title: mKernel: Fast Multi-GPU, Multi-Node Fused Kernels
summary: Communication has become a bottleneck in distributed training and inference of large models. Overlapping communication with computation at the granularity of kernels, on separate streams, reduces only part of this communication cost. Fused kernels often have better performance by transmitting each output tile as soon as it is produced, but existing fused kernels are largely confined to a single NVLink domain. We present mKernel, a library of multi-GPU, multi-node fused kernels that overlap computation, intra-node NVLink communication, and inter-node RDMA at tile granularity. mKernel partitions the streaming multiprocessors (SMs) of a persistent kernel into compute and communication roles, and an on-GPU controller tunes the SM partition adaptively at run time, since the best SM partition varies with the kernel and the input shape. It structures data movement hierarchically so that data traversing the inter-node network is minimized. Finally, it drives the network from the GPU through a lightweight command queue and host proxy implemented directly on RDMA verbs, which allows the same kernels to run on any network backend (e.g. InfiniBand and on AWS EFA); we observe, surprisingly, that GPUDirect Async (IBGDA) yields little additional benefit over host-assisted GPU-initiated communication. We implement five kernels spanning tensor, sequence, and expert parallelism. On two 16-GPU H200 clusters, mKernel achieves speedups of up to 1.72x on GEMM+AllReduce and $1.88\times$ on Ring Attention.

AI.tldr: mKernel是一个多GPU、多节点融合内核库，通过在tile粒度上重叠计算、节点内NVLink通信和节点间RDMA通信来解决分布式训练/推理中的通信瓶颈。它通过SM角色分工、层次化数据移动和基于RDMA verbs的可移植主机辅助GPU发起通信，在两个16-GPU H200集群上实现了最高1.72x（GEMM+AllReduce）和1.88x（Ring Attention）的加速。
AI.motivation: 大模型分布式训练/推理中，通信成为瓶颈（MoE训练中通信占前向43.6%、端到端32%）。现有的计算-通信重叠方案要么局限于单节点，要么在kernel边界以chunk粒度释放数据，无法在tile粒度上实现跨节点融合。此外，节点内NVLink（450 GB/s/GPU）与节点间网络（~50 GB/s/GPU）带宽严重不对称，且不同传输（InfiniBand vs EFA）的交付语义不同，给跨节点融合内核设计带来挑战。
AI.method: mKernel提出四项核心设计原则：(1) SM角色特化——将persistent kernel的SM分为计算、节点内通信、节点间发送/接收四类角色；(2) 层次化数据移动——先在NVSwitch上做本地reduce/broadcast以最小化跨节点流量，通过rail peer（同索引GPU）进行跨节点交换；(3) 可移植的主机辅助GPU发起通信——GPU将48字节命令写入pinned host内存的环形缓冲区，轻量级host proxy基于libibverbs批量提交RDMA write，绕过NCCL/NVSHMEM，同一代码可运行于InfiniBand和AWS EFA；(4) 自适应SM划分——片上控制器根据cycle counter估算compute/communication任务成本，动态调整目标SM分配。还实现了GPUDirect Async (IBGDA)版本，发现与主机辅助方式性能差异不大。共实现了5个kernel：AllGather+GEMM、GEMM+ReduceScatter、GEMM+AllReduce、MoE Dispatch+GEMM、Ring Attention。
AI.result: 在两个2节点×8 H200集群（一个用ConnectX-7 InfiniBand，一个用AWS EFA）上评估：GEMM+AllReduce最高1.72x（ConnectX-7）/1.53x（EFA）加速；Ring Attention最高1.88x（ConnectX-7）/1.78x（EFA）；AllGather+GEMM最高1.41x（EFA）/1.34x（ConnectX-7）；MoE Dispatch+GEMM在EFA上3.1–4.5x。优于Triton-distributed、Flux、Mercury、MagiAttention、ring-flash-attention等基线。自适应SM控制器在21个配置上达到静态最优的几何均值1.18x。
AI.conclusion: mKernel证明了在单个persistent kernel内统一协调计算、节点内NVLink和节点间RDMA的可行性，层次化数据移动和可移植的主机辅助GPU通信是关键创新。发现GPUDirect Async相比主机辅助方式并无一致优势。未来可扩展到更多节点和更大规模拓扑。

title: An Efficient and Modular Framework for Targeted Harm Mitigation in LLMS
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot learners but remain prone to misalignment with human preferences, often producing biased, toxic, or otherwise harmful outputs. Existing alignment methods, while effective, are costly and tightly coupled to the model, limiting flexibility and scalability. We propose a modular correction framework that augments pretrained LLMs with Activated LoRA (aLoRA) adapters and a context-aware routing mechanism to eliminate harms from misaligned model responses. Our approach enables expert adapters to activate mid-sequence without invalidating the KV cache, allowing low-latency, targeted correction during generation. Each expert is trained to detect and mitigate specific harms, such as bias or toxicity. A learned router dynamically selects appropriate experts based on the models intermediate outputs. We demonstrate that our system improves alignment on standard safety benchmarks while preserving task performance, offering a lightweight and efficient path toward safer and more controllable LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出一个模块化校正框架，通过Activated LoRA (aLoRA)适配器和上下文感知路由机制，在不失效KV缓存的前提下，对预训练LLM的有害输出进行低延迟、有针对性的修正。路由器和各aligner均以aLoRA形式实现，可热插拔并复用基础模型KV缓存。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法（如RLHF、DPO）训练成本高、与基础模型紧耦合，且会产生"对齐税"（损害任务性能）。外部aligner方法虽解耦，但需要多个独立检测器且无法复用KV缓存，导致延迟高、复杂度高。亟需一种轻量、模块化、低延迟且支持自定义对齐标准的方法。
AI.method: 1) 架构由一个路由器(aLoRA)和一组针对特定危害类型的aligner(aLoRA)组成；2) 路由器做多分类，将响应路由至对应aligner或判定无害；3) 每个aligner通过唯一的调用序列激活，只对调用序列之后的token应用低秩适配，使基础模型先前计算好的KV缓存可被复用，无需重新prefill；4) 损失函数为路由的多类交叉熵损失与aligner的语言建模损失之和；5) 测试三种训练配置：Trained Router（预训练aligner后冻结再训router）、Joint Trained Router、Cold Start Joint；6) 在BeaverTails、SafeRLHF、HarmfulQA上以Granite Guardian 3.1 8b标注，使用Granite 3.3 2b/8b作底座，并以Llama-3-8B、Mistral 7B、Gemma 12B、DeepSeek 7B等作基线。
AI.result: 路由任务上，加权平均F1≥80%（6类危害），2b路由器超越包括Gemma 12B在内的多数基线；3种训练配置路由性能相近。对齐任务上，aLoRA aligner在BeaverTails/SafeRLHF/HarmfulQA上对各危害类别的胜率多在0.85–1.00之间，与Granite instruct基线相当或更优。性能方面，相较LoRA变体，多轮对话中TTFT保持常数，延迟随对话增长显著降低，预期相对LoRA有7–20×加速。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以参数高效、可组合、模块化的方式实现针对性危害缓解，可复用基础模型KV缓存实现低延迟推理，并支持"自带适配器"式扩展。对齐与任务性能解耦，避免了传统RLHF/DPO的对齐税。局限：需访问基础模型权重（不适用于黑盒/API模型）；当前一次路由仅处理单一危害，多危害同时存在的复杂响应需扩展；适配器只能用于训练时所对应的模型，迁移会失去KV缓存复用优势。

title: LayerRoute: Adaptive Layer-Skipping with LoRA-Preserved Quality for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: We introduce LayerRoute, a parameter-efficient method for adaptive transformer layer-skipping that combines per-layer hard-gated routing (trained via a straight-through estimator) with joint LoRA fine-tuning. LayerRoute augments each of the 24 transformer blocks in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with a lightweight per-layer router (~21.5K parameters) and LoRA adapters (rank 8, ~1.08M parameters), training both jointly under a gate-regularized language-modeling objective. Across 10 independently-seeded training runs, LayerRoute converges to an identical skip-pattern structure in every run - a consistent set of 9 middle layers (8-16) becomes skip-eligible in all 10 seeds - and delivers genuine, verified wallclock speedup in every run (1.02x-1.06x, mean 1.04x). Quality is preserved or improved in every configuration tested: joint LoRA adaptation yields a perplexity improvement over the unmodified backbone in all 10 seeds (mean delta = -1.16 and -1.11 across the two evaluation splits used). We further verify the router performs genuine, non-trivial per-input computation: gate decisions in skip-eligible layers change the actual skip/run outcome for 87-100% of held-out samples, confirming real input-dependent routing rather than a fixed pruning pattern. LayerRoute trains in under 7 minutes on a single A100 and adds negligible overhead beyond the routing decision itself. We report our full reproducibility methodology, including a systematic diagnostic investigation into what determines the router's per-input decisions, as part of this work.

AI.tldr: LayerRoute是一种参数高效的自适应Transformer层跳过方法，在Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct的24个Transformer块上加入轻量级路由器（约21.5K参数）和LoRA适配器（rank 8，约1.08M参数），通过硬门控路由与LoRA联合训练，实现每输入动态跳过中间层，在10次独立随机种子实验中稳定获得1.02×–1.06×的实测加速，同时困惑度不降反升。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM推理对所有输入施加统一的计算量，而不同输入所需的计算量差异显著。如果能识别并跳过贡献较低的Transformer层，可在不损失质量的前提下降低推理开销。现有条件计算方法多基于单次训练运行报告结果，存在效应量不稳定、路由器可能退化为固定剪枝模式等问题，缺乏严格的可复现性验证。
AI.method: 1) 架构：在冻结的Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct的每个Transformer块中加入线性路由器（897参数/层，共21,528参数）和LoRA适配器（4个注意力投影，rank 8，α=16，共1,081,344参数）。2) 路由器对输入隐藏状态的均值池化做线性变换，经sigmoid后以0.5为阈值产生硬二值门控g_i∈{0,1}。3) 前向传播：h_{i+1}=g_i·Block_i(h_i)+(1-g_i)·h_i，门控为0时层被完全跳过（推理时不计算）。4) 采用直通估计器（STE）解决硬门控不可微问题，前向用硬决策、反向通过sigmoid梯度传递。5) 训练目标：LM损失+λ=1.0的门正则项（惩罚均匀高门值），防止全开退化。6) 偏置初始化：首尾16层b_i=+1.0，中间9层（8–16）b_i=−1.0，打破对称性使中间层从第1步起即可跳过。7) 10个独立随机种子训练，使用混合agentic数据集（工具调用+推理/规划），单A100训练约6.4分钟。
AI.result: 1) 跳过结构高度可复现：10个种子收敛到完全相同的模式——层0–7和17–23门值≈0.727（开放），层8–16门值≈0.273（可跳过），跨种子标准差<0.004。2) 实测墙钟加速1.02×–1.06×（均值1.04×），基于真实推理时跳过（非理论值）。3) 质量保持甚至提升：两个评估集上困惑度均低于全层基线（均值Δ=−1.16和−1.11），10/10种子皆为负。4) 路由器非平凡：门控权重项在可跳过层中改变了87%–100%样本的实际跳过/运行决策（中位93%），证明是真正的输入依赖路由而非固定剪枝。5) 局限性：作者无法确定路由器具体追踪何种输入信号——线性探针显示数据源语义可分离但路由器权重方向与之相关性近零；与序列长度相关性更强但与数据源标签高度共线，无法独立区分；显式监督实验也未改善对齐。6) 仅在Qwen2.5-0.5B单模型单架构族上验证，泛化性未知。
AI.conclusion: LayerRoute通过轻量级硬门控路由器与LoRA联合微调，实现了可复现的自适应层跳过，在10个独立随机种子上稳定获得一致的中间层跳过模式、实测加速（均值1.04×）和困惑度改善。作者将可复现性协议本身作为贡献，并直接验证了路由器的输入依赖性。然而，作者坦承尚未确定路由器决策所追踪的具体信号特征，将其诊断方法学作为模板公开，以匹配论文其余部分的严谨标准。LayerRoute与注意力内核优化、量化、剪枝、推测解码等技术互补，可叠加使用。

title: Not all Negation Cues are Equal: Affixal Negations Yield Better Negation Understanding
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Negation remains a longstanding challenge for both language models (LMs) and large language models (LLMs). Prior work mainly focuses on a small set of high-frequency single-word negation cues, such as not and never, with limited exploration of broader negation types and modern LLMs. To address this gap, we construct NegCue, a large-scale dataset containing over 1.8M samples spanning single-word, multi-word, and affixal negation with more than 200 unique cues. We further pre-train both encoder-only LMs and LLMs on NegCue to investigate how different negation types affect negation understanding. Experiments on five downstream benchmarks show that negation types contribute unevenly to performance gains under the same training scale. In particular, affixal negation yields the largest improvements, while the gains from the commonly studied single-word negation remain modest. Moreover, our results demonstrate that further pre-training improves negation understanding for both LMs and LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个大规模否定语料库 NegCue（包含超过 180 万样本和 214 个独特否定线索），并通过下一句极性预测（NSPP）任务对 BERT、RoBERTa 以及 Llama、Qwen 等语言模型进行进一步预训练。实验发现，不同否定类型（词缀、单词、多词）的贡献并不均等：词缀否定带来的提升最大，而以往研究中常用的单词否定提升最小。
AI.motivation: 否定理解是语言模型长期面临的挑战，但现有研究主要聚焦于 not、never 等少数高频单词型否定线索，忽略了词缀否定和多词否定等更广泛的否定形式，限制了对否定理解能力的全面提升。
AI.method: 构建 NegCue 语料库：从 2023 年英文维基百科中提取连续句对，其中第二句包含或不含词缀、单词或多词型否定线索，最终包含超 180 万样本和 214 个独特线索。使用下一句极性预测（NSPP）作为自监督任务，对 BERT-large、RoBERTa-large、Llama3.2-1B/3B 和 Qwen2-0.5B 进行进一步预训练。在五个下游基准（CondaQA、NeQA、NevIR、NMoNLI、ScoNe-NLI）上评估，并通过消融实验验证否定类型的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，进一步预训练 NegCue 在所有基准上都带来一致提升。其中词缀否定提升最大（RoBERTa 在 CondaQA 上提升达 +25.8%），而单词否定提升最小。中等频率否定线索获益最大。消融实验表明通用持续预训练反而损害性能，证实收益来源于否定特定的学习。Llama3.2-3B 在 NeQA 上达到 73%，超越此前 71% 的最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 不同否定类型对模型否定理解能力的贡献并不均等，词缀否定提供最显著的提升，而传统研究的单词否定反而贡献较小。NegCue 和 NSPP 预训练策略可有效提升 LMs 和 LLMs 的否定理解能力，为未来否定研究提供了新方向。

title: Leakage-Safe and Scheduler-Aware Machine Learning for Grid Job Runtime Prediction
comment: Accepted in the 26th International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026)
summary: Accurate job runtime prediction can improve scheduling-aware resource management in grid and distributed computing environments, but prediction models must be evaluated under realistic deployment constraints. This paper revisits CPU burst time prediction on the GWA-T-4 AuverGrid workload trace and reformulates it as leakage-safe pre-execution job runtime prediction. We define the target as job-level runtime, use only submission-time attributes, exclude post-execution variables, and evaluate models under temporal and cold-start settings rather than relying only on random cross-validation. We compare standard regressors, chronological historical baselines, categorical encoding strategies, and CatBoost with native categorical handling. We further add temporal hyperparameter tuning, runtime predictability analysis, feature ablation, error analysis by job length, and a minimal scheduling simulation. After temporal-validation tuning, CatBoost achieves the strongest deployment-oriented result with R^2=0.239, MAE=27,019, RMSE=46,587, and LogMAE=2.646 on the held-out temporal test set. A single-server simulation over all 69,523 held-out temporal test jobs shows that prediction-informed SJF reduces average waiting time by 50.92% relative to FCFS. The results show that random-split evaluation overestimates performance, categorical-native boosting improves temporal generalization, and long-job underestimation remains a scheduler-relevant challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文针对网格作业CPU突发时间预测任务，重新审视了GWA-T-4 AuverGrid工作负载轨迹上的预测问题，将其重新定义为无信息泄露的预执行作业运行时预测。核心贡献不在于提出新算法，而在于构建了一种严格的部署感知评估范式：通过仅使用提交时可获取的特征、引入时序安全的历史基线、比较类别特征编码策略、对CatBoost进行时序验证调优，并加入极简调度模拟来连接预测质量与调度行为。实验表明随机划分严重高估性能，调优后的CatBoost在时序测试集上R²仅0.239，但预测驱动的SJF仍可在单服务器模拟中将平均等待时间相对FCFS降低50.92%，长作业低估仍是调度相关的核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有网格作业运行时预测研究多采用随机交叉验证进行评估，存在目标泄露（使用执行后变量）和时间信息泄露问题，导致报告的性能无法真实反映部署场景；同时预测结果与调度决策之间的联系未被充分建立。本文旨在建立一种无泄露、时序感知且调度相关的评估基准，以更真实地衡量模型在生产部署条件下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 方法体系包含六个关键设计：（1）泄露安全特征策略——仅保留SubmitTime、ReqNProcs/ReqTime/ReqMemory等提交时属性及UserID、GroupID、ExecutableID等类别标识符，排除RunTime、WaitTime、UsedMemory等执行后变量；（2）时序安全历史基线——为每个测试作业仅使用其提交时间之前的同实体训练作业，避免未来信息泄露；（3）多种评估划分——随机5折、时序80/20、用户冷启动、可执行文件冷启动；（4）类别编码策略对比——独热、序数、目标均值编码与CatBoost原生类别处理；（5）时序验证调优——在内层时序验证集上选择CatBoost超参数（树深度8、500轮迭代、学习率0.03、L₂正则5），仅在保留的时序测试集上评估一次；（6）极简单服务器非抢占式调度模拟——比较FCFS、预测SJF与Oracle SJF在全部69,523个保留作业上的等待时间。
AI.result: 主要实验结果：（1）随机划分下K-NN达R²=0.700、MAE=7,417，而时序80/20下调优CatBoost仅R²=0.239、MAE=27,019、RMSE=46,587、LogMAE=2.646，随机划分显著高估性能；（2）时序划分下User EMA基线从随机的R²=0.638跌至-0.157，时序一致性至关重要；（3）类别编码对比中CatBoost原生类别处理（R²=0.239）大幅优于其他模型的最佳目标编码结果（Gradient Boosting R²=0.107）；（4）特征消融显示全部特征配置最优（R²=0.239），仅标识符（R²=0.126）、仅请求资源（R²<0）均较差；（5）置换重要性表明UserID、GroupID、ReqTime为最关键特征；（6）误差分析揭示系统偏差——短/中作业高估、超长/极长作业严重低估（极长作业低估率100%，平均误差-105,448秒）；（7）调度模拟显示预测SJF将平均等待时间从82,926,590降至40,698,550，相对FCFS改善50.92%，Oracle SJF改善75.83%。
AI.conclusion: 结论强调三点核心发现：第一，随机划分严重高估部署性能，必须采用时序和冷启动划分进行严格评估；第二，类别原生梯度提升（CatBoost）在泄露安全约束下能恢复有意义的时序预测能力（R²=0.239），优于传统编码策略下的各类模型；第三，长作业系统低估仍是调度相关的关键局限，可能导致回填预留违例。论文的主要贡献是建立了无泄露、时序感知、调度连接的评估范式，而非追求更高的回归精度。未来工作方向包括：集成至完整调度模拟器评估回填策略、探索分位数回归与保形预测区间、设计惩罚长作业低估的非对称损失函数，以及跨工作负载轨迹的泛化验证。

title: TyPatch: Transforming Patches into Typestate Rules for Kernel Bug Detection
summary: Historical Linux kernel patches capture defect knowledge that applies beyond their original repair sites. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can generate static-analysis checkers from historical patches and use them to uncover new kernel bugs. However, complete-checker generation requires the model both to recover the defect semantics expressed by a patch and to implement sophisticated program-analysis machinery, including object tracking, alias analysis, path-state maintenance, and interprocedural propagation. Coupling these responsibilities in a single end-to-end code-generation task can turn a simple defect rule into an unstable and expensive analyzer-implementation problem. To address this problem, we present TyPatch, which decouples patch-specific defect semantics from analyzer implementation. An LLM translates each patch into a typestate rule specifying its tracked object, actions, guards, transitions, and violations. A shared backend then executes these rules, binding their actions to program events, tracking object identity across aliases, propagating typestate along program paths, and producing reports for all rules. On Linux v6.16, TyPatch finds 559 distinct bugs, 121 of which have been confirmed by kernel developers. In a matched 38-patch comparison with the state-of-the-art complete-checker construction workflow, TyPatch uses 88.3-90.1% fewer generation tokens, while its initial report pools achieve 3.42-14.95$\times$ the precision of those produced by that workflow.

AI.tldr: TyPatch提出了一种解耦的Linux内核缺陷检测方法：通过LLM将历史补丁转化为结构化的typestate规则（仅描述缺陷语义），由共享后端统一执行对象跟踪、别名分析与路径敏感传播。在Linux v6.16中发现559个独立漏洞（121个已获开发者确认），相比SOTA的KNighter节省88.3-90.1%的生成token，初始报告精度提升3.42-14.95倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM从历史补丁生成完整Clang Static Analyzer检查器的方法（如KNighter），将"恢复补丁缺陷语义"与"实现复杂分析机制"耦合在同一代码生成任务中，导致实现错误频发、生成成本高、有效检查器产出率低（GPT-5.5仅27/167、DeepSeek仅23/198有效）。问题根源在于模型需为每个补丁独立重建对象跟踪、别名分析、路径状态维护与跨过程传播机制。
AI.method: TyPatch采用两阶段流水线：（1）规则生成阶段——LLM接收commit message、代码diff与源码上下文，结合类型化规则模式生成typestate规则R=⟨O,E,Q,q₀,δ,q_b,K⟩，显式定义追踪对象、动作字母表、状态集合、初始/违规状态、转移函数、合并算子与证据契约；经两阶段验证（模式验证+源绑定+状态机可达性+后端可执行性）后序列化为.ts格式。（2）共享后端执行阶段——基于LLVM IR与CFG统一执行规则池：动作匹配将规则动作绑定到LLVM指令/CFG边；AliasGraph通过ρ映射与字段边传递跨别名对象身份；移除回边后在拓扑序上做路径敏感传播（Γ=⟨A,T,H,B⟩）；证据筛选通过沿路径重放关键动作序列拒绝不可行候选；多条规则在同一链接单元中分组执行，共享AliasGraph与对象转移成本。
AI.result: （1）Linux v6.16漏洞发现：三个LLM（GPT-5.5/DeepSeek-v4-pro/Claude Opus 4.8）基于100个历史修复生成规则池，共发现559个独立漏洞（121个已获开发者确认），覆盖8个缺陷族，67.4%的漏洞被至少两个模型规则池共同发现。（2）38补丁匹配对比KNighter：TyPatch产生更多有效制品（GPT：31 vs 27；DeepSeek：25 vs 23），模型调用减少6.8-9.2倍，token消耗减少88.3-90.1%，初始报告池TP数多2.72-14.27倍，精度提升3.42-14.95倍（GPT：4.67% vs 0.31%；DeepSeek：9.11% vs 2.66%）。（3）规则保真度：249条规则中236条（94.8%）保留种子缺陷的核心对象与源-汇关系；13条错配集中在对象身份（4）、动作绑定（6）、失败谓词（1）与状态拓扑（2）；对齐规则贡献1131/1132的模型特定TP。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的typestate规则生成通过将补丁语义与分析机制解耦，显著提升了Linux内核缺陷检测的可靠性、成本与可扩展性。规则作为持久可执行的缺陷知识载体，可随内核演化累积；共享后端使新规则无需重新实现分析基础设施。验证了将LLM的角色限定为"描述缺陷语义"而非"实现分析器"的范式优势，为历史修复知识的规模化利用提供了可行路径。

title: PolicyMem: Geometric Policy Memory for LLM Governance
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world high-stakes applications, effective governance has become essential. Existing safeguards largely follow two paradigms: learning-based guards provide strong semantic discrimination but couple policy behavior to trained models and taxonomies, while programmable frameworks offer flexible control but require substantial manual prompt and workflow engineering. Neither externalizes policies as reusable operational states, making it difficult to consistently reuse policy evidence across detection, intervention, and verification. In this paper, we introduce PolicyMem, a geometric policy memory that externalizes natural-language policies as reusable geometric memory objects represented by low-rank subspaces in a shared representation space. A memory writer compiles natural-language policies into policy memory slots, and query-response pairs read the policy memory through projection energy. The resulting policy-evidence profile directly mediates the safety verdict and is reused for policy attribution and post-intervention verification. Coupled with a response rewriter, PolicyMem enables a detect-rewrite-verify loop for LLM governance. Across five widely used benchmarks, PolicyMem achieves state-of-the-art unsafe behavior detection while enabling effective policy attribution, rewriting, and post-intervention verification through the shared policy memory.

AI.tldr: PolicyMem提出了一种几何策略记忆框架，将自然语言策略编译为共享表示空间中的低秩子空间，通过投影能量进行读取，实现LLM安全的闭环治理（检测-改写-验证），在五个安全基准上达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全保障机制存在两大局限：基于学习的守卫模型将策略行为隐式耦合在训练参数中，难以独立检查和复用；可编程框架需要大量手工工程且缺乏跨治理阶段的一致性策略证据。两者都未将策略外部化为可复用的操作状态，导致在检测、干预和验证阶段难以一致地共享策略证据。
AI.method: PolicyMem将每个自然语言策略通过共享的子空间编译器映射为治理空间中的低秩子空间作为策略记忆槽；查询-响应对通过投影能量读取策略记忆，生成策略证据剖面；该剖面既驱动安全判定，又用于策略归因和改写反馈；通过响应改写器形成"检测-改写-验证"的闭环治理流程。训练采用多任务损失（判定+对比对齐+子空间去重叠+策略级辅助损失）和两阶段改写器训练（拒绝采样蒸馏+记忆门控DPO）。
AI.result: 在BeaverTails、WildGuardMix、Aegis 2.0、BingoGuard和SafeRLHF五个基准上，0.5B/3B PolicyMem在Safe-F1和Unsafe-F1上均优于所有基线；策略归因mAP显著优于Qwen提示基线；改写在安全性、信息保留和有用性上取得最佳综合得分；在leave-one-taxonomy-out协议下保持0.930 AUROC；存储仅需0.6MB（基线418-493MB），推理延迟19-28ms远低于WildGuard等。
AI.conclusion: PolicyMem通过几何策略记忆实现了统一的闭环LLM治理，证明了将策略外部化为低秩子空间操作状态的有效性，能够在检测、归因、改写和验证各阶段一致复用策略证据，同时具备良好的跨策略集泛化能力和部署效率。

title: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages. Equal contribution: Hongliang Wei and Xiaobing Tu. Corresponding authors: Xiaobing Tu and Xiaopeng Fan
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.

AI.tldr: 提出 HarnessBandit：一种面向多 harness 智能体强化学习的在线调度器，在每个优化步骤中根据"可学习性"（learnability，当前 harness 的平均绝对优势）与"可迁移性"（transferability，当前梯度草图与其他 harness 指数移动平均余弦相似度）动态选择单个 harness 产生纯批次，从而替代静态混合批次训练。在 Qwen3.5-2B × 6 个 harness × ClawGym 训练中，在 PinchBench 与 ClawEval 上均优于两种混合基线。
AI.motivation: 同一大模型代理在不同的 harness（系统提示、工具 schema、控制循环、轨迹格式差异）下表现不一致，对 harness 变化具有鲁棒性是重要目标。直接用多 harness 混合批次训练引入了调度难题：每一步既要保证当前 harness 提供有效学习信号，又要使更新方向能惠及其他 harness。静态分配无法响应这些非平稳信号。
AI.method: 将多 harness 训练建模为非平稳多臂赌博机，每个 harness 是一个臂。核心机制：(1) 每次 GRPO 更新后观测 learnability L_h（组内平均绝对优势）与 transferability T_h（当前 harness 的低维梯度草图与其他 harness 的 EMA 单位草图之间的余弦相似度均值）；(2) 经池化滑动窗口（W=32）min-max 归一化后融合为分数 S_h=α·L̃+(1-α)·T̃，α=0.5；(3) 维护每臂 Q 值 EMA（β=0.3）；(4) 采用 U_h=Q_h+c/√(n_h+1)，并通过带温度 τ=0.3 的 softmax 与 ε=0.15 的均匀下界混合采样；(5) 梯度草图采用最后 K=4 个 transformer 块的固定比例坐标子采样（d=65536），避免存储完整梯度；(6) 前 30 步轮询热身。整体作为 GRPO 之上常数级附加层，不修改策略目标。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-2B + Dr.GRPO、150 步、4 GPU 条件下，2,000 ClawGym 任务 × 6 harness。PinchBench（147 任务，分布内 OpenClaw）：HarnessBandit 均分 0.506，优于 OpenClaw+Codex 双 harness 混合（0.493）和 6 harness 混合（0.331，与基模 0.330 持平）。ClawEval（161 任务，分布外 harness，N=3）：Pass³ 与基模并列 26.7%（43/161），Pass@3 达 41.6%（67/161）vs 基模 36.0%（58/161）、6 harness 混合 38.5%（62/161）；平均分 0.556 vs 基模 0.534、6 harness 混合 0.510。PinchBench 子类目中 HarnessBandit 在 7/11 项领先。诊断显示 L 与 T 给出不同且随时间演化的排序（Pi 高可学习性但中等可迁移性，OpenCode 两项均高），最终采样概率为 0.127–0.204，访问次数 21–32，未坍缩到单一 arm。
AI.conclusion: 多 harness 智能体 RL 应当把"用哪个 harness 生成下一批数据"作为一个显式调度决策。HarnessBandit 表明，基于训练器内生的可学习性与跨 harness 可迁移性两个互补信号进行在线赌博机式分配，能够在固定 GRPO 预算下同时提升分布内与分布外 harness 的表现，避免静态混合批次带来的干扰或坍缩。两信号具备独立性与时变性，是合理调度依据。

title: Understanding the Limits of Agentic ICD Coding
summary: ICD-10-CM codes are alphanumeric codes used in the US to classify diagnoses and injuries for medical billing and epidemiological reporting. Standard ICD-10-CM benchmarks report aggregate metrics that obscure performance on complex coding scenarios. We evaluate neural, workflow, and agentic systems on a rarity-stratified set of MIMIC-IV discharge summaries and identify two orthogonal failure modes. Neural classifiers exhibit a 0.43 micro-F1 gap between rare and common codes. Workflow systems handle rare codes well but score near zero on injury and external cause codes that require multi-step guideline following. A tool-augmented agentic configuration with structured access to official ICD-10-CM reference materials recovers up to 0.34 micro-F1 on this subset. No single system dominates across all conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对ICD-10-CM自动编码任务，在按稀有度分层和多步指南遵循难度的MIMIC-IV出院小结上系统评估了三种范式（判别式神经模型PLM-ICD、工作流式代理CodeSeeker、自由形式工具增强代理），发现两类正交失败模式，并证明无单一系统在所有条件下占优。
AI.motivation: 现有ICD-10-CM基准报告聚合指标，掩盖了稀有码与需要多步指南遵循的复杂编码场景下的性能差距。系统性失败模式分析有限，且现有代理系统采用固定工作流，限制了动态重查索引和指南的能力。
AI.method: 构建稀有度分层（rare/uncommon/common各50份）和多步导航子集（Ch.19/20损伤与外部原因，153份）的MIMIC-IV评估集；设计受控多轮代理框架，提供9个工具（搜索/验证/参考/提交）以结构化访问官方ICD-10-CM参考材料，并强制"发现接地"（未通过工具发现的码不可提交）；比较PLM-ICD、CodeSeeker与多款LLM在有无工具、是否引入PLM-ICD作工具、是否去除提示级序列指令等消融条件下的表现。
AI.result: 1）PLM-ICD在稀有码与常见码间存在0.43的micro-F1差距；2）CodeSeeker在多步子集上接近零分（Opus 4.6仅0.010–0.027），固定检索无法暴露成对的外部原因与发生地码；3）工具增强代理在多步子集上较CodeSeeker恢复最高0.34 micro-F1；4）发现阶段是多步码的主要瓶颈（66–86%漏码从未被检索到），而非验证；5）正确码的发现位置显著早于错误码（p<10⁻¹³）；6）将PLM-ICD作为工具对不同模型效果不一致；7）移除提示级外部原因序列指令使GPT-5.2在常见码F1从0.322跌至0.091。
AI.conclusion: 稀有度偏差与多步指南遵循失败是两类正交缺陷：神经分类器因训练分布偏向常见码而在稀有码上退化，固定工作流代理因无法动态重新查询索引而在损伤/外部原因码上失效；结合工具层发现接地与提示层序列指导的工具增强代理可部分缓解该问题，但验证表明选择难于验证、更多工具调用不等同于更高精度，无单一系统在所有条件下占优。

title: Bangla Sentence Function Classification: Corpus Development, Model Benchmarking, and Interpretability
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE 5th International Conference on Robotics, Automation, Artificial-Intelligence and Internet-of-Things (RAAICON)
summary: Automatic sentence function identification is important for many downstream natural language processing (NLP) applications such as dialogue systems, text-to-speech synthesis, and machine translation. However, benchmark resources for Bangla sentence function classification remain limited. To mitigate this gap, this paper introduces a corpus of 10,000 Bangla sentences, manually annotated into four functional categories, namely declarative, interrogative, imperative, and exclamatory. The corpus is nearly balanced across the four classes, with high annotation reliability reflected by a Fleiss\' Kappa of 0.82. Furthermore, we evaluate multiple feature representations, including Bag-of-Words (BoW), TF-IDF, and Word2Vec, with several classical machine learning classifiers. In addition, two heterogeneous ensemble models, namely Single-Level Ensemble (SLE) and Double-Level Ensemble (DLE), are utilized to improve classification performance. Experimental results show that TF-IDF consistently outperforms Word2Vec, likely due to its ability to emphasize discriminative lexical cues associated with sentence functions, particularly given the relatively small corpus used to train Word2Vec. The DLE model with TF-IDF features achieves the best performance with accuracy and macro-F1 of 0.95, demonstrating the effectiveness of sparse lexical representations and heterogeneous ensemble learning for this task. Further cross-validation confirms the robustness of the approach, while LIME-based interpretability provides insights into model predictions. The developed corpus and model benchmarking establish strong baselines for Bangla sentence function classification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对孟加拉语句子功能分类资源匮乏的问题，构建了一个包含10,000条人工标注句子的语料库（分为陈述、疑问、祈使、感叹四类），并通过多种特征表示（BoW、TF-IDF、Word2Vec）与经典机器学习分类器及异构集成模型（SLE和DLE）进行基准测试，最终DLE+TF-IDF以0.95的准确率和宏F1值取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 句子功能识别（陈述/疑问/祈使/感叹）对对话系统、文本转语音、机器翻译等NLP下游应用至关重要，但孟加拉语作为低资源语言缺乏相关基准语料和分类研究，作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建10,000句孟加拉语人工标注语料，四类近乎平衡，Fleiss' Kappa为0.82保证标注可靠性；2) 采用BoW、TF-IDF、Word2Vec三种特征表示；3) 使用多种经典机器学习分类器，并提出两种异构集成方法——单层集成（SLE）和双层集成（DLE）；4) 通过交叉验证验证稳健性，并使用LIME进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: 实验表明TF-IDF因能突出判别性词汇线索而一致优于Word2Vec（后者受限于小语料训练）；DLE模型结合TF-IDF特征取得最佳性能，准确率和宏F1均达到0.95；交叉验证证实方法稳健；LIME可解释性分析提供了模型预测的洞察。
AI.conclusion: 所构建的语料库和模型基准为孟加拉语句子功能分类任务建立了强有力的基线，验证了稀疏词汇表示与异构集成学习在该任务上的有效性，将促进该低资源语言的相关NLP研究。

title: Phorecaster365: A Human-Supervised Reference Architecture for Hybrid Pharmaceutical Sales Forecasting and Planning Decision Support
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary appendices
summary: Pharmaceutical sales forecasts inform planning across products, regions, and distribution channels, yet their interpretation depends on inventory availability, transaction semantics, product lifecycle, and the information available when each forecast is issued. A model prediction alone does not preserve these conditions or establish whether a forecast is suitable for operational use. We present Phorecaster365, a human-supervised reference architecture that connects enterprise resource planning data to reviewable pharmaceutical sales forecasts. The architecture separates source ingestion, product-region series construction, temporally valid feature generation, statistical and machine-learning modeling, ensemble formation, uncertainty assessment, planner review, and lifecycle governance. Its central intermediate representation is a forecast context package that preserves the source snapshot, forecast target, temporal cutoff, available covariates, data-quality state, and hierarchy version. A corresponding forecast evidence package links predictions to model and calibration versions, exceptions, human adjustments, and publication history. Development experience with a synthetic panel of 10,950 daily records across 30 product-region series informs the design. Historical experiment summaries are retained only as descriptive evidence of development because their evaluation does not establish independent predictive validity. We specify a rolling-origin evaluation protocol, baseline and ablation requirements, uncertainty and robustness assessments, and a staged pathway from synthetic testing to use in governed planning. The contribution is an implementation-neutral system design and validation framework; the report does not establish real-world forecasting accuracy, comparative superiority, or operational benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Phorecaster365，一种人机协同的参考架构，旨在将企业资源规划（ERP）数据与可审查的药品销售预测相结合。该架构通过"预测上下文包"和"预测证据包"两种核心中间表示，解决了销售预测在库存可用性、交易语义、产品生命周期和预测发布时点等方面的语义与治理问题。文章规范了滚动起点评估协议、分阶段验证路径，但未声称建立实际的预测准确性或运营效益。
AI.motivation: 药品销售预测在跨产品、地区和分销渠道的规划中具有重要作用，但其解读高度依赖于一系列运营条件（库存可用性、交易语义、产品生命周期、信息可得时点）。单一的模型预测输出无法保留这些条件，也无法判定预测是否适合运营使用。现有做法在追溯性、可审计性和治理层面存在空白，因此需要一种能够将数据语义、生命周期治理和人工审查系统化整合的参考架构。
AI.method: 该论文提出一种实现中立的参考架构——Phorecaster365，其核心设计要素包括：(1) 模块化分层：源数据接入、产品-地区序列构建、时间有效特征生成、统计与机器学习建模、集成形成、不确定性评估、规划者审查与生命周期治理；(2) 中央中间表示："预测上下文包"（保留源快照、预测目标、时间截止点、可用协变量、数据质量状态与层级版本）和"预测证据包"（关联预测与模型/校准版本、异常、人工调整与发布历史）；(3) 验证框架：基于滚动起点（rolling-origin）的评估协议，明确基线与消融要求、不确定性与稳健性评估；(4) 治理路径：从合成数据测试到受治理规划环境使用的分阶段实施路径。开发经验基于一个包含30个产品-地区序列、10,950条日记录的合成面板。
AI.result: 本文报告的核心结果是架构层面的设计与验证框架，而非实证性能结果：(1) 通过合成面板的开发经验为设计决策提供描述性依据；(2) 明确定义了历史实验仅作为开发描述性证据保留，因为其评估无法建立独立的预测效度；(3) 规范了滚动起点评估协议、基线与消融实验要求、不确定性与稳健性评估准则；(4) 建立了从合成测试到受治理规划环境的分阶段过渡路径。文章明确声明报告未建立真实世界的预测准确性、相对优越性或运营效益。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于提出一种实现中立的系统设计与验证框架，强调药品销售预测的可追溯性、可审查性与生命周期治理，而非追求预测精度本身。该框架通过"预测上下文包"与"预测证据包"将数据语义、模型版本与人工监督纳入统一的中间表示层，为药品销售预测的运营化使用奠定了方法论基础。该工作属于架构规范层面的贡献，其实证有效性有待后续在受治理规划环境中的分阶段验证。

title: Finite-Time Node Separation in Recurrent Graph Neural Networks with Persistent Gaussian Perturbations
summary: Persistent Gaussian perturbations have been shown to prevent asymptotic oversmoothing in recurrent Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) by ensuring a positive stationary Dirichlet energy. However, this global energy bound does not guarantee that individual node representations remain distinct at finite depths. In this paper, we provide a complementary finite-time analysis of the same persistent-noise architecture. Let \(d\) denote the representation dimension and \(\sigma\) the noise standard deviation. We first prove an exact second-moment decomposition for the expected squared distance between any two node representations, yielding the universal lower bound \(2\sigma^2 d\) at every positive time step without contraction or stationarity assumptions. More precisely, conditional pairwise distances have a noncentral chi-square characterization: the noncentrality parameter is the deterministic message-passing separation normalized by \(2\sigma^2\). This yields dynamics-aware fixed-time and finite-horizon near-collision bounds that retain information discarded by the central worst-case analysis. The earlier central Gaussian bound is recovered as the worst-case zero-separation case. We additionally prove almost-sure pairwise noncollision, derive a uniform finite-horizon guarantee, and establish permutation equivariance in distribution for the stochastic dynamics and permutation-invariant graph outputs. Our results complement the asymptotic energy analysis of prior work and provide rigorous finite-time guarantees on node-level representation separation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带持续高斯扰动的循环图神经网络(GNN)，在无收缩性或平稳性假设下，给出节点表示两两分离的有限时间概率精化分析：证明精确的二阶矩分解(产生与拓扑无关的普适下界 2σ²d)、条件非中心χ²刻画导出动力学感知的固定时刻与有限时域近碰撞概率上界、几乎必然的两两不碰撞、以及随机动力学的分布置换等变性。实验在合成图上验证了这些理论预测。
AI.motivation: 现有工作[1]已证明持续高斯扰动通过保证正的平稳Dirichlet能量可阻止渐近过平滑。但该全局渐近能量界无法保证有限深度下个体节点表示仍保持可区分。正的整体能量与某些节点对可能极近甚至重合是兼容的。本文因此问：在不依赖收缩性或平稳性假设的前提下，持续高斯更新本身能给出怎样的有限时间、逐对的概率分离保证？
AI.method: 研究对象是与[1]相同的后更新加性高斯噪声循环架构 H⁽ᵗ⁺¹⁾ = F(H⁽ᵗ⁾) + σΞ⁽ᵗ⁾。方法完全基于噪声的独立高斯结构：(1) 对条件差 ζᵢⱼ⁽ᵗ⁾ ∼ N(0, 2σ²I_d) 进行二阶矩展开，得到精确分解等式并由此给出 2σ²d 的期望下界；(2) 注意到条件差服从以确定性消息传递分离为非中心参数的非中心χ²分布，由此推出随 λᵢⱼ⁽ᵗ⁾ = ‖Fᵢ−Fⱼ‖²/(2σ²) 变化的固定时刻与有限时域近碰撞上界（含中心高斯上界作为 λ=0 最坏情形）；(3) 用非退化高斯密度的满维性证明精确碰撞概率为零，并对所有正时刻取交得同时不碰撞；(4) 用高斯噪声的可交换性证明动力学的分布置换等变性与图级读出的分布不变性；(5) 在3类合成图(n=30)、d=16、σ=0.1、T=40 的循环消息传递 tanh(AHWᵀ) 上做5组蒙特卡洛实验验证。
AI.result: 理论结果：(i) 引理3.1的精确二阶矩分解 ℰ[‖Δᵢⱼ⁽ᵗ⁺¹⁾‖²] = ℰ[‖Fᵢ−Fⱼ‖²] + 2σ²d；(ii) 定理3.2给出 t≥1 时普适期望下界 2σ²d；(iii) 定理3.4与推论3.5–3.6证明几乎必然两两不碰撞，且对有限图同时跨所有正时刻成立；(iv) 引理3.8给出条件非中心χ² CDF 形式的精确小球概率，定理3.10/3.14导出动力学感知的固定时刻与有限时域上界 ε_δ,T ∝ σ·T^{−1/d}·[Γ(d/2+1)/C(n,2)]^{1/d}；(v) 定理6.1–6.2与推论6.3证明分布置换等变与图级读出不变性。实验结果：在3种图(cycle, ER, BA)上 2σ²d 的实证均值 ≈0.319–0.320，与理论值0.32吻合；最小成对距离始终为正(T=40时中位数≈0.38)；实证近碰撞概率在非空洞区间内均小于理论中央上界；置换实验中保持同一数值噪声时配对差很大(均值绝对差1.47)但边际分布KS检验不拒绝同分布(p=0.77)；27组参数敏感性扫描中实证5%分位始终高于 ε_δ,T，中位经验/理论比1.44(范围1.36–1.93)。
AI.conclusion: 本文是对持续噪声GNN理论的有限时间概率精化，而非新架构或图级普适表达力定理。在不需收缩性或平稳性假设下，严格证明了期望下界 2σ²d、几乎必然两两不碰撞、动力学感知的高概率分离界以及分布置换等变性。中心高斯最坏情形界被恢复为非中心χ²精化的 λ=0 特殊情形。控制实验支持理论预测，但实证与理论界之间存在保守间隙(中位比1.44)，源于对节点对与时间步的并集上界。节点级分离不等价于图级普适性；连接有限时间随机分离与图级表达力仍是开放问题。

title: CRITICS - Critical Science Without Borders: Language Models to Promote Critical Thinking in Science Education
summary: The CRITICS project addresses science accessibility and literacy by converging advanced Machine Translation (MT) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) with educational technology. By leveraging MT systems specifically optimized for scientific content, educational institutions can provide accurate, culturally relevant translations of scientific materials in students' native languages, ensuring that complex scientific concepts are comprehensible while maintaining technical accuracy. Building on these translations, the project explores the design and evaluation of innovative science teaching-learning proposals grounded in curriculum-aligned teaching-learning. Thus, CRITICS will investigate key components of scientific argumentation and critical thinking practices together with textual feedback aligned with learning objectives and assessment criteria inspired by competence-based evaluation frameworks. CRITICS aims to break down language barriers to accessing cutting-edge research and educational materials currently available only in high-resourced languages, thereby facilitating the democratization of scientific knowledge and fostering critical thinking in science education.

AI.tldr: CRITICS是一个为期三年的CHIST-ERA IV项目，旨在通过基于大语言模型(LLM)的机器翻译技术，将科学知识翻译成低资源语言（如巴斯克语、立陶宛语），并结合论证挖掘和自动批判性问题生成，促进科学教育中的批判性思维，推动科学知识的民主化。
AI.motivation: 当前科学研究和教育材料主要使用英语等高资源语言出版，导致低资源语言（如巴斯克语、立陶宛语）使用者在获取科学知识方面面临语言障碍，限制了科学素养和批判性思维能力的培养。CRITICS旨在通过NLP技术打破这一语言壁垒，使科学知识能够以学生母语的形式精准传播，同时培养学生的科学论证和批判性思维能力。
AI.method: 项目采用三组件系统方法：(1)基于LLM的科学文档翻译系统，使用适配器对科学语料进行微调，保留专业术语和文档结构；(2)教学与学习序列(TLS)生成器，将翻译后的科学文献转化为结构化教育资源，并通过论证图分析识别关键概念；(3)基于LLM的自动评估器，通过论证挖掘检测误解和谬误，自动生成与学习目标对齐的批判性问题及文本反馈。此外，还开发针对科学领域MT和文本生成任务的LLM-as-a-Judge评估方法。所有技术通过三个开发-评估循环迭代改进。
AI.result: 作为项目立项阶段的论文，CRITICS目前尚未报告实验结果，但已明确：(1)聚焦自然科学（生物、化学、物理）和人工智能两大领域；(2)针对英语-立陶宛语/巴斯克语（低资源）和英语-法语/德语（中资源）翻译；(3)将开发Parallel Reader和Teacher Evaluator两款原型工具；(4)数据来源包括Biorxiv、PubMed Central、ChemRxiv、arXiv、ACL Anthology等开放科学资源；(5)将利用UPV/EHU现有的500份能力本位评估数据集。项目的创新点包括：针对科学文档的LLM翻译、跨语言论证相似性研究、多语言批判性问题自动生成（该任务此前基本未被探索）、以及面向科学领域的LLM评估方法。
AI.conclusion: CRITICS将通过整合LLM机器翻译、论证挖掘和自动批判性反馈生成，推动科学知识在多语言环境下的民主化传播。项目致力于在专业术语一致性、文档结构保留和多语言论证评估等方面超越现有技术水平，采用开源模型、合成数据生成和LLM-as-a-judge评估指标以确保结果可重现且透明。未来可扩展至更多低资源语言及多模态LLM集成，进一步扩大对全球科学教育的影响。

title: Hardware-Aware Learned Representation Compression for Distributed In-Sensor Vision
comment: Under submission at IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computing
summary: In-sensor computing reduces the cost of transmitting high-resolution image data by performing early-stage processing near the sensor. However, the logic chip integrated with a CMOS image sensor (CIS) is tightly constrained in compute and memory, limiting conventional deep neural network partitioning. We present OASIS, a distributed in-sensor vision framework that uses a lightweight encoder to generate compact, task-relevant representations before off-chip transmission. The encoder is trained end-to-end using task, entropy, and reconstruction objectives, while the decoder is used only during training. OASIS supports two complementary deployment paths. The first applies 4-bit quantization and Huffman coding while preserving the spatial structure required by classification and dense-prediction tasks. The second uses Sobol-based hyperdimensional computing (HDC) to transform the encoder latent into a fixed-dimensional binary hypervector for associative-memory classification. For the SwinViT-based VWW model, mapping a $3\times3\times8$ latent to a 64-dimensional hypervector provides an additional $1.77\times$ communication reduction with less than one percentage point of accuracy loss relative to the 128-dimensional configuration, yielding an overall $18{,}816\times$ reduction compared with raw 8-bit image transmission. We implement the digital near-sensor pipeline on an AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA and characterize it using direct board-level power measurements and Vivado post-implementation analysis, together with circuit-simulated CIS models and a 7-nm ASIC projection. Across visual wake-word classification, hand tracking, and eye tracking, OASIS reduces total system energy by approximately $2\times$-$4.5\times$ while maintaining competitive accuracy, demonstrating a practical hardware-algorithm co-design path for communication-efficient in-sensor vision.

AI.tldr: In-sensor computing reduces the cost of transmitting high-resolution image data by performing early-stage processing near the sensor. However, the logic chip integrated with a CMOS image sensor (CIS) is tightly constrained in compute and memory, limiting conventional deep neural network partitioning. We present OASIS, a distributed in-sensor vision framework that uses a lightweight encoder to generate compact, task-relevant representations before off-chip transmission. The encoder is trained end-to-end using task, entropy, and reconstruction objectives, while the decoder is used only during training. OASIS supports two complementary deployment paths. The first applies 4-bit quantization and Huffman coding while preserving the spatial structure required by classification and dense-prediction tasks. The second uses Sobol-based hyperdimensional computing (HDC) to transform the encoder latent into a fixed-dimensional binary hypervector for associative-memory classification. For the SwinViT-based VWW model, mapping a $3\times3\times8$ latent to a 64-dimensional hypervector provides an additional $1.77\times$ communication reduction with less than one percentage point of accuracy loss relative to the 128-dimensional configuration, yielding an overall $18{,}816\times$ reduction compared with raw 8-bit image transmission. We implement the digital near-sensor pipeline on an AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA and characterize it using direct board-level power measurements and Vivado post-implementation analysis, together with circuit-simulated CIS models and a 7-nm ASIC projection. Across visual wake-word classification, hand tracking, and eye tracking, OASIS reduces total system energy by approximately $2\times$-$4.5\times$ while maintaining competitive accuracy, demonstrating a practical hardware-algorithm co-design path for communication-efficient in-sensor vision.

title: Thought without systematicity? Evaluating reasoning models on rule induction tasks
comment: Code available at this https URL
summary: A central tenet of human cognition is systematicity, the principle that understanding one concept is inherently tied to understanding close variations of that concept. Do reasoning models robustly exhibit such systematicity? If so, we would expect consistent performance on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. Here, we extend established rule induction tasks from cognitive science to assess the systematicity of thought in current reasoning models. Each task family has compositional structure that we use to create structurally equivalent task variations through task isomorphisms such as recombination and substitution. We find that despite being able to correctly solve a task, models often fail on structurally equivalent variants of the same task. These findings suggest that many model behaviors lack systematicity, rendering it difficult to robustly establish the cognitive abilities of reasoning models beyond the particular contexts they were evaluated in.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地评估了当前主流推理模型（包括GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini系列）在四种规则归纳任务上的系统性（systematicity）。研究发现，尽管这些模型能够解决某些任务的某一变体，但它们常常在结构等价的变体任务上失败，暴露出显著的"系统性差距"。增加推理预算或消除采样噪声均无法消除此差距，表明问题根源在于模型缺乏对组合结构的真正理解。
AI.motivation: 人类认知的核心特征之一是系统性：理解一个概念意味着能理解其结构等价的变化。该研究旨在检验当前推理模型是否具备这种系统性——即能否在结构等价的任务变体上保持一致表现。缺乏系统性使得难以将模型在特定情境下的能力推广到更广泛的认知能力评估。
AI.method: 论文将认知科学中的四种经典规则归纳任务改编为可生成结构等价变体的组合任务族：(1) 基于语法的指令学习、(2) 符号版Raven渐进矩阵、(3) 整数序列上的程序归纳、(4) 布尔概念学习。通过任务同构（task isomorphism，包括符号替换、特征重绑定、成分置换、示例重排序）生成结构等价的任务变体，并定义了三个系统性度量指标：能否解决任一变体、解决变体的比例、能否解决所有变体。同时通过方差分解分离了任务内采样噪声与任务间变异方差，并使用零温度解码进一步验证。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 大多数模型在布尔概念学习任务上表现出完美系统性，但在其余三个任务族上存在显著的系统性差距（如Claude Opus 4.7在程序归纳任务上解决了91.67%的任务变体集合的至少一个变体，但仅在50.00%的集合上能解决全部变体，差距达41.67%）；(2) 增加推理预算（从低到高）并未一致地改善系统性；(3) 采样噪声只能部分解释系统性差距——使用贪心解码（零温度）后差距依然存在，表明问题源于模型推理本身而非采样随机性。
AI.conclusion: 当前推理模型缺乏严格的思维系统性。即便能解决某个任务，它们常常无法解决结构等价的变体。这揭示了推理模型认知能力评估中的测试有效性问题：缺乏系统性使得从单一情境的评估结果推广到更广泛的认知能力缺乏可靠依据。研究呼吁构建应比人类更具系统性的智能机器。

title: Mizan: A National Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi Civic Context
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Live leaderboard: this https URL
summary: Arabic large-language-model (LLM) evaluation has matured around Modern Standard Arabic (MSA): aggregated leaderboards such as the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard (OALL), HELM Arabic, and BALSAM rank models across dozens of MSA tasks, and frontier systems increasingly saturate them. Dialectal Arabic, the language Iraqis actually speak, remains nearly invisible to this infrastructure. We introduce Mizan ("the balance"), Iraq's national benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Iraqi Arabic and the Iraqi civic context: an MSA baseline track paired with an Iraqi track across six axes (dialect comprehension, dialect generation, bidirectional MSA-Iraqi translation, Iraq-specific knowledge, official-document field extraction, and safety), built from 340 originally authored, dually reviewed items with statistically audited answer positions and Wilson intervals on every published score. A pilot evaluation of 27 systems, spanning closed frontier models three days after release, open weights across size tiers, and an Arabic trio of commercial, open-specialized, and sovereign systems, yields four findings. The MSA track saturates while the Iraqi track discriminates, with a consistent 14-18-point per-model gap and statistically tied leaders. Official-document extraction confines every system to 32-56. Arabic-focused specialization behaves as MSA specialization: two dedicated Arabic models score below a size-matched generalist on the Iraqi track. And the safety-hardened tier of the newest model family deterministically refuses innocuous dialect-comprehension items as policy violations, an over-refusal mode invisible to MSA benchmarks. The platform enforces an integrity protocol of immutable snapshots, verification certificates, a human publication gate, and public retraction, all exercised during this study. Code and the public development set accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: Mizan 是伊拉克首个针对伊拉克阿拉伯语及伊拉克公民语境的大语言模型综合评测基准，采用 MSA 基线轨道与伊拉克轨道并行的双轨设计，沿六大评估轴（方言理解、方言生成、双向 MSA-伊拉克语翻译、伊拉克知识、官方公文字段提取、安全性）对 27 个系统进行评测，揭示了 MSA 轨道饱和、伊拉克轨道有效区分、官方公文提取普遍失败（32-56分）、阿拉伯语专项模型在方言能力上反不如同规模通用模型、以及前沿模型安全层对伊拉克方言词汇产生确定性过度拒绝等核心发现。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语大模型评测体系（OALL、HELM Arabic、BALSAM 等）几乎全部围绕现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）构建，已出现饱和现象；同时伊拉克阿拉伯语作为伊拉克数千万母语者的实际使用语言，及其独特的行政公文与社会语境，在当前评测基础设施中几乎完全缺席。该研究由伊拉克国家级团队主导，旨在为政府采购语言模型提供国家尺度的评测依据，填补方言与公民语境评测的空白。
AI.method: 构建包含 340 道原创（不译自外部基准）条目的题库，由母语者双重复审；六大评估轴（其中三项为多选题/抽取题自动评分，三项为生成题待人工评判）以 MSA 与伊拉克语双轨道运行；题目正确选项位置经卡方拟合优度检验平衡；每项分数附 Wilson 95% 置信区间；搭建独立离线评测运行器与公开排行榜平台，实施不可变快照、SHA-256 验证证书、人工发布门禁与公开撤回的完整性协议；按统一提示、相同计分与完成预算阶梯（2048→8192 token）在冻结题库上对 27 个系统进行两轮独立全量评测。
AI.result: 27 个系统的评测呈现四项核心规律：（1）MSA 轨道饱和（8 个系统满分 100，其余均压缩在 80 以上）而伊拉克轨道分数跨逾 23 点，每模型自身存在稳定的 14-18 点方言缺口，前两名在显示精度下并列且两轮互换排名；（2）官方公文字段提取将所有系统限制在 32-56 分区间，整体表现最强者并非综合榜首，新前沿模型仅获 53.7；（3）阿拉伯语专项模型（开源 SILMA-9B、主权 ALLaM-7B）在伊拉克轨道上反比同规模通用模型低约 10 分，专项化本质上等同于 MSA 专项化；（4）claude-fable-5 安全加固层对 7 道询问日常伊拉克词汇含义的题目产生确定性拒绝（停止原因标记为"refusal/cyber"），伊拉克理解项过度拒绝率 12%，MSA 轨道 0%，其他 26 个系统 0%。两轮独立评测平均绝对差异 0.5 分，差异均落在 Wilson 区间内。
AI.conclusion: Mizan 证明 MSA 评测已丧失区分力，伊拉克阿拉伯语及其公民语境是揭示当代大模型盲区的有效维度：方言能力是单纯规模扩展与 MSA 中心微调无法解决的数据问题；安全对齐若未覆盖方言分布，会将方言日常词汇误判为违规内容；官方公文阅读能力这一国家最迫切的需求恰是当前所有厂商均未达标、所有基准均未覆盖的能力；当前阿拉伯语专项模型生态存在访问通道缺失（统一 API 层不可达、发布量化产物不可用）的结构性基础设施问题。v1.0 将扩容至 1000+ 题、引入密封私有测试集、补充摩苏尔方言覆盖并完成生成轴人工评判。

title: GraMRAG: Orchestrating Multi-Agent Multi-Step Reasoning via Graph Memory with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Although existing multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have demonstrated promise on complex multimodal reasoning tasks, they remain fundamentally limited in reasoning depth and memory structure, suffering from inadequate retrieval and state blindness when answering knowledge-intensive questions. To address these limitations, we propose GraMRAG, a graph memory-guided multi-agent RAG framework that integrates a dynamic multimodal memory graph to enable stable, multi-step multimodal reasoning. We introduce a vision-text bridged reasoning paradigm that unifies multi-scale entity cropping with a ReAct-style visual toolchain, enhancing the long-horizon cross-modal reasoning capability. We further construct a multimodal memory graph that formalizes agent reasoning as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG), explicitly modeling action-observation dependencies to mitigate state blindness and suppress redundant retrieval. Moreover, we propose Topology-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO) that leverages graph topology for critical path identification and targeted node pruning, enabling fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step reasoning trajectories. Extensive experiments on challenging multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex long-horizon reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: GraMRAG是一个面向复杂多模态长链路推理的图记忆多智能体RAG框架，通过视觉-文本桥接推理范式、动态DAG多模态记忆图和拓扑感知策略优化（TAPO）三个核心创新，在多模态基准上取得了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体RAG系统在复杂多模态推理任务中存在三大局限：(1) 检索轮次有限，导致推理深度不足，难以支持数十步的迭代推理；(2) 线性记忆或迭代摘要式记忆结构缺乏对推理状态的显式建模，导致状态盲视和冗余检索；(3) 基于终态稀疏奖励的信用分配粒度过粗，无法区分有效检索步骤与冗余操作。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 视觉-文本桥接推理范式——Visual Explorer进行多尺度实体裁剪与ReAct风格视觉工具链检索，独立的Hit/No Hit Judge评估证据，Text Researcher基于桥接上下文进行文本推理；(2) 多模态记忆图——将推理过程形式化为动态DAG，包含根节点、视觉节点、桥接节点、文本节点和答案节点，显式编码动作-观察依赖；(3) 拓扑感知策略优化（TAPO）——正向轨迹中屏蔽拓扑死胡同节点的梯度贡献，反向轨迹中屏蔽有价值检索节点的梯度贡献，实现细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在涵盖通用文本（HotpotQA、SQuAD）、图像与视觉文档（ViDoSeek、SlideVQA、MMLongBench）、大规模长上下文视频语料（LVBench、WikiHowQA、SyntheticQA、XVBench）的9个基准测试中，基于Qwen3-VL-4B和8B的GraMRAG全面优于ReAct、Vanilla RAG、UniversalRAG、VideoRAG、MemAgent、Mem1和VimRAG等基线，8B版本平均得分达53.5%，消融实验证实三组件互补（基线43.8%→完整53.5%），且训练收敛速度优于GSPO。
AI.conclusion: GraMRAG通过图记忆结构化多智能体推理过程，结合拓扑感知信用分配，有效解决了多模态长链路推理中的深度不足、状态盲视和粗粒度优化问题，在多样化基准上取得SOTA。未来工作将探索更大规模架构与轻量化图记忆机制以降低推理开销。

title: To do($x$) or not to do($x$): Medical Image Counterfactuals for Dataset Augmentation
summary: Medical image analysis is often hindered by biased datasets, which can lead to biased models and limited clinical applicability. A promising strategy for mitigating such biases is to augment training data with synthetic images. Counterfactual (CF) generation is one such strategy, though the term is used in two different senses: in some works, CFs are produced through causality-based interventions derived from structural causal models, whereas in others, they are produced by non-causal image edits or conventional conditional generative models, such as altering anatomy or adding pathologies. In this work, we study this distinction and evaluate its practical consequences for medical image augmentation. We compare three conditioning strategies: $\textit{Deterministic}$, which changes selected variables while holding the remaining variables fixed; $\textit{Undirected}$, which updates variables according to learned statistical associations without assigning causal directions; and $\textit{Causal}$, which propagates interventions along a directed causal graph. We analyse how these choices affect the resulting images, and explore when causally grounded methods improve dataset augmentation or bring limited benefit. In particular, we assess downstream performance and fairness, where fairness refers to reduced sensitivity to dataset biases across sensitive subgroups. Our experiments demonstrate that using a causal approach to synthetic training data generation can lead to tangible benefits, with these insights offering valuable guidance to machine learning practitioners for the effective design of data generation protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了三种用于医学图像合成数据增强的条件生成策略（Deterministic、Undirected、Causal），通过Morpho-MNIST受控实验和CheXpert/MIMIC临床数据实验，揭示了因果建模在缓解偏差、改善公平性方面的实际价值与适用条件。
AI.motivation: 医学图像数据集常存在偏差（如性别与疾病的虚假相关），导致模型在临床部署中出现偏差和泛化能力受限。合成数据增强是缓解偏差的常用策略，但现有文献中"反事实"一词含义模糊——有的指基于结构因果模型（SCM）的因果干预，有的仅指非因果的图像编辑或条件生成。本文旨在厘清这一区别，并系统评估因果条件策略在数据增强中的实际收益。
AI.method: 作者将生成模型的条件策略分为三类：(1) Deterministic——设定目标变量值，其余变量固定；(2) Undirected——基于统计关联推断其余变量，不指定因果方向；(3) Causal——沿有向因果图传播干预（基于SCM的abduction-action-prediction）。同时区分两种图像生成方式：基于真实图像的反事实生成和潜空间直接采样。基于半监督因果层次VAE模型实现三种策略，并在Morpho-MNIST（已知数据生成过程，4种DAG）和CheXpert胸片（age→pleural effusion→lung volume的DAG）上分别验证。在CheXpert上通过人为注入性别-PE虚假相关偏差，评估不同条件下PE分类器的AUC和不同年龄子群的公平性差距，并扩展至MIMIC数据集测试分布外表现。
AI.result: 在Morpho-MNIST上：(1) Causal在所有正确指定的DAG上均表现最佳或与最佳无显著差异；(2) Deterministic因设计过于刚性，遗漏应传播的因果效应；(3) Undirected因双向传播，过度改变父变量；(4) 当因果图被错误指定（方向反转）时，Causal优势消失，性能与最差方法持平。在CheXpert上：(1) 所有增强方法均优于无增强基线；(2) 标签比例越低，Undirected和Causal相对Deterministic优势越明显；(3) 反事实图像质量更高（FID/MMD/SSIM/LPIPS均更优），而采样在低标签设置下多样性更高；(4) 在公平性方面，Deterministic和Causal能减少年龄相关的公平性差距，而Undirected因双向建模意外放大了PE与年龄在反因果方向的关联，反而加剧偏差；(5) MIMIC跨数据集测试中，Causal-CF取得最佳AUC (0.8967) 和F1 (0.6207)。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出以下核心结论：(1) 当因果图正确时，Causal条件在所有干预类型上表现稳健；(2) 因果建模带来的更强归纳偏置有助于在低标签和高度偏差场景下提升下游性能；(3) 反事实生成与潜空间采样之间存在质量-多样性权衡——高标签时反事实更优，低标签时采样更优；(4) Undirected的双向关联可能反向放大偏差，在涉及父变量的公平性考量时不如Deterministic或Causal；(5) 若因果图不确定，Deterministic或Undirected反而更稳妥。整体上，本文为设计合成数据生成协议提供了具体指导，证明了因果方法在适当条件下的实际价值。

title: LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents
comment: Accepted by the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI'26)
summary: As LLM agents become integrated into increasingly complex workflows, they must continually acquire new capabilities while retaining competence on previously learned tasks. Lifelong agents address this through experience replay, injecting past interactions into the prompt to leverage prior experience during inference. However, replay is not free: every replayed trajectory competes with retrieval, reasoning, tool use, and verification for the same limited prompt and compute budget, making effective resource allocation essential. Existing approaches allocate these resources using fixed replay policies, regardless of whether replay is beneficial for the current task. We identify this as inference-time memory allocation, a distinct problem class for lifelong agents, and introduce LIMBO: the first online framework to our knowledge that treats memory as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly optimizes memory strategy and inference budget for each incoming task. Unlike prior approaches that fix the replay policy or require model weights, teacher supervision, or offline retraining, LIMBO learns this allocation online in a single pass, explicitly balancing task performance and inference cost without modifying the underlying agent. Across three LLM backbones on LifelongAgentBench, LIMBO achieves better cost-accuracy tradeoffs than state-of-the-art memory-augmented baselines and nearly matches all strongest such baselines at up to ~83% lower inference cost (~53% on average). LIMBO adapts its policy across models and environments without retraining, demonstrating that effective allocation can be learned online rather than manually specified.

AI.tldr: LIMBO提出首个在线推理时记忆与算力联合分配框架，将终身LLM智能体中的经验回放从固定预处理转变为可控决策，通过双头LinUCB上下文老虎机为每个任务动态选择回放策略（无回放/完整/压缩/检索）和计算预算，无需模型权重、离线训练或教师监督。在LifelongAgentBench上跨3种LLM骨干（Qwen 2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、GPT-4o mini）和2种环境（DB、OS）的实验中，以最高约83%（平均约53%）的推理成本降低实现与最强记忆增强基线相当的准确率，并在不同模型/环境间自动学习差异化的回放策略。
AI.motivation: 终身LLM智能体依赖经验回放复用历史交互轨迹，但回放会与检索、推理、工具调用、验证竞争有限的提示和算力预算。现有方法使用固定回放策略，不论当前任务是否真正受益，造成成本-价值不匹配（例如Qwen2.5 7B在DBBench上将回放从k=8扩到k=16，成本增加1.7倍但精度仅提升0.35点）。本文将这一资源分配问题形式化为"推理时记忆分配"这一独立问题类别，挑战"固定回放策略+手动指定"的范式。
AI.method: LIMBO基于扩展LinUCB的双头参数化上下文老虎机：(1) 12维在线特征向量涵盖提示形状（prompt/user/system/scaffold的log归一化token数）、运行时状态（成本EMA、运行准确率、上次归一化成本）和上次结果（成功/错误指示符）；(2) 每个动作维护精度矩阵A_a∈R^{12×12}和两个参数向量（准确率头b_a^acc和成本头b_a^cost），前者经σ映射预测正确概率，后者经max(·,0)预测归一化期望成本；(3) 动作为{无回放/完整/压缩/检索}四种记忆模式×三档生成预算（≤512/768/≥1024 token）的笛卡尔积，检索评分为查询词、技能集、表标识的Jaccard加权和；(4) 选取规则score(a)=p̂_a - λĉ_a + α√(xᵀA_a⁻¹x)，λ=0.5平衡精度与成本；(5) 每任务后用Sherman-Morrison秩一更新维护A_a⁻¹；(6) 满足四个设计属性：黑盒兼容（D1，无需权重/梯度）、单遍在线学习（D2）、O(d²)=O(144)控制器开销<0.5ms（D3）、显式精度-成本权衡（D4）。在LifelongAgentBench（DB/OS各500任务）上评估三种骨干×两种环境共六组配置，对比基线包括无回放、固定k∈{1,4,8,16}回放、LongLLMLingua压缩、Group Self-Consistency。
AI.result: 六组配置下LIMBO均位于成本-精度Pareto前沿：Qwen DB 74.4%/$0.050 vs 固定k=16基线74.85%/$0.290（-82.8%成本）；Qwen OS 51.4%/$0.226 vs 固定trim k=1基线51.5%/$0.343（-34.1%）；Llama DB 66.2%/$0.144 vs 固定k=16基线70.0%/$0.316（-54.4%，但比无回放20.8%高45.4点）；Llama OS 43.0%/$0.224 vs 固定k=1基线44.4%/$0.304（-26.3%）；GPT-4o mini DB 67.4%/$0.292 vs LongLLMLingua 69.0%/$1.654（-82.3%）；GPT-4o mini OS 62.4%/$0.833，严格Pareto支配LongLLMLingua基线（+0.6点且-40.5%成本）。相同超参数在六组配置中学到显著不同的动作分布：Qwen DB和GPT DB约78%任务选无回放（低回放价值场景）；Llama DB约85%任务转检索回放以挽救20.8%的无回放崩塌（记忆必需场景）；Qwen OS采用约70%检索+约25%完整回放的混合策略；GPT OS约88%检索且成本仅比无回放高约6%。在线适应证据：Qwen OS上第一个50任务窗口无回放占17.3%，收敛后稳定在3.8%；UCB探索奖励从0.347降至0.115（-67%），交叉种子标准差<0.017。所有实验三种子（42/43/44）平均。
AI.conclusion: LIMBO验证了有效推理时记忆分配可在单遍在线流中习得，无需离线训练、模型权重访问或教师监督。它是终身智能体场景中首个将记忆视为可控推理时资源的框架，并同时联合优化记忆策略与推理预算。该工作建立了一类新的"推理时记忆分配"问题，指出针对固定骨干/环境的差异化回放策略存在显著收益，并指出改进记忆表示方法（如MemRL）可自然作为附加动作整合到LIMBO的动作空间中。未来工作包括成本结构直接消融、动作空间扩展及更复杂终身场景的验证。

title: Signatures of Steerability in Activation Space of Language Models
summary: Steering language models using a set of contrastive representations has been a canonical and computationally efficient method for controlling model behavior. Despite this success in controlling certain model behaviors, the effectiveness of activation steering varies markedly across concepts; the generalization properties of steering vectors are often considered a function of the dataset used to construct them. We make this dataset-dependence claim more rigorous and show that simple separation metrics strongly correlate with the downstream steerability of language models across diverse settings, even after controlling for layers and dataset effects. Beyond prediction, we provide evidence from a synthetic superposition experiment that separation metrics are strongly correlated with alignment between the empirical and true feature direction. Our results suggest that simple separability statistics can serve as practical diagnostics for when steering vectors are likely to work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现简单的激活空间分离度指标（特别是信噪比SNR）能强预测语言模型中对比激活添加（CAA）引导向量的下游可引导性，并在合成叠加实验中验证这些指标实质上追踪的是恢复方向与真实特征方向的对齐程度而非全局叠加几何。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（steering）是一种无需更新模型权重即可控制语言模型行为的有效方法，但其效果在不同概念、提示模板、数据集和干预层之间差异很大，且泛化能力通常被视为训练数据集的函数。本文旨在将"数据集依赖性"这一经验性观察严格化，探索是否存在某种激活分布的几何性质可预测引导效果，从而为判断引导向量何时有效提供实用诊断工具。
AI.method: 1. 数据集与模型：使用26个角色数据集（Perez et al. 2023）、5个真实性数据集（Ying et al. 2026）和7个安全性数据集（Zhang et al. 2024），覆盖Qwen、Gemma、Llama三个模型家族共6个指令调优模型（1B-4B及7B-14B参数规模）。2. 引导向量构建与可引导性度量：采用对比激活添加（CAA, Rimsky et al. 2024）方法构建引导向量μ，可引导性定义为引导强度λ与平均倾向性之间的最佳线性拟合斜率。3. 四种分离度指标：信噪比（SNR = ‖μ‖²/(Tr(Σ⁺)+Tr(Σ⁻))）、均值对齐（个体对比对与μ的余弦相似度均值）、流形容量（基于随机投影可分性的维度数）和内禀维度（Two-NN估计器）。4. 合成叠加实验：在已知真实特征方向v₀的受控设置中，系统变化字典相干性ϵ、活跃噪声特征数k和特征恢复度π，分析各分离度指标与这些结构性属性的关系。5. 偏相关分析：通过对层或数据集指示变量做线性残差化，控制混杂变量后计算偏相关。
AI.result: 1. 在真实LLM中：SNR是最佳预测指标，跨所有模型和数据集的Pearson/Spearman相关系数达0.69-0.82（r=0.76聚合）；均值对齐次之（0.63-0.82）；流形容量中等（0.47-0.76）；内禀维度最弱且在人格数据集上甚至出现符号翻转（-0.07至-0.29）。2. 控制混杂后：SNR在控制数据集（r=0.74）和控制层（r=0.74）后仍保持最强预测力；内禀维度在控制层后几乎消失（r=0.07）。3. 合成实验揭示机制：SNR与均值对齐与特征恢复度π强相关（ρ≈0.91和0.90），与活跃特征数k弱负相关（ρ=-0.33），与相干性ϵ几乎无关（ρ≈-0.01）；内禀维度呈现相反模式，与k正相关（ρ=0.37）但与π负相关（ρ=-0.42）。4. 验证：分组内相关分析确认SNR和均值对齐的恢复度关联在各配置中一致（组内中位数ρ≈0.92），而内禀维度的关联消失（中位数ρ≈0.006）。5. 层分析：分离度相关性最高的层通常接近模型最可引导的层（5/6模型在4层以内）。
AI.conclusion: 简单的分离度统计量（尤其是信噪比）可作为预测语言模型CAA引导向量下游效果的实用诊断工具。这些指标之所以有效，主要因为它们追踪的是恢复的引导方向与真实线性特征方向之间的对齐程度（特征恢复机制），而非全局叠加结构的几何属性。SNR在控制数据集和层效应后仍保持稳健的预测力，为实践中预判引导是否可行提供了低成本的几何探针。局限包括：仅验证CAA方法、相关分析非因果、仅测试多选格式且未评估流畅度退化，以及可能被滥用于对抗性操纵。

title: Towards Evolving Context Parameterization for Large Language Models
summary: Context parameterization enables large language models (LLMs) to internalize contexts into reusable model parameters, avoiding repeated processing across subsequent queries. However, existing methods typically assume static contexts and lack explicit mechanisms for distinguishing validity states under continual updates. To study this real-world scenario, we formalized the Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution (MUSE) task and constructed MUSE-bench to evaluate update incorporation and unaffected-information preservation. The resulting challenge requires preserving the global state while adjusting the contribution of memory evidence. Motivated by this, we proposed PLUME, a training-free method that constructs a global update representation, activates memory evidence to form a local parameter view, and adaptively integrates their predictions during decoding. Comprehensive evaluation on MUSE-bench demonstrated PLUME's effectiveness in sequential evolution settings, yielding relative improvements of 29.9% in average ROUGE-L Recall and 54.9% in LLM-as-a-Judge. Our codes are available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: This paper addresses context parameterization under continual updates in LLMs. It formalizes the MUSE (Memory Updating with Sequential Evolution) task, constructs MUSE-Bench (~3K contexts, 13K QA pairs across 5 datasets), and proposes PLUME—a training-free method combining a global update representation (integrating pre-update and full context LoRA adapters via D2L hypernetwork) with query-activated memory evidence, fused through adaptive decoding using JS divergence-based gating.
AI.motivation: Existing context parameterization methods (CD, D2L, knowledge editing) assume static contexts and lack mechanisms to handle continual updates where valid, and invalidated information coexist in parameterized states, leading to interference and unreliable responses in long-running agents.
AI.method: PLUME has three components: (1) Global Update Representation: parameterizes C_old and C_full via D2L hypernetwork, combines them as ΔW_g = α·ΔW_full + β(ΔW_full − ΔW_old) via LoRA factor concatenation; (2) Query-Activated Memory Evidence: lexical relevance scoring (BM25-style) with recency margin δ to select one memory unit, then parameterizes it separately; (3) Adaptive Decoding: computes JS divergence between global and evidence distributions at each step, uses λ_t = λ_max · d_t/(d_t+τ) to adaptively fuse log-probabilities during decoding.
AI.result: On MUSE-Bench (Qwen3-4B, Gemma-2-2B), PLUME improves average ROUGE-L Recall from 44.46 to 57.76 (+29.9%) and LLM-as-a-Judge from 34.49 to 53.41 (+54.9%) over D2L. Achieves best Locality among parameterized methods (+13.85% over D2L, +31.75% over CD). Generalizes to GSM8K (+95.8% Recall) and CRUXEval (+57.8% Recall). Ablations confirm complementary roles: removing global drops Recall by 24 points, removing memory drops by 17 points. Performance degrades only 2.09 points over 20 sequential updates.
AI.conclusion: The work demonstrates that context parameterization under continual updates requires distinguishing validity states while preserving unaffected information. PLUME's combination of global update amplification with query-specific evidence activation, gated by predictive divergence, provides a training-free solution that maintains efficient context reuse. Limitations include inheriting D2L's lossy compression and the lack of intrinsic update-awareness in the hypernetwork itself.

title: Entropy-Punctured Bloom Filters for Memory-Efficient Machine Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026). 9 pages, 7 figures
summary: Memory-efficient feature representations are increasingly important in machine learning settings where storage, transmission cost, bandwidth, or privacy constraints limit access to raw data. Bloom Filter (BF) encodings provide compact probabilistic representations of engineered features, but their behavior under structural compression and their applicability to regression tasks remain underexplored. In this work, we propose entropy-punctured Bloom Filters, a memory-aware encoding strategy that removes low-variability bit positions identified using empirical entropy. Starting from fixed-length BF encodings of quantized features, the proposed approach produces reduced representations that preserve predictive structure while improving predictive efficiency relative to encoded representation size. We evaluate the approach on diverse regression datasets, comparing raw features, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Random Projection (RP), and Bloom Filter variants under leakage-free evaluation protocols and approximately matched representation sizes. Performance is assessed using ridge regression, XGBoost, and neural networks, with predictive efficiency measured as R2 relative to encoded representation size per sample. Results show that Bloom Filter encodings remain competitive with classical compressed representations while achieving substantial storage savings. Entropy-based puncturing further reduces representation size with minimal loss in predictive fidelity, yielding improved predictive efficiency. These findings demonstrate that entropy-punctured Bloom Filters provide an effective representation-level compression approach for memory-constrained machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"熵穿刺布隆过滤器"（Entropy-Punctured Bloom Filters, PBF）的内存感知编码策略，用于机器学习中的回归任务。该方法通过移除基于经验熵识别出的低变异性比特位置，在保留预测结构的同时显著减少编码表示的大小。实验表明，PBF在保持与经典降维方法（如PCA、随机投影）相当预测性能的同时，显著提高了预测效率（每字节R²）。
AI.motivation: 在存储、传输、带宽或隐私约束限制访问原始数据的机器学习场景中，需要内存高效的特征表示。布隆过滤器（BF）编码可提供紧凑的概率表示，但其在结构压缩下的行为及在回归任务中的适用性尚未得到充分探索。此外，传统降维方法主要评估预测准确度，未能充分捕捉预测性能与表示大小之间的折衷。
AI.method: 1. 布隆过滤器特征编码：将分位数化后的特征通过k-哈希映射为固定长度的二进制向量表示。2. 熵穿刺：基于经验熵计算每个比特位置的边际熵Hj，移除熵低于阈值τ的低变异性比特位置，保留高变异性位置。该过程遵循无信息泄漏的评估协议（仅使用训练数据估计熵）。3. 评估指标：定义"预测效率"PE = R²/B（B为每样本编码字节数），用于衡量单位存储所保留的预测信号。4. 对比方法：与原始特征、PCA、随机投影（RP）以及标准特征哈希（FH）在近似匹配的表示大小下进行比较。5. 模型：使用岭回归、XGBoost和神经网络（MLP）。6. 数据集：涵盖表格、时间序列、生物医学和文本等多种模态的8个回归数据集。
AI.result: 1. 预测保真度：PBF在大多数数据集上保持与原始特征和经典压缩方法相当的R²性能。2. 预测效率：在8个数据集中的7个上，PBF实现了最高的预测效率（例如，Boston数据集从0.0082提升至0.0380；Parkinson's从0.0105提升至0.0720）。3. 结构鲁棒性：移除低熵比特比移除高熵或随机比特的损害更小；适度的熵穿刺（τ=0.15-0.35）可移除大量低变异性位置同时保持预测保真度。4. 折叠实验：OR折叠可将64字节压缩至32字节而几乎不损失R²。5. 与特征哈希对比：在存储匹配条件下，PBF在California Housing（R²=0.7622 vs 0.0844）和Parkinson's（R²=0.8830 vs 0.3654）上均显著优于标准有符号特征哈希。
AI.conclusion: 熵穿刺布隆过滤器提供了一种有效的表示级压缩方法，适用于内存受限的机器学习场景。该方法在保持预测保真度的同时显著减少了编码表示大小，在大多数评估的数据集上实现了优越的预测效率。熵作为标签独立的近常数比特位置指标，其指导下的结构压缩具有实用价值。但该方法也存在局限性：熵是边际的无监督度量而非与目标互信息的度量，低熵位置仍可能具有预测性。未来工作可探索有监督的比特选择准则、自适应参数选择及隐私敏感场景中的应用。

title: Data-free On-policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a standard component of frontier post-training pipelines, yet how much its training data actually contributes has gone largely unexamined. On the two teacher-student pairings most common in practice, we find OPD almost indifferent to its data: eight prompts already match a 17k-problem dataset, and three independently built datasets whose difficulty and teacher-student KL differ several-fold produce nearly indistinguishable training curves. Two causes account for this. First, the unit of data in OPD is the state a prompt leads to, not the prompt itself: a single prompt keeps exposing new teacher correction as sampling continues, while the marginal value of additional prompts collapses after eight. Second, replacing mathematics with competitive programming still recovers over ninety percent of the in-domain gain, indicating that OPD transfers the teacher's mode of reasoning rather than knowledge related to the data. We take this to its limit with Data-free On-policy Distillation (DF-OPD), in which the teacher writes its own training questions under a simple prompt -- no external data, no filtering -- leaving a system of just two policies. DF-OPD matches and even surpasses real data, and the questions it produces track the teacher's own post-training data on three key diagnostics of training dynamics, which other real datasets do not. Applied to multi-teacher distillation, where the (prompt, domain) pairs normally have to be derived from post-training data that is often out of reach, 1k self-generated questions close 98.5% of the available headroom, even surpassing the 96.6% reached with 7k real examples. Moreover, together these results invite a reassessment of the role data plays in OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示在线策略蒸馏（OPD）对训练数据极不敏感，并据此提出完全无需外部数据的DF-OPD（由教师自行出题），在单教师和多教师蒸馏设置下均匹配或超越真实数据。
AI.motivation: 尽管在线策略蒸馏（OPD）已成为前沿大模型后训练流水线的标准组件，但其训练数据的实际贡献从未被系统审视。实践中常面临两个难题：（1）预算应投向数据采集还是算法优化？（2）当教师权重可获取、但其后训练数据不可获取时，如何蒸馏？因此需要量化OPD对数据数量、难度、信息量的依赖程度，并探索能否完全摆脱外部数据。
AI.method: 在两类常见师生配对（RL微调教师 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B → JustRL-1.5B；同族大参数教师 Qwen3-1.7B → Qwen3-30B-A3B）上，沿数量（|D|=1/8/64/256/1k/17k）、难度/信息量（DAPO/DeepMath/ORZ/DeepCoder）三个轴扫描OPD训练曲线；定义"信号覆盖率"（signal coverage）衡量已访问状态暴露教师修正的比例；提出DF-OPD——教师按简单指令自出题、无种子、无检索、无过滤；并扩展到Open-MOPD的三领域（数学/代码/指令遵循）多教师蒸馏，由各领域教师自行生成带领域标签的提示。
AI.result: （1）8个提示即匹配17k数据集（RL配对56.3 vs 56.4；大参数配对49.9 vs 47.4），单个提示仍在3.6分以内；（2）DAPO/DeepMath/ORZ虽难度与师生KL差异达数倍，训练曲线几乎重合；（3）单问题信号覆盖率随采样预算从0.114升至0.507，每翻倍增加约0.04，但问题数从1增至8后边际贡献骤降约30倍；（4）用DeepCoder（编程题）替换数学训练数据仍保留92–96%的域内收益；（5）DF-OPD自生成题在RL配对达56.4–56.6，大参数配对48.6–49.5（均超真实数据）；（6）自生成题在top-k KL、top-k重叠、学生重叠质量三个训练动力学诊断上与教师后训练数据DAPO同组，而DeepMath/ORZ/DeepCoder均偏离；（7）多教师蒸馏中1k自生成题（仅真实数据13%）恢复98.5%上限，超过7k真实后训练例的96.6%，且数学与指令遵循均领先。
AI.conclusion: OPD对训练数据数量、难度、信息量均不敏感，根源在于：（1）在线策略采样+逐token密集监督使少量提示转化为大量监督信号；（2）OPD传递的是教师的推理模式，而非数据中的知识。这两点共同推动出DF-OPD——只需教师与学生两个策略，无需任何外部数据或过滤，单教师与多教师蒸馏均匹配或超越真实数据。该工作重新审视了数据在OPD中的角色。

title: ECAS: An Edge-Controlled Agentic System for Validation-Gated Scientific Application Execution
summary: Scientific applications increasingly rely on high-performance computing (HPC), yet translating a scientist's high-level goal into a correct target-scale execution remains brittle and labor-intensive. Large language model (LLM) agents promise to automate this, but two obstacles remain: granting a cloud-hosted model direct HPC access exposes credentials and execution authority, while withholding it demands continuous human supervision; and one-shot generation cannot adapt when generated artifacts fail in a site-specific HPC environment. We present \textsc{ECAS}, an \textbf{E}dge-\textbf{C}ontrolled \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{S}ystem for closed-loop execution of scientific computing campaigns with limited human intervention. \textsc{ECAS} separates \emph{reasoning}, \emph{control}, and \emph{execution}: a cloud-hosted LLM proposes plans, artifacts, and repairs; a user-controlled edge agent retains credentials, workflow state, and execution authority while enforcing policy and resource constraints; and the HPC system computes. Its core mechanism is \emph{validation-gated execution}: generated artifacts pass static checks and small-scale validation, failures trigger repairs from sanitized execution feedback, and target-scale execution is permitted only after validation and policy checks pass. \textsc{ECAS} also draws on an edge-resident library of expert-distilled, site-specific skills that is never disclosed to the cloud. In preliminary experiments with three scientific applications on two production ALCF systems under six injected fault types, closed-loop repair improves application success from 0/6 to 6/6 over one-shot generation, validation gating prevents all three observed target-scale failures, and skill conditioning improves success from 4/6 to 6/6. These results show the feasibility of delegating adaptive reasoning to the cloud while retaining execution control at the edge.

AI.tldr: ECAS(Edge-Controlled Agentic System)提出一种面向高性能计算(HPC)科学应用的智能体系统，通过将云端LLM推理、边缘设备控制和HPC执行三层分离，并采用验证门控(validation-gated)执行机制，实现从自然语言目标到目标规模HPC作业的闭环自动化执行，最小化人工干预。
AI.motivation: HPC科学应用的部署是"翻译问题"——将高层目标转换为系统特定的工件(源码、环境、启动命令、批处理脚本)易出错且劳动密集。虽然LLM智能体可自动化此过程，但存在两大障碍：(1)信任与可靠性问题——云端模型直接访问HPC会暴露凭据和执行权限，缺乏本地策略检查；(2)适应性障碍——一次性生成无法应对站点特定的运行时故障。
AI.method: ECAS采用三层架构：(1)云端(推理平面)——托管LLM提出计划、工件和修复，输出抽象诊断而非站点特定命令；(2)边缘(控制平面)——用户控制设备持有凭据、工作流状态、策略检查、日志清理和执行权限；(3)HPC(执行平面)——通过MCP/IRI执行作业。核心机制为验证门控执行：静态检查→小规模验证→基于清理后反馈的修复→策略门控通过后提升至目标规模。额外包含构建阶段的专家-在环技能构建方法：HPC专家离线处理代表性任务，每次修正被提炼为边缘私有的、可复用的"技能"(站点特定的过程性知识)，部署时通过检索相关技能来条件化生成与修复。
AI.result: 在ALCF的Crux和Sophia两套生产系统上，使用IOR、DLIO和E3SM-IO三种科学应用，在6种注入故障类型下的初步实验表明：(1)端到端可行性——三个工作负载均完成端到端执行，E3SM-IO在512进程目标规模达到1112 MiB/s聚合写入带宽；(2)闭环修复——一次性生成0/6故障解决，闭环修复提升至6/6(30/30次运行全部自主完成)；(3)验证门控——三种运行时故障下，直接提交在15/15次运行中产生4节点目标规模失败，验证门控将所有失败限制在1节点验证阶段，目标规模失败为0/15；(4)技能条件化——冷启动(空技能库)代理仅解决4/6故障(20/30)，技能条件化代理解决全部6/6(30/30)，将两个需站点特定知识的故障从不可解决转为自主修复。
AI.conclusion: ECAS证明了将自适应推理委托给云端、同时在边缘保留执行控制的可行性。凭据、状态、技能库和执行权限保留在用户控制的边缘，作业仅在验证通过后提升，为LLM驱动的HPC自动化提供凭据隔离和策略中介执行，同时减少浪费的节点小时数。构建阶段的专家-在环方法将站点专业知识一次性捕获为可复用技能，使部署循环自动运行，仅在真正新颖的故障时需要专家介入。作为研究原型，评估存在局限(两个相关系统、确定性故障注入、小规模)，完整评估正在进行中。

title: Graph-Transformer Fraud Detection with Self-Supervised Pretraining and Conformal Risk Control
summary: Financial fraud in corporate transaction networks has grown more coordinated and harder to detect with rule-based engines and with classical learning models that treat each transaction in isolation. This paper presents GTFD, a graph-transformer fraud detector that fuses structural and temporal evidence from a corporation's payment graph. GTFD encodes the graph with a multi-head graph attention network, encodes ordered transaction sequences with a gated transformer, and combines both views through a cross-modal gating layer. A conformal risk-control head converts the fused representation into threshold-free anomaly scores with finite-sample coverage guarantees, and the network is trained with self-supervised link-mask pretraining plus adversarial augmentation so it remains stable under scarce labels and under adversarial perturbation. On a corporate transaction benchmark enriched with coordinated fraud rings, GTFD reaches an AUROC of 0.990, an F1-score of 96.1% (precision 96.3%, recall 95.9%), and an accuracy of 98.4%. It reduces the false-positive rate by about 29% relative to the strongest baseline while raising coordinated fraud-ring recall from 85.1% to 96.5%. Ablations attribute roughly 2.0 AUROC points to self-supervised pretraining and 1.9 AUROC points to the conformal head, and adversarial stress tests show GTFD retains 89.2% accuracy at perturbation magnitude 0.20 where the next-best model falls to 76.4%.

AI.tldr: GTFD是一种面向企业交易网络中协同欺诈检测的图-Transformer混合模型，通过融合图注意力网络、门控Transformer和跨模态门控层，并结合保形风险控制和自监督预训练，实现了高准确率与强鲁棒性的欺诈检测。
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则引擎和经典学习模型的欺诈检测方法将每笔交易孤立看待，难以应对日益协同化、复杂化的企业交易网络欺诈行为，亟需融合结构与时序证据的新方法。
AI.method: 1. 使用多头图注意力网络（GAT）对企业支付图进行结构编码；2. 使用门控Transformer对有序交易序列进行时序编码；3. 通过跨模态门控层融合两种视图；4. 采用保形风险控制（conformal risk control）头输出无阈值异常分数并提供有限样本覆盖保证；5. 训练采用自监督链接掩码预训练与对抗增强。
AI.result: 在包含协同欺诈环的企业交易基准上，GTFD达到AUROC 0.990、F1分数96.1%（精确率96.3%、召回率95.9%）、准确率98.4%；相较最强基线，假阳性率降低约29%，协同欺诈环召回率从85.1%提升至96.5%；消融实验显示自监督预训练贡献约2.0个AUROC点，保形头贡献约1.9个AUROC点；在扰动幅度0.20的对抗压力测试下保持89.2%准确率，次优模型仅76.4%。
AI.conclusion: GTFD通过图结构与时序序列的跨模态融合，配合保形风险控制和自监督预训练，在企业交易欺诈检测中显著优于现有基线方法，尤其在协同欺诈环检测与对抗鲁棒性方面表现突出，为复杂金融欺诈检测提供了有效的解决方案。

title: OpWeave: Flexible Operator Disaggregation for Heterogeneous LLM Serving
comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, including references and appendices
summary: LLM serving systems increasingly disaggregate inference into finer-grained stages, with recent approaches separating attention from FFN or MoE execution during decode. This operator-level disaggregated serving (ODS) can improve hardware matching and enable independent scaling, particularly across heterogeneous devices. However, existing systems fix operator boundaries and lack a unified characterization of when disaggregation reduces serving cost. We present OpWeave, an end-to-end framework for heterogeneous ODS. OpWeave provides an analytical cost model that bounds the gains of homogeneous and heterogeneous ODS over colocated serving. It jointly optimizes operator partitioning and deployment configuration through a regularity-aware planner that keeps the search tractable even for hybrid-attention models. A vLLM-based runtime executes the synthesized plans with flexible operator stages across heterogeneous device groups. In our evaluation, OpWeave reduces serving cost by up to $1.78\times$ on homogeneous and $1.89\times$ on heterogeneous GPU clusters relative to the best feasible baseline, while meeting latency SLOs.

AI.tldr: OpWeave 提出了一套面向异构 GPU 的算子级解耦服务（ODS）端到端框架，通过解析成本模型、规则性感知的规划器以及基于 vLLM 的灵活运行时，在满足 TPOT SLO 的前提下显著降低大模型推理服务成本。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统在解码阶段将注意力与 FFN/MoE 算子共置部署，导致两类算子（内存带宽受限的注意力 vs. 计算密集的 GEMM）在硬件匹配上低效，且 KV 缓存与模型权重争夺显存限制了可服务的批大小；此外，现有固定边界（如 attention–FFN split）的 ODS 方案缺乏统一的理论刻画，且难以适应混合注意力（hybrid-attention）模型中层间结构的差异。
AI.method: 1) 建立解析成本模型，给出 colocation、homogeneous ODS、heterogeneous ODS 三种模式下每 token 成本的闭式表达，并证明同构与异构 ODS 相对共置部署的增益上界及单峰性；2) 提出 partition block 抽象与 regularity-aware 子块模板，将算子划分与设备组部署的组合搜索压缩到可处理规模；3) 构建网络安全的每 owner Pareto 前沿，并使用分支定界精确搜索最低成本满足 TPOT SLO 的方案；4) 基于 vLLM 实现分布式运行时，每个 rank 通过单次 native 提交完成整轮解码的计算与通信序列。
AI.result: 在 H100 同构集群上，OpWeave 相对最佳可行基线最高降低 1.78× 服务成本，pipeline stage 数从 124 降至 20.7，每输出 token 跨节点传输量最高减少 22.8×，计算占用率超过 80%（基线约 50%）；在 H100+L40S / H100+A100 异构集群上，最高相对非 OpWeave 基线降低 1.89×，相对同构 OpWeave 平均再降 14%，与理论上限 (1+√η)/2 的趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: OpWeave 首次将算子级解耦服务的理论、规划与执行打通：通过成本模型量化了 ODS 的适用条件与收益上限，通过规则性感知的精确规划在异构硬件上联合搜索最优算子切分、并行与批量配置，并通过低开销运行时落地；其抽象和结论为未来面向更异构模型与硬件的算子级解耦研究提供了基础。

title: The Attribution-Compression Frontier in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted to GroundLM 2026 Workshop at EMNLP
summary: Context compression reduces generator input in retrieval-augmented generation, but answer quality alone does not characterize citation attribution. We measure citation attribution across compression methods and budgets, comparing reranking, extractive selection, abstractive summarization, token pruning, and an extract-cluster-rewrite construction on ASQA and QASPER under a fixed generator and primary entailment evaluator. On ASQA at a nominal 0.25 budget (achieved compression 0.08), a RECOMP-style compressor's citations score 0.86 precision against its summaries but 0.12 against source spans under our re-attributability protocol. These estimates depend on a shared NLI model for span recovery and citation scoring and lack independent human calibration. Extractive selection's observed grounded precision ranges from 0.43 to 0.49 across nominal budgets from one-half to one-tenth of the ASQA context, while answer quality declines. For the same RECOMP setting, claim verification after source recovery yields an unsupported rate of 0.88 versus 0.17 when checking summaries. This gap persists beyond structural rejection of missing provenance, but remains evaluator-dependent. A 200-question TRUE T5-XXL audit also finds emitted--grounded gaps under both fixed and recomputed source mappings, without establishing human-calibrated support rates.

AI.tldr: 本文在ASQA与QASPER两个数据集、固定生成器（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和主评估器（DeBERTa-v3-base NLI）下，系统比较了六类上下文压缩方法在四个压缩预算上的引用归因表现。核心发现是"发出精度"（emitted precision，针对压缩文本）与"落地精度"（grounded precision，针对源片段）之间存在系统性、统计显著的巨大差距——以RECOMP为例，ASQA上发出精度0.86但落地精度仅0.12，作者将这种现象命名为"归因洗白"。同时定义了再归属协议、三种声明验证模式以及一种新的提取–聚类–重写（ECR）构造，并通过TRUE T5-XXL的第二评估器审计验证了主要结论的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统的评估多关注答案质量，但压缩后的上下文可能切断引用与源证据之间的可追溯链接。作者指出：当压缩器生成的摘要被当作可引用文档时，一致性可能被错误地等同于"有源证据支持"，他们将此称为"归因洗白"。本文旨在系统量化这一发散现象，跨压缩方法族、数据集与预算进行受控测量。
AI.method: 1）固定流水线：检索→压缩→生成→评估。生成器统一为Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（vLLM+贪心解码，ALCE风格编号引用提示）。2）六种压缩器：identity、重排序top-k、嵌入式抽取、RECOMP抽象摘要、LLMLingua-2词元剪枝、自研ECR（按Jaccard重叠贪心聚类近重复句并引用所有成员sid）。3）四种标称预算{0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05}，按生成器分词器词元度量；由于抽象压缩器常常远超预期压缩，所有图均以"实现压缩比"为横轴。4）双视角引用评估：发出精度Pe（针对压缩单元本身）与落地精度Pg（先通过声明或NLI+词汇检索恢复源片段再评分）。5）三种验证模式：摘要检查Um、声明片段检查Us（无声明者结构性为1.00）、恢复源检查Ur。6）数据集：ASQA（944题，文档级）+QASPER（976题来自271篇论文，段落级）。7）统计推断：944题/271篇逐点95%百分位置信区间+双侧随机化检验，Holm校正全部148个对比；附200题TRUE T5-XXL第二评估器审计。
AI.result: 1）发出-落地差距显著且持续：ASQA上RECOMP名义0.25（实现0.08）时Pe=0.86、Pg=0.12，差距0.740（95%CI[0.711,0.767]，pH=0.0148）；QASPER对应差距0.491。LLMLingua-2的Pg随预算收紧单调下降（ASQA：0.16→0.10→0.05→0.03）。2）抽取与重排序在不同预算下权衡精度与答案质量：ASQA抽取Pg在0.43–0.49间波动，str-EM从0.32单调降至0.15；重排在标称0.25时提升Pg从0.51到0.69但str-EM从0.34降至0.25。3）ECR优势有限：仅在QASPER标称0.50相对抽取提升Pg 0.063（pH=0.0148），其他差异不显著。4）声明验证结构性失败：无来源映射的方法Us恒为1.00；恢复源验证Ur对RECOMP在ASQA为0.88、QASPER为0.95，显著高于Um（0.17/0.50）。5）TRUE审计在100题/数据集上重现了所有16个发出-落地正差距（pH=0.0024），但跨评估器Pg差异未通过校正，不构成等价性验证。6）成本分析显示RECOMP总输入（含验证）最低为127词元，但其落地精度也最低。
AI.conclusion: 压缩显著削弱了引用归因：发出精度高估真实支持率，落差幅度随压缩强度扩大且依赖评估器。声明性来源信息是验证覆盖的关键决定因素。报告引用精度时应同时给出发出与落地两种视角、压缩比应使用实现值而非标称值，并应将验证成本纳入端到端评估。TRUE子样本印证了主要结论，但人类标定与跨模型族复现仍是必要的后续工作。本文的148个对比提供了完整的配对推断证据，但所有结论仍以单一生成器、单一主评估器与受界恢复流程为条件。

title: Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Temporal knowledge graph embedding (TKGE) models infer missing facts in knowledge graphs that evolve over time. Many existing models use a single geometric space, which can limit their ability to represent diverse relational patterns, or treat entity representations as static. We propose Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention (BSCA), a TKGE model that combines circular and hyperbolic rotations within a unified biquaternionic framework. A complex-valued attention mechanism adaptively fuses time-conditioned and relation-conditioned entity representations, allowing them to vary with temporal and relational context. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show competitive performance across datasets, with the largest improvement on GDELT: BSCA achieves an MRR of 52.1\%, compared with 38.1\% for the strongest baseline in our comparison.

AI.tldr: 提出BSCA模型,将双四元数空间与复数注意力结合用于时序知识图谱补全,在GDELT数据集上MRR提升约37%。
AI.motivation: 现有时序知识图谱嵌入(TKGE)方法存在两大局限:单一几何空间难以表示多样化的关系模式,以及将实体表示视为静态而无法捕捉实体语义随时间的变化。
AI.method: BSCA模型包含两大核心组件:(1)利用双四元数的Hamilton乘积,在统一代数框架中同时建模循环旋转、双曲旋转和缩放变换;(2)采用复数值注意力机制动态融合时间条件与关系条件的实体表示,使实体表示随时间戳和关系上下文变化。模型通过N3正则化、互逆学习(每个关系引入逆关系)和时间正则化进行训练。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集(ICEWS14、ICEWS05-15、GDELT、YAGO11k、Wikidata12k)上,BSCA在四个数据集的所有指标上取得最优,YAGO11k上Hits@3和Hits@10最优。最显著提升在GDELT:MRR达52.1%,相比最强基线TuckERTNT的38.1%提升约37%。模型参数量38.41M,ICEWS14训练时间9.5分钟。消融实验验证了各组件贡献。形式化证明显示模型可表示对称、非对称、逆和时序演化四种关系模式。
AI.conclusion: BSCA通过双四元数空间统一循环与双曲变换,并结合复数注意力实现上下文相关的实体表示,在时序知识图谱补全任务中取得了强性能与适中计算成本的良好平衡,支持对超复数表示在TKGE中进一步研究。

title: A latent dimension of Condorcet's jury theorem for multiple AI advisers
summary: When the same question is asked of multiple AI advisers, as in self-consistency and LLM-as-a-judge panels, Condorcet's jury theorem predicts that adding independent, competent advisers makes the majority more reliable. The theorem, however, has a latent dimension when viewed from the user's vantage: adding advisers also makes disagreement more visible.
