The extended analysis additionally examines generation-constraint adherence, participant-level characteristics, and exploratory LLM-based evaluations of haiku authorship. Overall, the findings suggest that as LLMs improve, surface-level creative plausibility may reduce reliable human discrimination within constrained poetic settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了六种不同LLM生成的日语俳句与人类俳句在作者归属和美学评估方面的差异，发现GPT-5等强模型的识别准确率接近随机水平，且审美评分主要预测"感知作者身份"而非"真实作者识别"。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在创意文本生成方面的能力提升，AI生成俳句与人类作品的区分变得日益困难。先前研究多关注质量评估或生成技术，较少同时比较多个现代模型、考察审美判断与正确作者归属之间的关系。本研究填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用few-shot prompting让6个LLM（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5、StableLM-7B、Gemma-2B、LLaMA-2、LLM-JP）为四个季节各生成3首俳句；混合12首人类获奖俳句后，向144名日本大学生发放问卷，要求判断作者身份并对七个美学维度评分。同时使用Grok作为探索性LLM评估者。采用正则化逻辑回归和贝叶斯广义线性混合模型分析数据。
AI.result: 识别准确率因模型而异：GPT-5(0.493)、Gemini 2.5(0.503)、StableLM-7B(0.524)接近随机水平；LLM-JP(0.590)、Gemma-2B(0.611)、LLaMA-2(0.670)具有中等可检测性。审美评分（流畅性、诗意等）能较强预测"感知作者身份"（AUC=0.793），但几乎不能预测"正确识别"（AUC=0.505），揭示了美学评估与真实作者检测之间的分离。Grok作为评判者也呈现类似模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现审美印象主要充当作者归属的启发式线索，而非真实来源的可靠诊断信号。随着LLM生成流畅且风格合理的俳句能力增强，表层创意合理性可能削弱人类的可靠辨别能力。人类评估在理解感知美学质量方面仍有价值，但仅凭审美判断可能越来越难以可靠识别创意作品的真实来源。

title: The Misery of Mechanistic Interpretability: A Formal Perspective
comment: Keywords: artificial intelligence; safety; interpretability; large language models; formal methods; verification; certification; robustness; sparse autoencoder; transcoder
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has become the dominant lens for understanding frontier language models, as their inner workings are complex and inherently black boxes. To gain insights into these models, interpretable replacement networks (IRNs) are trained at all layers, exposing interpretable features through sparsely activated neurons. However, the faithfulness of an IRN is usually evaluated only empirically on clean data, and we show that even semantically minor input perturbations flip the dominant IRN features-and thus the human-understandable interpretation-across five open-weight model families (GPT-2 small, Gemma 2 2B, Gemma 3 1B, Llama 3.2 1B, R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B). We propose the first formal verification framework for the faithfulness of an IRN, where reachability analysis certifies a sound upper bound of the faithfulness gap in adversarial scenarios. Moreover, we show that verification-aware training of IRNs substantially tightens this certified bound, restoring a feature-level interpretation that safety auditors can act on. Together, these results give, to the best of our knowledge, the first formal guarantees for mechanistic interpretability of large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了机制可解释性中可解释替代网络（IRN）在对抗扰动下的脆弱性，并提出了首个针对IRN忠实性的形式化验证框架，通过可达性分析给出忠实性差距的认证上界，同时验证感知训练可显著收紧该界。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性依赖IRN作为模型计算的稀疏、可解释替代，但IRN的忠实性通常仅在干净数据上经验性地评估，缺乏对对抗场景的鲁棒性保证。这种脆弱性会误导安全审计员（例如通过同义词替换使有害请求的判别特征翻转），构成可信部署的风险。
AI.method: 1) 在五个开源模型家族（GPT-2、Gemma 2 2B、Gemma 3 1B、Llama 3.2 1B、R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B）上，通过三级自然语言复述扰动（minor/medium/major）评估IRN主动特征的Jaccard重叠度；2) 构建形式化验证框架，将每个token的同义词嵌入凸包作为输入集，利用基于zonotope的可达性分析（CORA工具箱）计算MLP与IRN差异网络在ℓ∞范数下的认证上界δ̄，并给出top-K特征Jaccard的认证下界；3) 提出IRN分支的"一步前瞻"优化，折叠编码器-解码器矩阵以避免高维zonotope的显式构造，复杂度为O(d²ₘₒdₑₗₐ IRN)；4) 采用PGD对抗训练、基于可达集的Set训练以及LoRA微调等多种方案进行验证感知训练。
AI.result: 实验表明即使是微小的语义保留扰动也会大幅翻转IRN的主导特征：在major级别下，最差层的top-20 Jaccard重叠度下降高达95%；形式化验证揭示所有层的忠实性差距随层数加深而增大；验证感知训练（Set）可将认证上界δ̄降低约90%（相对误差体积约10⁻⁷⁷⁹），同时使IRN更稀疏（活跃特征减少81%）；但即使经过训练，仅2-3个top-20特征能被证明保留，因为底层模型本身对21%的minor复述就会改变其下一token预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了针对大语言模型机制可解释性的首个形式化忠实性保证，证实现有IRN在对抗场景下不可靠；所提出的可达性分析框架可扩展到不同激活函数（ReLU、JumpReLU、TopK）和模型规模；验证感知训练能显著缩小忠实性差距但无法完全闭合，部分原因在于底层模型自身的非鲁棒性；未来工作需将训练与验证协同设计的IRN架构，以及实现整模型的组合式验证。

title: Specifying Reward Functions for RL Without Environment Sampling
summary: Enabling human stakeholders to specify reward functions that lead to their desired outcomes is a key challenge in deploying reinforcement learning agents. Preference-based methods such as online RLHF can reduce the burden of manual reward design, but they require repeatedly training policies, sampling trajectories from the real world, and eliciting feedback, making them impractical in settings where environment interaction is computationally expensive or unsafe. We introduce Experience-Free Autonomous Reward Specification (EARS), a method for learning reward functions from preferences without environment interaction. Our approach uses a structured LLM-mediated process to construct a small set of expressive reward features from a task description and the environment observation space, then strategically samples imagined trajectories in this feature space and learns feature weights from preferences over the imagined trajectory pairs. We evaluate on three long-horizon domains: pandemic lockdown regulation design, insulin administration for diabetes patients, and autonomous vehicle control on a highway. We compare EARS to baselines that also enable reward specification without environment interaction--namely, methods that directly prompt an LLM to generate a reward function. When learning from either ground-truth preference labels or preferences labeled by a LLM, EARS designs reward functions that are more aligned with the ground truth reward function that produced the preferences or LLM context than these baselines. These results suggest that preference-based reward specification remains effective without environment sampling, enabling practical reward design in settings where collecting real trajectories is costly or infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EARS（Experience-Free Autonomous Reward Specification）方法，通过LLM设计奖励特征并在特征空间中采样"想象轨迹"，从偏好中学习奖励函数，无需与环境交互。在三个长视野领域上表现优于直接提示LLM生成奖励函数的方法。
AI.motivation: 在线RLHF需要反复训练策略、从真实环境采样轨迹并获取反馈，在环境交互计算昂贵或不安全的场景下（如机器人、昂贵物理仿真器）难以应用。论文旨在解决无需环境采样的奖励函数指定问题。
AI.method: EARS包含两阶段：（1）由"利益相关者LLM"和"协调者LLM"进行结构化对话，根据任务描述和观测空间设计少量可表达的奖励特征（Python函数）及推测的特征范围；（2）在特征空间中均匀采样"想象轨迹"，通过不确定性度量（ENN集成的方差/线性规划的边界差异）选择信息量最大的轨迹对，获取偏好后用Bradley-Terry交叉熵损失或线性规划学习线性权重。
AI.result: 在三个长视野领域（疫情管控、胰岛素给药、高速公路自动驾驶）的评估中，EARS从真实偏好或LLM标注偏好学习到的奖励函数比直接提示LLM生成奖励函数的基线更对齐于真实奖励函数，且匹配或优于使用真实轨迹偏好的离线RLHF基线。消融实验表明使用LLM设计特征空间优于直接使用原始观测空间。
AI.conclusion: EARS证明无需环境采样的基于偏好的奖励指定仍然有效，为环境交互成本高昂或不可行的场景提供了实用的奖励设计途径。未来工作包括人类利益相关者标注偏好的用户研究，以及探究人类应提供何种自然语言规范。

title: Don't Count the Edits, Judge by the Outcome Alone: Reward-Based Evaluation for Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Grammatical error correction (GEC) evaluation has traditionally relied on reference or edit overlap, which can penalize valid rewrites that differ from gold corrections. Reference-free metrics reduce this dependence, but evaluating whether a fluent output is a valid correction of the source remains challenging. We propose SURE, a source-conditioned reward evaluator trained on within-source preferences spanning minimal-edit and rewrite-oriented corrections. SURE jointly learns an overall reward with criteria-level supervision for grammaticality, faithfulness, and fluency, together with span-level grounding for source-side error resolution. Experiments on SEEDA show that SURE performs competitively against strong baselines, with particular gains on rewrite-style corrections and more disentangled criteria-level diagnostics. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出SURE，一种用于语法纠错（GEC）评估的源条件奖励评估器，通过联合学习整体奖励与语法性、忠实度、流利度等准则级监督及源端错误解决的片段级定位，在SEEDA基准上展现出与人类判断的强对齐，尤其在改写式纠错评估中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 传统基于参考或编辑重叠的GEC评估指标会惩罚与参考答案不同但合理的改写，且难以识别LLM产生的整体性改写是否构成对源句的有效纠正。作者旨在解决如何在不依赖参考的情况下，判断一个流畅的输出是否为源句的有效纠正。
AI.method: 1）合成偏好数据生成：从BEA-2019和JFLEG收集源句，构建包含人类参考答案、GEC系统输出及GPT-4o生成的最小编辑和改写式纠错的候选池，由GPT-4.1-mini、Claude Haiku 4.5和Grok 4.3三个LLM裁判进行偏好标注，仅保留完全一致同意的2,400个偏好对；2）奖励建模：以DeBERTa-v3-large+LoRA为编码器，联合优化配对排序损失、准则级排序损失（语法性、忠实度、流利度）和片段级二分类损失（源端错误是否被解决），推理时无需参考。
AI.result: 在SEEDA基准上，SURE在系统级和句子级均与人类判断保持强一致性，在+Fluency设置下表现尤为突出；在改写式纠错的成对比较中准确率最高（R–T: 73.3%/72.3%，R–R: 58.1%/58.3%）；准则级诊断显示语法性、忠实度、流利度之间的纠缠显著低于SOME；人类验证表明完全一致筛选策略显著提升了偏好标签的质量（p=0.027）。代价是引入改写数据后在传统GEC对上略有下降。
AI.conclusion: SURE通过源条件奖励建模将"纠正有效性"形式化为可学习的评估目标，在改写式纠错评估和准则级可解释性方面优于现有参考无关指标，但存在跨域校准不均、依赖LLM裁判标注偏差等局限，未来工作将扩展人类标注偏好数据、多语言场景及准则级奖励校准。

title: Self-Evolving Memory for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation has emerged as a promising end-to-end paradigm for personalized recommendation. However, user preferences continuously evolve over time, making self-evolving an essential capability for generative recommender systems. Existing evolving strategies, such as continual retraining and distillation-based adaptation, directly update the shared model parameters using streaming interactions. Nevertheless, we find that directly applying such strategies to generative recommendation introduces a critical issue, termed evolution conflict. Specifically, heterogeneous preference shifts from different users are optimized within a fully shared autoregressive parameter space, causing dominant behavioral patterns to progressively dominate the model evolution process while underrepresented patterns become increasingly overlooked. To address this issue, we propose a self-evolving memory paradigm for generative recommendation, aiming to enable effective evolution across heterogeneous behavioral patterns. We further identify three key principles for effective self-evolving recommendation systems, including isolated memorization, reinforced evolution, and scalable application. Guided by these principles, we develop LION, a simple yet effective framework centered on a sparse Key-Value memory layer. Specifically, LION introduces sparse memory activation to isolate the evolution of different behavioral patterns, while a consolidation loss is designed to reinforce the learning of underrepresented preference dynamics during continual adaptation. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LION under various continual evolution settings (e.g., per-period evaluation, user/item group evaluation, and evolution convergence analysis). The codes are released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对生成式推荐中的自演化（continual evolution）难题，本文提出了一种基于稀疏键值（KV）记忆层的新框架 LION，以解决异构行为模式在共享自回归参数空间中产生的"演化冲突"问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐（如 TIGER）通过统一的 Transformer 主干自回归生成物品 ID，但用户偏好随时间持续演化。现有的自演化策略（持续微调、蒸馏自适应等）直接更新共享参数，导致一个关键问题——"演化冲突"：不同用户的异构偏好漂移在共享参数空间内优化方向冲突，主流行为模式逐渐支配演化过程，而少数派模式被边缘化，造成弱势用户群体的推荐性能恶化。
AI.method: LION 是一个基于稀疏 KV 记忆层的生成式推荐自演化框架。其核心包含三大设计原则：1）隔离记忆（Isolated Memorization）：通过查询驱动的稀疏记忆激活机制（Top-K 选择），每个用户只激活部分记忆参数，使不同行为模式通过差异化路径演化；2）强化演化（Reinforced Evolution）：引入辅助监督损失（consolidation loss），直接对记忆增强表征施加监督，强化弱势模式的学习信号；3）可扩展应用（Scalable Application）：记忆参数为固定大小 2Nd，与用户数量无关，支持大规模部署。此外，框架使用全序列记忆查询（用完整历史做路由，仅用近期子序列驱动 Transformer 前向传播）。作者从理论上证明了 LION 能将梯度冲突严格限制在记忆激活的重叠区域，并加速收敛。
AI.result: 在 Amazon 三个真实数据集（Games、CDs、Toys）上的实验显示：1）整体性能：LION 在 Recall@10 和 NDCG@10 上显著优于 TIGER 等 7 个基线，相对 TIGER 在三个数据集上提升 15.6%–43.7%；2）用户分组表现：在非活跃用户组（G3–G5）的提升尤为显著，正好对应其设计目标；3）消融实验：稀疏记忆层、全序列查询、合并损失三者缺一不可，其中合并损失是关键驱动；4）梯度分析：LION 在所有周期上均实现活跃与非活跃用户梯度余弦为正（消除冲突），而 TIGER 存在显著负余弦；5）收敛性：LION 收敛更快且收敛损失更低；6）参数高效：在 16× 记忆大小压缩下性能波动仅 ±0.4%。
AI.conclusion: LION 成功解决了生成式推荐中自演化面临的演化冲突问题，通过稀疏 KV 记忆层实现行为模式的隔离演化，并通过合并损失强化弱势模式学习。理论分析与大量实验验证了其在异构用户群体上的有效性、可扩展性和持续性。未来可扩展至 LLM 架构、引入自适应路由、以及结合轻量级用户适配器作为互补机制。

title: Through the Eyes of the Beholder: Biometric and Demographic Conditioning for Multimodal Sexism Detection
summary: Detecting sexism on the internet is a fundamentally subjective task; our team, VANGUARD, addresses this challenge in the EXIST 2026 Task 2 by proposing a human-centered multimodal framework that analyses and incorporates the psychological and demographic characteristics of human annotators into the detection pipeline. We fuse five input modalities through a cross-attention architecture with Feature-wise Linear Modulation conditioning. Meme text is extracted and visually described with Gemma 4, then augmented by automatic translation between English and Spanish with NLLB-200. Text and image representations are produced by LoRAadapted XLM-RoBERTa and CLIP encoders and fused with sensor features encoded by a pretrained autoencoder. To model annotator subjectivity, we frame Subtask 2.1 as a label distribution learning problem, optimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence loss over the full annotator label distribution. At inference time, predictions are produced by soft-voting between the deep multimodal network and a complementary SVM trained on stylometric and physiological features. Our best submission ranks 29th out of 114 on Subtask 2.2 (source intention) under soft evaluation, and the normalized ICM scores remain above the baseline on Subtasks 2.1 and 2.2, indicating that annotator-centered conditioning contributes a usable signal. We release our full pipeline and analysis to support reproducible human-centered modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个以人为中心的多模态框架，用于EXIST 2026任务2的性别歧视检测。该方法将五种输入模态（VLM提取的嵌入文本、VLM生成的视觉描述、meme图像、标注者人口统计信息和生理传感器数据）通过跨注意力架构与FiLM条件化机制融合。子任务2.1被构建为标签分布学习问题，使用KL散度损失优化整个标注者标签分布。推理时，通过深度多模态网络与基于特征的SVM软投票结合。最佳结果在子任务2.2（来源意图）软评估下排名第29/114。
AI.motivation: 互联网meme中隐藏的性别歧视通常通过反讽和隐含的视觉含义表达，具有高度主观性。EXIST 2026任务2的核心挑战在于学习人类标注者的分歧而非强制单一标签，引入标注者的生理信号和人口统计特征使得以人为中心的建模方法成为可能。
AI.method: 系统采用多阶段流水线：(1)使用Gemma 4提取meme中的干净嵌入文本并生成结构化视觉描述；(2)使用NLLB-200进行英西跨语言翻译增强；(3)使用LoRA适配的XLM-RoBERTa和CLIP编码文本和图像，预训练自编码器编码传感器特征；(4)跨注意力融合多模态信息，FiLM条件化机制注入56维人类上下文向量；(5)KL散度损失优化标签分布，SupCon对比学习作为辅助损失；(6)推理时深度模型与SVM软投票集成。
AI.result: 在子任务2.2软评估下排名第29/114；在子任务2.1和2.2上ICM归一化分数均高于基线；五种子消融实验经Holm-Bonferroni校正后，没有任何单个组件（包括FiLM条件化）显示出统计上可检测的贡献；英语-西班牙语性能存在显著差距（测试集0.5496 vs 0.4306 ICM-Norm）；子任务2.3多标签分类因严重类别不平衡表现接近平凡基线。
AI.conclusion: 标注者生理和人口统计背景与meme性别歧视感知统计相关，将其纳入系统是有用的信号。系统最佳表现来自组件的整合而非任何单一模块，子任务2.3性能受限于多任务干扰而非架构设计。未来工作将探索个体级传感器建模、更大种子数和针对稀有类别的处理。

title: Multi-View Molecular Representation Learning with Hierarchical Graphs and Contextualized Fingerprints
comment: The paper has been accepted as a Full Research Paper at CIKM '26. Source code is available at this https URL
summary: Molecular property prediction requires representations that generalize from limited labeled data to structurally novel compounds. Existing molecular pretraining methods often rely on a single view: graph-based approaches model atom-bond topology but provide limited fragment-level supervision, whereas fingerprint descriptors encode chemical patterns but are typically used as fixed auxiliary features. We propose HiFi-Mol, a multi-view framework that separately pretrains a hierarchical graph encoder and a contextualized fingerprint encoder before downstream integration. The graph branch uses fragment-aware masking with multi-resolution supervision to capture substructure-aware representations, while the fingerprint branch tokenizes active entries from seven fingerprint families and applies masked language modeling to learn contextualized embeddings. During fine-tuning, HiFi-Mol combines projected multi-resolution graph features with fingerprint embeddings for downstream prediction. Evaluated on MoleculeNet benchmarks under the scaffold split, HiFi-Mol achieves a 2.77% improvement in average ROC-AUC over the best baseline across eight classification tasks while maintaining competitive performance on three regression tasks. Further analyses reveal that fragment-aware masking improves graph representation quality, and classification results demonstrate dataset-dependent strengths of the individual graph and fingerprint variants, confirming that the two views provide complementary predictive signals.

AI.tldr: HiFi-Mol 提出了一个多视图分子预训练框架，分别预训练层次化图编码器和上下文指纹编码器，在下游任务中融合两个视图的特征用于分子性质预测。
AI.motivation: 现有分子预训练方法通常依赖单一视图：图方法建模原子-键拓扑但缺乏片段级监督，而指纹描述符虽编码化学模式但通常仅作为静态辅助特征。两种视图的融合往往浅层且缺乏视图特定的预训练目标。
AI.method: 1) 图分支：构建包含原子、片段（BRICS+SSSR分解）和全局节点的层次化图，使用片段感知掩码（FAM）并通过共享的5层GINE编码器，以全局对比（InfoNCE）、片段ID预测、原子/键类型预测和距离预测等五个目标进行多分辨率预训练，采用不确定性加权平衡损失；2) 指纹分支：将7个指纹家族（ECFP4/6、FCFP4/6、ATOMPAIR、TOPTOR、MACCS）的活性条目与SMILES拼接为联合序列，用基于ChemFLM/ModernBERT的编码器进行掩码语言建模；3) 下游整合：分别提取多分辨率图特征（均值池化原子、最大池化片段、全局节点）和上下文指纹嵌入，投影拼接后输入任务预测头。
AI.result: 在MoleculeNet基准（scaffold split）上，HiFi-Mol在8个分类任务上的平均ROC-AUC达到76.15，相对最强基线MolCLR提升2.77%；在3个回归任务上保持竞争力（ESOL和FreeSolv第二）。消融实验表明FAM对图表示质量贡献最大（移除后平均-0.91），全局对比目标影响最大（-1.23）。单视图分析显示图变体在BBBP/Tox21/ToxCast/BACE上优，指纹变体在HIV/MUV/ClinTox/SIDER上优，证明互补性。FAM预训练使检索空间中ECFP4 Tanimoto相似度和Bemis-Murcko骨架匹配率均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 双视图分别预训练+下游融合的策略有效捕获了层次化拓扑与上下文描述符的互补信号；FAM和上下文指纹建模是提升分子表示质量的关键组件。未来工作将探索可扩展的跨视图交互机制以及等变3D分子建模的扩展。

title: FedLTLib: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Federated Long-Tail Learning
summary: Driven by the escalating demand for privacy-preserving computing, Federated Learning (FL) has witnessed remarkable progress, becoming a cornerstone technology for bridging distributed data silos in mobile edge networks. However, in real-world mobile computing environments, data is generated by heterogeneous mobile devices with varying user behaviors, leading to a significant Long-Tail Distribution. Unlike idealized balanced datasets, data in the wild manifests an acute imbalance where a minority of head classes dominate the sample space while a vast number of tail classes, often representing rare but critical edge-case events, are extremely scarce. This data heterogeneity, which we formally characterize as "Double Heterogeneity", referring to the superposition of global class imbalance and local statistical skew, precipitates severe performance deterioration on tail classes, thereby spurring the vital research direction of Federated Long-Tail Learning (FL-LT). To standardize evaluation and accelerate research in this field, we introduce FedLTLib, a comprehensive benchmark tailored for FL-LT. Addressing the critical issues of inconsistent experimental configurations and unfair comparisons in prior work, FedLTLib establishes a standardized evaluation framework. The platform not only incorporates diverse benchmark datasets reflecting mobile data characteristics but also implements 13 state-of-the-art FL algorithms (4 traditional FL algorithms and 9 FL-LT algorithms). By leveraging FedLTLib, researchers can perform fair and reproducible evaluations of algorithm robustness and generalization capabilities under a unified experimental protocol, ultimately advancing the deployment of robust intelligence in mobile computing ecosystems.

AI.tldr: FedLTLib是首个针对联邦长尾学习（FL-LT）的综合性基准测试框架，通过数学建模"双重异质性"（全局类别不平衡+局部统计偏斜），标准化了实验配置和评估协议，集成了13种SOTA算法（4种传统FL + 9种FL-LT），并在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny-ImageNet上提供了多维度（精度+系统效率）的公平可复现评估。
AI.motivation: 现实移动边缘网络中数据普遍呈现长尾分布，但当前FL-LT研究存在三大瓶颈：①实验场景定义不一致（全局长尾建模方式混乱）；②评估指标过于粗粒度（仅看Top-1整体准确率，掩盖尾部类性能崩塌）；③代码库碎片化导致复现困难。这阻碍了该领域的公平比较与实际部署。
AI.method: 1. **统一数学分类法**：用指数衰减参数ρ控制全局类别不平衡（IF = (1/ρ)^(K-1)），用Dirichlet参数α控制局部Non-IID偏斜，两者解耦定义三类场景（全局平衡+局部偏斜、全局不平衡+局部IID、双重长尾）。2. **模块化框架架构**：DataPartitioner + Federated Orchestration Engine + Algorithm Zoo三层解耦，支持即插即用扩展。3. **多维评估协议**：采用Many/Medium/Few-shot分层准确率，并引入通信开销和VRAM/CPU内存的硬件级profile。4. **算法动物园**：集成FedAvg/Prox/MOON/FedLC 4种基线，及CReFF/CCVR/FedETF/RUCR/CLIP2FL/FedLoGe/FedIC/FedGraB/FedYoYo 9种FL-LT算法。
AI.result: 在Scenario C（IF∈{10,50,100}，α=0.5）下的实验揭示了四大关键发现：①**CReFF等虚拟特征重训练方法在极端双重异质性下严重失效**（CIFAR-100 IF=100时仅34.09%，低于FedAvg的40.60%），原因是局部统计量严重不足导致分布偏移；②**FedETF因固定几何先验表现出极强的稳定性**，VRAM仅85.86 MB；③**FedGraB/FedLoGe等平衡增强方法存在"局部-全局公平性冲突"**——以牺牲本地多数类客户端利益换取全局尾部提升，VRAM高达2.61 GB/1.77 GB；④**自举蒸馏方法（FedYoYo）实现最优帕累托均衡**，CIFAR-100 IF=100下达52.82%全局准确率和26.4%尾部准确率，VRAM仅234.74 MB。t-SNE可视化证实FedIC有效防止特征坍缩。
AI.conclusion: FedLTLib填补了FL-LT标准化基准的空白，揭示了传统FL方法通过牺牲尾部类换取虚假整体精度的根本缺陷。未来研究方向包括：①面向边缘设备的轻量级FL-LT（PEFT、无通信logit调整）；②隐私保护型尾部增强（差分隐私下的长尾学习）；③利用CLIP等基础模型进行联邦提示调优以应对极端数据偏斜。

title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
summary: Amid the rapid advancement of physical-world intelligence, cloud-edge collaborative large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising roadmap for practical LLM deployment. However, existing cloud-edge paradigms struggle to balance global consensus with local personalization, which fails to satisfy the need for a unified knowledge foundation on the cloud and domain-specific adaptation at the edge. To address this, we introduce, for the first time, a personalized bilevel optimization framework that formalizes cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a dual structure: the upper level optimizes edge-side personalization, while the lower level governs cloud-side knowledge transfer, reaching cloud-edge evolving in coordination. We then propose CIDERS, an efficient solver that decomposes the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger. While the cloud performs knowledge transfer to the learnable backbone, the key lies in embedding global trajectories into each local personalization step via consensus-variate correction to reconcile personalization with consensus. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis, including a geometric characterization of the local trajectory and a full convergence guarantee, revealing an explicit trade-off structure between personalization and global convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CIDERS consistently outperforms competitive baselines on the compressed edge path, with 3.1x and 1.7x gains on mathematical reasoning and code generation, respectively, and a 10\% relative gain on instruction metrics. Mechanism experiments attribute these gains to early consensus-corrected coordination and task-aware distillation. Overall, CIDERS offers a viable path toward consensus-guided continuous personalization in cloud-edge LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIDERS框架，针对云-边协同大语言模型部署中全局共识与本地个性化难以平衡的问题，首次将云边协作建模为个性化双层优化（上层优化边端个性化messenger，下层进行云端知识蒸馏），并通过共识变量校正将全局轨迹嵌入到每一步本地个性化更新中。在Qwen2.5-3B/1.5B上的实验表明，在压缩边端路径上数学推理提升3.1×、代码生成提升1.7×，指令指标相对提升10%。
AI.motivation: 现有云-边LLM范式固守模型共识原则，忽略了边缘场景中数据、用户行为和物理环境的天然个性化特性，导致模型参数调整能力分散在云端与边缘之间，无法同时满足统一知识基础与领域特定适应的需求。物理世界智能（如自动驾驶、工业机器人闭环控制）对低延迟、数据隐私和实时性提出了硬性要求，使云-边协作成为架构性必然。
AI.method: 方法包含三大模块：(1) 模型分解——将LLM分为云端冻结全骨干ℬ_F、本地可学习压缩骨干ℬ_L和客户端个性化messenger 𝒫_M；(2) 个性化双层优化(PBO)——上层优化messenger实现快速客户端适应，下层通过任务感知知识蒸馏(TAKD)对齐可学习骨干与下游任务；(3) 共识变量校正几何更新——客户端维护本地共识变量c_i，通过γ参数调节将全局轨迹注入本地个性化步骤，云端仅传输压缩的共识增量Δc_i以实现精确的本地位移重建。算法提供FO（一阶）和FD（有限差分Hessian-向量积）两种求解器。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-3B/1.5B上的三个互补协议实验中，CIDERS-FO在6个指标中均领先FedBiOT、FedOT和LocalOT：GSM8K精度领先5.30–11.15个百分点，Dolly PPL降低约8.7%，HumanEval-X三种语言pass@1提升2.4–4.3个百分点；压缩后6层messenger在NLL上比FedBiOT低9.9–22.2%。理论分析证明在η=O(T^{-1/2})步长下，联合目标差距以O(T^{-1/2})次线性速率收敛到稳定邻域，参考方向几何上位于本地梯度与全局共识方向的连线段上，权重ψ_t=(1-γ)+γ(1-α)^t。
AI.conclusion: CIDERS首次为云-边LLM系统提供了完整的个性化双层优化理论框架和高效求解器，通过共识变量校正机制成功协调全局共识与本地个性化，实验证明该方法在压缩部署路径下显著优于现有联邦微调基线。然而，FD相对FO无一致优势，AdapEmu与全骨干AdapFu之间仍存在显著能力差距，跨域个性化匹配优势较小但绝对响应质量更优。未来工作将扩展至具身智能与世界模型。

title: Scalability and Performance Evaluation of Federated Learning Frameworks: A Comparative Analysis
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables, published in International Journal of Machine Learning and Cybernetics, this version is largely before peer review revisions
summary: This paper presents a systematic examination and experimental comparison of the prominent Federated Learning (FL) frameworks FedML, Flower, Substra, and OpenFL. The frameworks are evaluated experimentally by implementing Federated Learning over a varying number of clients, emphasizing a thorough analysis of scalability and key performance metrics. The study assesses the impact of increasing client counts on total training time, loss and accuracy values, and CPU and RAM usage. Results indicate distinct performance characteristics among the frameworks, with Flower displaying an unusually high loss, FedML achieving a notably low accuracy range of 66% to 79%, and Substra demonstrating good resource efficiency, albeit with an exponential growth in total training time. Notably, OpenFL emerges as the most scalable platform, demonstrating consistent accuracy, loss, and training time across different client counts. OpenFL's stable CPU and RAM underscore its reliability in real-world scenarios. This comprehensive analysis provides valuable insights into the relative performance of FL frameworks, offering good understanding of their capabilities and providing guidance for their effective deployment across diverse user bases.

AI.tldr: 本文对四个主流联邦学习框架（FedML、Flower、Substra、OpenFL）进行了系统的实验比较，重点评估了它们在不同客户端数量下的可扩展性和关键性能指标（训练时间、损失、准确率、CPU和RAM使用情况）。OpenFL在可扩展性方面表现最佳，Substra资源效率高但训练时间呈指数增长，Flower损失异常偏高，FedML准确率偏低。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习领域存在多种开源框架，但缺乏对它们在可扩展性和实际性能方面的系统性比较。随着FL应用场景的扩展，框架在不同规模下的表现对实际部署至关重要，因此需要为研究者和从业者提供选型指导。
AI.method: 对FedML、Flower、Substra和OpenFL四个FL框架进行实验性比较，通过改变客户端数量进行联邦学习训练，重点分析以下指标：(1) 总训练时间；(2) 损失值与准确率；(3) CPU和RAM资源使用情况。从可扩展性角度评估各框架在不同客户端规模下的性能特征。
AI.result: Flower显示异常高的损失值；FedML准确率范围较低（66%-79%）；Substra资源效率良好，但总训练时间随客户端数增加呈指数增长；OpenFL在所有客户端规模下均表现出稳定的准确率、损失和训练时间，CPU和RAM使用也保持稳定，可扩展性最佳。
AI.conclusion: OpenFL是最具可扩展性的FL平台，在不同客户端数量下保持稳定的性能指标，适合实际部署场景；Substra在资源效率方面表现优异但存在训练时间的可扩展性瓶颈；各框架在性能特征上差异显著。本研究为FL框架的选型和实际部署提供了有价值的参考依据。

title: A Language-Guided Multimodal Foundation Model for Zero-Shot and Multi-Task Brain Signal Analysis
comment: 38 pages, 7 main figures and 20 supplementary figures; includes Supporting Information. Code: this https URL
summary: Brain signal analysis is essential for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnostics, yet current approaches face critical limitations. End-to-end models require task-specific retraining and exhibit limited generalization, while pre-trained models lack semantic depth and still depend on extensive fine-tuning. Meanwhile, general-purpose multimodal foundation models, though powerful in other domains, struggle to interpret brain signals due to representational misalignment and lack of domain knowledge. This study introduces a multimodal foundation model for zero-shot and multi-task brain signal analysis (METIS) through a unified language-signal alignment framework. METIS is pretrained on the largest and most diverse brain-signal corpus to date, comprising over 70,000 h of recordings from more than 11,000 subjects across 20 datasets. In a comprehensive zero-shot evaluation across 12 datasets, METIS outperformed the leading generalist model by over 20.9% in average accuracy. Remarkably, without any fine-tuning, METIS's performance matches or exceeds that of supervised, task-specific models. Furthermore, METIS demonstrates exceptional data efficiency and strong generalization, achieving an average AUROC advantage of over 16.0% in few-shot settings and 15.9% in cross-dataset transfer. This work establishes a new paradigm for general-purpose brain signal analysis, paving the way for next-generation neurotechnology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了METIS，一个基于语言-信号对齐的多模态基础模型，用于零样本和多任务脑信号分析。METIS在迄今最大、最多样化的脑信号语料库（超70,000小时、11,000+受试者、20个数据集）上进行预训练，通过统一的指令驱动生成框架实现跨任务、跨数据集的泛化，在零样本、少样本和跨数据集迁移任务中均显著优于现有端到端模型、预训练模型以及通用多模态基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有脑信号分析方法存在三大局限：1）端到端模型需要任务特定重训练，泛化性差；2）预训练模型缺乏语义深度，仍需大量微调；3）通用多模态基础模型因表征错配和缺乏领域知识而无法有效解读脑信号。本文旨在构建一个能够同时实现零样本推理、多任务处理和跨域泛化的大脑信号通用基础模型。
AI.method: METIS采用统一的解码器-Transformer架构，将脑信号分析建模为信号-问题回答任务。核心组件包括：1）通用信号编码器：将异构EEG/iEEG信号通过Z-score归一化、短时傅里叶变换和卷积嵌入转化为统一的token序列，并结合跨通道多头自注意力进行特征融合；2）多模态Transformer骨干：采用分组查询注意力（GQA）和稀疏激活的混合专家（MoE）模块（8个路由专家+1个共享专家，top-k=2路由策略），实现高效自适应计算；3）混合注意力掩码：信号token之间采用双向注意力，文本token之间采用因果注意力，文本对信号完全可见；4）模态感知旋转位置编码：为信号和文本分配不同的基频以减少跨模态注意力泄漏。预训练目标为信号条件下的自回归生成损失与MoE负载均衡损失的加权和（λ=0.001）。在12个零样本数据集和14个少样本数据集上进行系统评估。
AI.result: METIS在多个维度表现出色：1）零样本评估：在12个数据集上平均AUROC达75.5%，平均准确率超过最佳通用多模态基础模型（ChatGPT/Gemini/Grok/DeepSeek）20.9%以上，且无微调即可匹配或超越监督任务特定模型；2）少样本分类（线性探测）：在1/2/4/8-shot设置下均优于BIOT、LaBraM、CBraMod等预训练基线，平均AUROC优势超16%；3）跨数据集迁移（8个设置）：平均AUROC优势达15.9%，t-SNE可视化显示其表征在不同数据集间保持拓扑一致性；4）关键任务表现：睡眠分期ISRUC（94.1%）、Dreams（92.9%）、IED检测Mayo（93.5%）、阿尔茨海默ADFSU（74.6%）、跨物种癫痫RatEpilepsy（63.2%）、ADHD（72.4%）等；5）消融实验：MoE模块带来7.49个百分点AUROC平均增益（参数匹配对比）；EEG+iEEG联合预训练显著优于单模态预训练；数据规模从0%到100%带来26.5个百分点的性能提升；指令质量消融显示高质量任务指令带来9.50pp增益；提示词和标签改写分别仅带来2.49pp和3.15pp的轻微性能下降。
AI.conclusion: METIS标志着脑信号分析从"专用工具"到"通用助手"的范式转变，通过语言引导的因果建模范式与大规模预训练，将异构脑信号映射到统一语言-信号联合空间。其混合专家架构、混合注意力机制和大规模多模态预训练的组合，能够显著降低临床标注成本，将模型部署时间从数月缩短至数小时。该框架不仅为脑信号分析提供了通用蓝图，还可拓展至ECG、EMG等其他生理信号甚至基因组学数据，为下一代神经技术和个性化神经病学奠定基础。

title: Look Before You Leap: Factual Decoding with Internal Attribution Signals
summary: Hallucination remains a critical challenge in large language models (LLMs), where early factual errors compound through autoregressive generation in a snowballing effect that neither post-hoc correction nor weight-level intervention can effectively preempt. We propose DescaPE (DEcoding Signal Control Against Path Error-snowballing), a decoding framework that leverages internal model signals to suppress hallucination-prone trajectories at inference time. Through sliding-window MLP ablation, we identify a factual-salient layer span within LLMs whose derived signal is selectively elevated for factual tokens and exhibits anomalous spikes at hallucination-prone steps. We train a lightweight probe to approximate this signal from a single forward pass and integrate it into candidate scoring to penalize high-risk continuations while rewarding factually grounded ones. Experiments across five factuality benchmarks on three LLMs demonstrate that DescaPE achieves factuality improvements over decoding-time baselines in multiple settings, while incurring only 1.10x latency overhead in our efficiency evaluation. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出DescaPE，一种基于LLM内部事实归因信号的解码框架，通过滑动窗口MLP消融定位事实显著层段，利用轻量探针近似该信号，并在候选评分中引入风险惩罚和事实奖励，以预防式抑制幻觉轨迹。在5个事实性基准、3个LLM上验证有效，仅带来1.10倍延迟开销。
AI.motivation: LLM幻觉问题中，早期事实错误在自回归生成中会滚雪球式放大，事后修正和权重干预均难以预防。现有解码时干预方法存在三类局限：内部引导法对已启动的幻觉轨迹补救有限；外部验证法引入分布失配和推理开销；自验证法受限于生成器自身的分布空间。核心问题是：是否存在一种独立于最终输出分布的内部事实信号，能在解码时预防幻觉。
AI.method: 1) 滑动窗口MLP消融定位"事实显著层段"（Llama第12-18层、Mistral第20-26层、Qwen第12-18层），通过对比消融前后目标token的对数概率差（Factual Attribution Score Δ(w)）量化各层段贡献。2) 提取事实归因信号δ_t：事实token上信号显著升高，功能词上接近零；幻觉token出现异常尖峰。3) 训练三层MLP轻量探针f_φ，以单次前向传播的隐藏状态拼接候选token嵌入为输入，采用加权Huber损失拟合δ_t^{real}。4) 信号集成波束评分：引入风险惩罚P_risk（信号超过阈值τ时惩罚）和事实奖励B_fact（信号处于事实区间时奖励），与LM对数概率组合指导波束选择，保留长度归一化和早停机制。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA、FreshQA、FActScore、NQ、TriviaQA五个基准上，DescaPE在三个模型上均改善了开放式事实QA和长文本生成效果：TruthfulQA T*I指标在三个模型上均最优，Llama-3.1的FActScore达67.20（远超基线）。延迟开销仅1.10倍（对比Self-Refine的7.24倍和END的1.83倍）。消融实验证实风险惩罚与事实奖励互补，探针在安全区和风险区的区域一致率分别为75.8%和69.6%，风险误判率低于6%。在HotpotQA上验证了对多跳推理的保留能力（答案保留率84.62%）。短答案QA在标准EM/F1下增益较有限，SoftEM指标和Gold Preservation（97.91%-99.87%）分析表明这主要源于响应格式与严格词匹配敏感性，而非事实性退化。
AI.conclusion: DescaPE证明了LLM中间层蕴含可独立于最终输出分布的事实信号，为解码时预防幻觉提供了新路径。事实显著层段的归因信号能有效识别幻觉高风险步骤，轻量探针使其可实时部署且不修改模型参数或依赖外部验证器。该方法在事实性关键场景中展现了性能与效率的良好平衡，但存在依赖离线消融识别层段、探针token级精度有限、对短答案严格指标增益不均、未区分知识缺失与解码失败等局限，未来需探索跨步逻辑一致性建模与知识缺失检测。

title: Sylvas: Synergistic Learning Value based Device Scheduling in Federated Continual Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Federated continual learning (FCL) enables shared global models to continuously adapt to distributed and non-stationary data streams, making it important for Internet of Things applications such as intelligent transportation, industrial monitoring, and unmanned systems. Under spatio-temporal data distribution dynamics and label scarcity, a key challenge is how to quantify the contribution of each edge device to global learning performance and schedule the most valuable devices under resource constraints for timely model updating. This article presents Sylvas, a synergistic learning value based device scheduling framework for FCL at the wireless edge. Sylvas evaluates the learning value of distributed data from two perspectives: distributional value, which characterizes the contribution of device data to global model learning from a spatio-temporal distribution perspective, and label value, which captures the quantity and reliability tradeoff of pseudo-labeled data. By integrating these factors into a synergistic learning value metric, Sylvas schedules devices with high learning value while satisfying communication and computation resource constraints. Case studies demonstrate that Sylvas supports timely model adaptation under spatio-temporal distribution dynamics and effectively exploits unlabeled data.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无线边缘场景下的联邦持续学习（FCL）提出了一种基于协同学习价值的设备调度框架Sylvas，通过联合衡量设备数据的分布价值与标签价值，在通信与计算资源约束下选择高价值设备以实现及时模型更新。
AI.motivation: 联邦持续学习在物联网应用中面临两个核心挑战：一是时空数据分布动态变化使得难以量化各边缘设备对全局学习的贡献；二是持续到达的数据多无标注，伪标签的可靠性难以保证。在资源受限条件下，如何调度最有价值的设备以实现及时模型更新成为关键难题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：（1）分布价值：结合集体散度（衡量被调度设备组对全局数据分布的代表性）与时间漂移（衡量设备当前数据与历史数据的分布变化），采用时变权重在训练早期侧重时间漂移以快速适应新数据，后期侧重集体散度以提升全局代表性；（2）标签价值：通过置信度阈值过滤伪标签，并衡量伪标签数量与可靠性的权衡，对新引入类别采用渐进式宽松阈值策略，对已学习类别采用严格阈值；（3）资源约束调度：将协同学习价值与设备计算和通信成本结合，通过固定总和坐标下降法和贪心策略求解组合优化问题，选择满足延迟预算的高价值设备组。
AI.result: 在全标注类增量场景（CIFAR-100，30设备，ResNet-18）中，Sylvas相比随机调度、最优信道、FedCBS、FedCGD、纯漂移等基线方法，在分布变化后能更快恢复并保持更稳定的性能；在半监督场景（SVHN，30设备，仅少量服务器标注）中，Sylvas达到不同目标精度所需通信轮次更少，测试精度更高，有效利用了大量无标注数据并降低了适应延迟。
AI.conclusion: Sylvas通过协同整合分布价值与标签价值，在资源受限条件下有效解决了联邦持续学习中的设备调度问题，能够在时空分布动态变化和标签稀缺场景下实现及时模型更新。未来研究方向包括移动感知FCL、将主动学习与FCL结合以降低标注成本，以及基于数据漂移检测的资源高效训练触发机制。

title: Transfer Learning for Socioeconomic Estimation in Forced-Displacement Settings
summary: Progress in inclusive household surveys has strengthened socioeconomic evidence for forcibly displaced populations, providing indispensable benchmarks on living conditions and welfare. However, these surveys remain resource-intensive and periodic, while conditions can change between rounds, particularly in settings affected by fragility, conflict, and violence. More frequently updated, spatially granular complementary evidence is therefore needed to identify where socioeconomic conditions may be changing between survey rounds and to inform operational prioritization. Earth observation and machine learning offer a scalable source of spatially explicit socioeconomic information. However, tools developed for general populations have not been systematically adapted and evaluated in forced displacement settings, where living conditions, settlement patterns, and displacement impacts may differ substantially. We address this gap by adapting a multimodal spatiotemporal vision transformer, pretrained on Demographic and Health Survey data from approximately 1.2 million households across 36 African countries, to forced displacement and host community settings in South Sudan, Cameroon, and Zambia. We develop and evaluate the updated, adapted model using socioeconomic indices derived from UNHCR FDS and RMS data. Our results show that satellite-derived geospatial covariates explain up to 66% of the variation in socioeconomic outcomes in camp-intersecting grids, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 4.37 index points, and 41% in non-camp-intersecting areas, with an MAE of 5.41. The framework complements and adds value to periodic household surveys by filling critical spatial and temporal data gaps with regularly updated, model-based socioeconomic estimates. These estimates sustain insight between survey rounds and support timely humanitarian prioritization and field verification.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于约120万户DHS数据预训练的多模态时空视觉Transformer模型，通过迁移学习适配到南苏丹、喀麦隆和赞比亚的强制流离失所与宿主社区场景，利用UNHCR的FDS和RMS调查数据构建社会经济指数，并验证其在营地网格与非营地网格中的预测性能，以填补周期性入户调查之间的数据空白。
AI.motivation: 强制流离失所人群中，基于入户调查的社会经济数据存在资源密集、周期性长、时空覆盖有限的局限，难以及时反映脆弱性、冲突与暴力背景下流离失所人口福利的变化，亟需可频繁更新、空间精细化的补充证据用于人道主义行动优先级排序。现有EO-ML贫困估算工具多基于一般人群开发，未被系统地适配与评估于流离失所场景。
AI.method: 采用基于Pettersson et al.的多模态时空视觉Transformer架构，使用Landsat表面反射率时间序列、VIIRS夜间辐射、Open Buildings建筑足迹作为输入特征。使用DHS数据预训练的权重进行初始化，采用部分微调策略：冻结早期空间Transformer层，微调其余空间层、时间Transformer和回归头。FDS和RMS数据用于构建基于PCA的社会经济指数。实验采用四折空间分区交叉验证，按6.72km×6.72km网格单元聚合样本，并通过滑动窗口增强数据集（每个国家211-238个网格，共1123个）。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在三国联合测试集上R²=0.40，MAE=5.49；分国别R²分别为南苏丹0.62、赞比亚0.44、喀麦隆0.28。营地相交网格R²=0.66（MAE=4.37），非营地相交网格R²=0.41（MAE=5.41）。南苏丹三国联合场景外延测试中，将模型应用于2023-2025年影像，预测其社会经济指数累计下降27%，与苏丹战争外溢效应一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文为首次系统评估从一般国家人口到强制流离失所人口的迁移学习，证明DHS预训练表示在适配后对难民、IDP和宿主社区场景仍具预测价值。该框架提供可扩展的运营路径，用于在入户调查周期之间生成空间精细、规律更新的模型估算，作为识别需要进一步评估与实地核查优先区域的人道主义筛查工具，补充而非取代入户调查。

title: CiteGuard-RAG: A Validation-Centered AI System for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering
comment: Submitted to Engineering Reports. 22 pages, 2 figures, 12 tables
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve access to complex information; however, retrieving evidence alone does not ensure that answers are grounded, citation-valid, or appropriately refused. This paper introduces CiteGuard-RAG, a validation-centered AI system for evidence-grounded question answering. The system integrates hybrid semantic-lexical retrieval, citation-constrained generation, sentence-level grounding validation, and single-pass regeneration. Validation is used at runtime to determine whether a candidate answer should be accepted, refused, or regenerated before final delivery. CiteGuard-RAG is evaluated on 400 questions across a controlled housing-law dataset, PrivacyQA, and CUAD. In the controlled evaluation, it achieves 99.1% retrieval accuracy, 98.3% grounded-answer accuracy, and 98.3% citation validity, with no validation-detected hallucinations. Ablation results show that grounded-answer accuracy drops sharply when validation is removed, even when retrieval accuracy remains unchanged. External evaluation shows that while citation validity remains strong, evidence utilization, span alignment, and refusal calibration become harder under domain shift. These findings indicate that trustworthy RAG systems require explicit validation between retrieval and final answer delivery. CiteGuard-RAG provides a practical architecture for linking retrieval, generation, citation checking, abstention, and regeneration in high-stakes information access.

AI.tldr: CiteGuard-RAG是一个以验证为中心的RAG系统，通过混合检索（语义+BM25）、引用约束生成、句子级接地验证和单次重新生成机制，在受控住房法律数据集上实现了99.1%检索准确率和98.3%接地答案准确率，且无验证检测到的幻觉。验证层被证明是关键——移除后接地准确率从98.3%骤降至8.7%。外部验证（PrivacyQA和CUAD）表明引用有效性可迁移，但答案利用和拒绝校准在领域偏移下表现下降。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统即使检索到相关证据，仍可能出现幻觉、引用无效或拒绝行为不可靠的问题，尤其在高风险的Legal QA场景中，检索成功并不能保证生成的答案忠实于源文档。现有验证方法多为事后、答案级别或面向评估，缺乏在交付前进行细粒度接地控制的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出CiteGuard-RAG系统，核心组件包括：（1）页面感知文档解析与段落感知分块；（2）混合检索（稠密语义向量+BGE嵌入与BM25词法检索以0.65/0.35加权融合）；（3）引用约束生成（要求内联引用且仅基于检索内容）；（4）句子级接地验证（检查引用有效性、词法重叠阈值0.10、语义相似度阈值0.40）；（5）单次验证引导的重新生成（验证失败时触发一次重新生成，仍失败则标准化拒绝）。评估涵盖400个问题，包括150条受控住房法律数据、200条PrivacyQA和50条CUAD。
AI.result: 受控评估：检索准确率99.1%、接地答案准确率98.3%、引用有效性98.3%、幻觉率0%、真实拒绝率96.4%。Mistral和Qwen在相同配置下表现一致，表明系统行为主要由检索和验证约束决定。消融实验：移除验证层后接地准确率从98.3%降至8.7%，引用有效性从98.3%降至12.3%，幻觉率升至18.6%；混合检索优于纯词法（84.6%）和纯语义（92.3%）。外部验证：PrivacyQA上引用有效性保持100%，证据支持率81.33%，无不支持幻觉；CUAD压力测试中检索召回率100%但证据支持率仅36%，错误拒绝率升至56%，表明条款级抽取任务下span选择和拒绝校准能力下降。
AI.conclusion: 可信的RAG系统需要检索与最终交付之间的显式验证。CiteGuard-RAG提供了将检索、生成、引用检查、弃答和重新生成链接在一起的实用架构。研究表明：检索覆盖率和引用有效性比答案抽取和拒绝校准更具可迁移性；高检索准确率本身不能保证接地或引用有效的答案；未来工作应通过改进span选择、基于蕴含的验证和有界多轮重新生成来加强证据利用。

title: Per-Matrix Optimality Is Not Enough: Three-Level Optimization for Low-Rank LLM Compression
comment: 16 pages, to appear at EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Per-matrix singular value decomposition (SVD) truncation is Eckart-Young optimal in the whitened Frobenius norm, but errors from independently compressed matrices compound through the block's nonlinear forward pass. Inspired in part by hierarchical variational optimization in quantum many-body methods, we introduce a three-level chain that widens optimization scope from individual matrices to Transformer blocks to the full model: whitened SVD~(L1), block-level joint optimization~(L2), and end-to-end language-modeling loss refinement~(L3), all from 256 calibration sequences, with no instruction or recovery data. On LLaMA-7B at 60% compression, the chain reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 42.1 to 19.1 to 11.4. The block-level stage acts as a regularizer: skipping it worsens Penn Treebank (PTB) perplexity by 24 points, a gap that additional end-to-end training did not close in our experiments. Perplexity gains hold across 20-80% compression, five architectures up to 13B parameters, and both in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks, though the cross-architecture rows use architecture-specific configurations and the ratio sweep was not run under one common protocol. With more calibration data, skipping the block-level stage becomes competitive, revealing an offline compute--data trade-off. We therefore claim improvements only in perplexity and compression fidelity; downstream accuracy remains well below the dense model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于LLM低秩压缩的三级优化链：L1白化SVD（单矩阵）、L2块级联合优化（含前瞻探针）、L3端到端LM损失微调。仅用256条校准序列，无需指令或恢复数据。在LLaMA-7B 60%压缩率下，WikiText-2困惑度从42.1降至11.4；块级阶段充当正则化器，跳过它使PTB OOD困惑度恶化24点。
AI.motivation: 现有的逐矩阵SVD低秩压缩方法虽然在白化Frobenius范数下是Eckart-Young最优的，但忽略了Transformer块内非线性前向传播中各矩阵误差的相互影响，以及跨块的误差累积。这导致压缩后的模型性能远低于稠密模型。LoRA等数据依赖的恢复方法又改变了纯后训练压缩的设定。因此，需要一种仅使用现有校准数据、能捕捉块内和跨块交互的更广优化范围方法。
AI.method: 三级层次化优化链：(1) L1：对每个权重矩阵执行白化SVD，得到Eckart-Young最优的逐矩阵分解；(2) L2：在每个Transformer块内联合优化所有低秩因子，损失包含两部分——重建损失（压缩块输出与原始输出的Frobenius距离）和前瞻损失（通过冻结的下一块和可训练的探针矩阵，将隐藏状态投影到词汇空间，用KL散度衡量下一块预测分布的偏移）；(3) L3：以L2为热启动，对所有低秩因子进行端到端的语言建模损失微调。所有阶段共享256条校准序列（每条2048 token），不引入额外参数或外部数据。L2提出"跨前沿重建+下一块词汇前瞻"（CF+LA）作为核心技术贡献。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-7B 60%压缩率下，三级链将WikiText-2困惑度从L1的42.1降至L2的19.1再到L3的11.4，优于使用50K Alpaca样本的SVD-LLM + Sequential LoRA（15.0）。在20-80%压缩率范围、5种架构（最大13B）、ID和OOD基准上均有效。跳过L2会使PTB恶化24点（OOD），更多端到端训练无法弥合此差距；该方向在3个端到端管道种子上保持一致。在20%压缩时L1已捕获大部分增益，60%时L2贡献最大，80%时三级全部必要。推理时参数减少~58%，峰值显存降低49-56%，但解码吞吐因两个未融合GEMM下降6-14%。
AI.conclusion: 低秩压缩的单元不应是单个权重矩阵，而是截断误差实际交互的计算图。逐矩阵最优不足以恢复密集模型性能，关键在于从矩阵级→块级→全模型级逐步扩展优化范围。L2块级优化充当OOD正则化器，隐式正则化谱范数（避免LiLlama式的谱放大），在数据稀缺时价值最大。当校准数据充裕时（1024序列），跳过L2也具有竞争力，因此L2本质上是离线计算与校准数据之间的权衡。作者明确声明仅在困惑度和压缩保真度上有改进，下游任务准确性仍远低于稠密模型，不声称保留了广泛能力。

title: Before You Poll with LLMs: A Deliberative Diagnostic Framework
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Note: Web abstract is abridged to meet arXiv character limits. See PDF for the full proceedings abstract
summary: Can LLMs reason through new information like humans, or do they merely retrieve cached opinions? This is critical for silicon sampling, where LLM personas simulate public opinion at scale. Current evaluations test only whether personas hold the right opinions -- a static snapshot. But opinion research increasingly depends on dynamic fidelity: whether personas update beliefs in response to new arguments, as humans do during deliberation. No existing benchmark tests this. We introduce the Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework, which compares human and LLM belief shifts after identical informational interventions. Grounded in deliberative polling, it surfaces failures invisible to static evaluation: models that produce plausible partisan opinions can still misrepresent how those opinions change. Applying the framework to five frontier models using data from America in One Room (526 personas, 72 questions), we find that every model fails, each in a unique manner. GPT-5.1 exhibits reversal: its personas become more hostile toward the opposing party after balanced information, while humans become less so. This reversal is selective (80% on outgroup vs. 26% on policy questions) and symmetric across partisan identities. Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Llama 3.3 70B exhibit overshoot, shifting correctly but at 5-7x human magnitude. DeepSeek V3 exhibits rigidity with near-zero change. Targeted ablations reveal that policy content triggers these failures and that they are identity-specific: GPT-5.1 reverses on outgroup questions but overshoots on ingroup; Gemini shows the inverse. We term this signature self-sycophancy: conformity to the model's internal stereotype of the persona rather than reasoning from the information provided. Our framework offers a concrete protocol: run the deliberative diagnostic before trusting LLM personas to mimic revised beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"协商性民意调查诊断框架"（Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework），用于评估LLM角色在接触平衡信息后是否能像人类一样更新信念，测试动态保真度。在五个前沿模型上测试发现所有模型均以不同方式失败：GPT-5.1表现出"反转"（对外群体敌意增加），Gemini/Claude/Llama表现为"过度反应"（幅度是人类5-7倍），DeepSeek表现为"僵化"（近乎零变化）。作者将这种失败模式命名为"自我谄媚"（self-sycophancy），即模型遵从其对角色的内部刻板印象而非从提供的信息推理。
AI.motivation: 随着硅采样（silicon sampling）实践的兴起，LLM角色被用于大规模模拟公众意见。然而现有评估仅测试静态保真度（角色是否持有正确观点），而忽视了动态保真度（角色在接触新信息后是否能像人类一样更新信念）。意见研究中越来越依赖动态保真度，特别是在协商和说服场景中，但现有基准均未测试这一能力。
AI.method: 1. 框架设计：四阶段诊断流程（pre-poll前测→briefing信息介入→post-poll后测→comparison对比），通过计算Δ=Post-Pre的信念偏移，与人类基线比较，将模型行为分为四类：match（匹配）、overshoot（过度反应）、reversal（反转）、rigidity（僵化）。2. 人类基线数据：America in One Room（A1R），526名登记选民，72个问题，13个人口学属性。3. 测试五个前沿指令调优模型：GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Llama 3.3 70B、DeepSeek V3，温度设为0。4. 通过针对性消融实验隔离机制：内容触发实验（用不相关材料替换政策简报）、群内/群外控制实验（显式命名目标群体）、替代解释排除（模式崩溃、党派训练偏差、人设构建伪影等）。
AI.result: 1. 所有五个模型均失败，且失败方式各异：GPT-5.1在外群体问题上表现出反转（Δ=+0.50 vs 人类Δ=-0.21），Gemini/Claude/Llama表现出5-7倍过度反应，DeepSeek表现出僵化。2. GPT-5.1的反转具有选择性：外群体问题上反转率80%，政策问题上仅26%。3. 反转在所有党派群体中对称存在（民主党、共和党、独立人士均反转，p<0.001）。4. 政策内容是触发因素：用不相关材料（意大利面历史、园艺、国际象棋）替换政策简报后，分歧消失，两个模型均产生相同的过度反应（Δ=-0.75）。5. 身份特异性：GPT-5.1在外群体问题上反转但在群内问题上过度反应（Δ=+0.24 vs Δ=-1.09，t=12.29）；Gemini表现相反。6. 探索性干预（多主体协商、思维链、标签移除等）均无法同时校正方向和幅度。
AI.conclusion: 本文发现LLM存在"自我谄媚"现象：模型遵从其内部刻板印象而非从提供的信息推理。这表现为陈述性-程序性差距（declarative-procedural gap），即LLM能检索似是而非的党派观点（陈述性），但无法模拟这些观点如何在新信息影响下更新（程序性）。静态评估无法捕捉此类失败，因为模型可能在pre-deliberation阶段产生合理观点，却在post-deliberation阶段产生方向错误、幅度夸大或完全缺失的偏移。作者提出四步验证协议：构建校准样本→模拟匹配LLM角色→应用诊断分类法→测试选择性。该研究强调在使用LLM角色模拟意见变化前必须运行协商性诊断。

title: K-Bench: a clinically calibrated benchmark for evaluating large language models in high-risk mental health conversations
summary: % !TEX root = ../main.tex People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet their safety in evolving, high-risk conversations remains poorly characterised. We developed K-Bench, a clinician-calibrated, protected benchmark evaluating 125 model configurations representing 33 base models from 14 providers across a fixed cohort of 200 multi-turn vignettes involving suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, substance misuse, and no-risk presentations. Synthetic patient conversations showed substantial distributional overlap with real human-AI conversations. A frozen GPT-4o judge achieved 94.2% exact agreement with clinician consensus across 6,751 eligible item comparisons from 151 clinician-rated transcripts. Leading models combined strong supportive conversation with combined-risk scores above 95, whereas risk exploration exposed substantial variation among lower-performing configurations. Therapeutic prompting produced configuration-specific gains concentrated among weaker models, while elevated reasoning produced no average improvement. K-Bench combines broader clinical coverage and configuration-scale comparison with a continuously updated public leaderboard whose operational test materials are protected from direct optimisation. The leaderboard is available at this http URL .

AI.tldr: K-Bench 是一个由临床医生校准的、面向高风险心理健康对话的受保护基准测试，评估 125 个 LLM 配置在 200 个多轮心理剧场景（含自杀、自伤、家庭暴力、物质滥用及无风险）上的表现。冻结的 GPT-4o 评判器与临床共识的逐项一致率达 94.2%。领先模型的综合风险得分高于 95，但风险探索维度的表现差异最大；治疗性提示主要提升弱模型，增强推理并未带来平均改进。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 被广泛用于心理健康支持，亟需一个具备临床广度、对话深度、可扩展评分与防污染机制的独立评估基准，以识别现有模型在高风险、渐进式披露及多风险共存情境下的真实安全性与配置特异性弱点。
AI.method: 基于生活经验来源的素材构建 122 变量因子心理剧库；用 4 款患者智能体生成最多 20 轮的多轮对话，与真实人–AI 对话语料做嵌入空间重叠验证；6 名临床心理学家按 7 维度 47 子项（Q1–Q47）对 151 份转录本独立打分生成共识真值；用冻结的 GPT-4o 评判器对 125 个模型配置进行打分并与共识校准；分析总体/综合风险得分、风险领域、严重度、共病、提示与推理配置的配对效应。
AI.result: 合成患者与真实对话在嵌入空间显著重叠；GPT-4o 评判器在 D1–D7 全部 6751 项合格比较中与临床共识一致率 94.2%，高于临床–临床间 89.4% 的一致率；125 个配置总体得分 81.19–98.96，综合风险得分 52.39–96.11，领先配置（GPT-5.5、Claude Fable 5 等）综合风险 >95；D2 风险探索区分度最大（22.1–93.1），自杀、自伤、物质滥用、家暴领域均分约 89–92；严重度升高或风险共病增多时仅出现小幅下降；治疗性提示在弱模型上收益最大（IBM Granite 4.0 H Micro +17.91），但对领先模型效应不一甚至为负；推理增强平均效应为 –0.58 分，对综合风险并无普遍增益。
AI.conclusion: K-Bench 提供了迄今最广泛的高风险心理健康对话比较评估：领先的 LLM 能在多风险、渐进修辞场景中维持支持性与临床一致的对话，但其风险探索能力在弱模型上仍显著不足；提示与推理的效应具配置特异性而非普遍有益，因此模型版本、系统提示与推理设置应作为整体临床部署配置共同评估；公开排行榜与受保护的运行材料支持长期独立、可追溯的迭代评估。

title: LLM-Based Schema-Aware Split Learning for Privacy-Preserving Mental Distress Prediction Across Heterogeneous Surveys
summary: Rising societal and lifestyle complexity has been linked to a growing prevalence of mental distress worldwide. Educational institutions, workplaces, clinics, etc. collect large volumes of mental health survey data to understand and reduce this burden. Collaborative analysis of such data could yield effective generalizable predictive models. Privacy constraints and varied survey designs (i.e., different questions, scales, and formats) hinder direct integration. We propose a schema-aware split learning (SL) framework that preserves privacy, using a large language model (LLM) as a shared semantic encoder to harmonize heterogeneous survey schemas across institutions. We serialize each survey record into a natural-language description, unifying disparate survey schemas into a common format. The LLM is fine-tuned for mental distress assessment via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and partitioned across client and server. Clients retain the raw survey responses locally and run only a lightweight front-end, so original records never leave the institution that collected them. The resource-intensive backbone runs on the server, minimizing client-side computation. Using LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct, the framework attains an average ANLS of 0.708 with only 2,000 training samples, surpasses federated learning (FL) in eight of nine settings, and cuts per-client computation by three orders of magnitude, while generalizing to unseen datasets. Overall, it enables accurate, privacy-preserving, and resource-efficient collaborative learning from heterogeneous mental health survey data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于大语言模型的模式感知拆分学习框架，通过将异构心理健康调查数据序列化为自然语言描述，利用 LoRA 适配的 LLaMA-3.2-3B 作为共享语义编码器，在保护隐私的前提下实现跨机构协作式心理痛苦预测。
AI.motivation: 心理健康调查数据敏感且受法规限制，无法跨机构共享；同时各机构使用不同的问卷设计（问题、量表、格式），导致数据模式异构。现有方法通常仅解决隐私或异构之一，无法同时兼顾。
AI.method: 1) 模式感知序列化：将四条记录序列化为自然语言提示（指令-输入-输出格式），统一异构模式；2) 拆分学习架构：客户端仅保留分词器、LoRA 嵌入和轻量投影头（约 3.68M 参数），服务器承载 LLM 主干；3) LoRA 适配（rank=16）仅训练约 0.75% 参数；4) 构建 3×3 网格（三种模式异构度 × 三种数据量不平衡度），共 10 个客户端。
AI.result: 使用 LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct，仅 2000 训练样本即取得平均 ANLS 0.708；在 9 种设置中 8 种优于联邦学习（平均 0.708 vs 0.687）；客户端计算量降低约三个数量级（0.08 TFLOPs vs 158 TFLOPs，1.3 GB vs 15–25 GB）；泛化模型在未见数据集上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次将拆分学习、LoRA 适配 LLM 语义编码器与异构调查模式协调三者结合，实现了准确、隐私保护且资源高效的跨机构心理健康协作学习；但未对中间激活提供抗模型反演攻击的防护，属于未来工作方向。

title: Learning Multimodal One-step Flow Policy via Value-weighted Optimal Transport
summary: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn a policy solely from fixed datasets, which often contain multimodal action distributions. Flow policies can naturally represent such multimodal behaviors, but learning an efficient one-step flow policy remains challenging: standard value guidance often leads to mode collapse or exploits overestimation bias in out-of-distribution regions. To address this, we introduce One-step Flow policy via Optimal Transport (OptiFlow), a framework for one-step flow policy learning as a structured sample-allocation problem. OptiFlow jointly trains a value-aware reference flow policy and an efficient one-step policy, coupling their action samples through state-wise entropic optimal transport. For each state, critic-estimated values define the priority of distillation target actions, while the action-distance cost ensures geometrically compatible pairings. By avoiding direct critic maximization, our transport-guided approach enables in-distribution exploitation by anchoring the one-step policy to high-value, dataset-supported modes without the risk of out-of-distribution divergence. Experimental results demonstrate that OptiFlow effectively captures optimal multimodal behaviors and achieves strong performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OptiFlow 是一种面向离线强化学习的高效一步流策略学习方法，通过价值加权的熵最优传输将多步参考流策略蒸馏为一步策略，在保留多模态结构的同时避免直接 critic 最大化导致的模式崩溃与 OOD 过估计偏差。
AI.motivation: 一步流策略部署高效但学习困难：逐点噪声-动作匹配易导致模式崩溃（多模态退化为折中均值），而直接 critic 最大化易利用 OOD 区域的过估计偏差。需在不直接优化 critic 的前提下，将多步流策略蒸馏为一步策略，同时保留多模态结构并锚定在数据支持的高价值模式。
AI.method: 四步框架：(1) TD 学习 critic Q_φ；(2) 用 Value-aware Behavior Cloning (VaBC) 训练多步参考流策略 μ_ω，以 softmax 权重赋予高于当前一步策略 Q 值的数据集动作更高权重；(3) 在每个状态对 μ_θ 采样 N 个动作、对 μ_ω 采样 M 个动作，构建**非对称边际**的熵正则化 OT 问题——一步策略侧采用均匀边际 p=1/N 以保留基噪声分布，参考策略侧采用 softmax 价值加权边际 q ∝ exp(Q_φ/τ) 以将更多监督质量分配给高价值参考动作，成本矩阵仅基于动作空间几何距离（归一化欧氏距离）；(4) 通过 Sinkhorn 求解传输计划 P*，对每个一步策略样本取行内最大传输质量的参考动作作为蒸馏目标，加权回归损失训练 μ_θ。通过 2×2 反例证明：价值信息必须编码在参考侧边际中（而非仅在成本中），否则均匀边际下任何可行耦合的期望赋值价值被边际固定，无法保证策略改进。
AI.result: 在 OGBench（导航与操控，共 60+ 任务）、D4RL AntMaze 与 Adroit 上评估：OGBench 状态平均 48.3±0.4，超越 GFP (45.6)、FQL (39.0)；OGBench 操控平均 44.5±0.5，在 Cube-Single/Double/Triple、Puzzle-4×4、Scene-Play 五个家族中取得最优；D4RL AntMaze 平均 86.6±0.7 优于 GFP (82.6)、FQL (82.3)；可视化任务平均 75.9 显著优于 GFP (57.7)。消融证明：均匀参考边际使平均从 57.3 降至 9.7（价值加权边际至关重要），VaBC 优于 AWR 风格加权 (57.3 vs 52.5)，动作采样预算增加不能解释性能差距；Bandit 诊断表明 OT 比 VWD、Top-K NN、Q-cost OT 更优保留多模态并避免次优分配；四模式 MDP 中 OptiFlow-BC 在数据不均衡下保持四模态平衡覆盖。Offline-to-online 微调在 OGBench 与 D4RL 上均持续提升。超参数 τ、η、Sinkhorn 迭代数与采样数 (N, M) 对性能相对稳健。
AI.conclusion: OptiFlow 证明了价值引导的一步流策略学习可受益于传输式监督而非直接 critic 最大化；价值加权参考边际解耦了价值与几何分配，避免了 OOD 偏差并保留多模态结构；该框架将 critic 信息用于构建结构化监督而非直接优化，开辟了保留多模态行为的价值引导生成式策略学习路径。主要局限是训练时增加 Sinkhorn 计算开销（参考动作采样主导，非 Sinkhorn 本身），且在参考动作分布简单时优势减小。

title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
summary: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. Retrieval pipelines move the selection out of the context, but also out of the agent's capability. We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two linear maps suffice to read it out with no skill text in the context. Gavel (Glance And Verdict from a frozen LLM) reads it in two steps. A glance projects the task's and each skill's mid-layer states through the two maps, the only parameters trained, and scores the full library against compact per-skill banks that one forward pass builds at installation. A verdict then resumes the shortlisted skills' forward passes and reads the model's own likelihood and yes/no judgment, fused with the glance as a product of experts. Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories. On Qwen3-32B it outperforms progressive disclosure and retrieve-and-rerank pipelines that add 1.2B to 16B external parameters, by up to 13.4 points on written tasks and up to 21.9 when the need for a skill arises mid-rollout. Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness the same 32B triggers the correct skill on Skill-Use more often than far larger frontier models running in Codex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gavel，一种基于冻结LLM自身前向传递的技能路由方法，通过两个线性映射（glance和verdict）从模型的中间层隐藏状态中读取路由信号，无需在上下文中加载技能文本即可完成技能选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的技能路由方法存在两种缺陷：(1)渐进式披露（progressive disclosure）将所有技能元数据预加载到上下文中，分散模型注意力并限制库大小；(2)检索-重排序流水线将选择交给外部模型，脱离了智能体LLM的能力，且无法随智能体能力提升而改善。作者希望实现"用智能体的能力做路由，但不占用其上下文"。
AI.method: Gavel采用两阶段设计：1) Glance（扫视）：在冻结LLM的中间层（通过矩阵熵准则自动选择，约70%深度处）添加两个线性映射W_q和W_s，将任务token状态映射为查询、每技能token状态映射为键，通过token级max-similarity匹配对整个库排序，并采用ε-cover压缩技能库（最近优先遍历）。2) Verdict（裁决）：对候选列表，通过恢复安装时的前向传递（追加任务），读取模型对任务的对数似然L和yes/no对数几率V。最后通过专家乘积（Product of Experts）将三者融合：S = g + αL + γV。只需训练两个768×5120的线性映射（共7.9M参数）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-32B上，Gavel在三个公开基准（SkillRet、SRA-Bench、Eval-Core）和新建的SkillTraj基准（372条模拟智能体轨迹）上均优于渐进式披露和1.2B-16B参数的检索-重排序流水线，最多高出21.9点（rollout中段场景）。在bash-agent部署中，Qwen3-32B + Gavel在Skill-Use上正确触发率达.909，超过多个远大的前沿模型（包括MiniMax-M3在Codex中.864、GLM-5.1在Codex中.706等）。路由准确率随骨干模型能力增强而提升。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的骨干LLM已具备技能选择所需的能力，仅需学习的读出即可将其利用起来。Gavel作为原生路由器，可推广至工具、记忆或MCP服务器的路由，无需额外模型陪伴骨干。

title: A Lifecycle Cost Analysis of Smart-Contract-Coordinated Federated Learning Marketplaces
summary: Blockchain-enabled Federated Learning (FL) marketplaces enable collaborative model training among mutually distrustful participants through smart contracts. Although numerous architectures exist, their economic evaluation is typically limited to isolated blockchain operations rather than the complete marketplace lifecycle. Consequently, it remains unclear whether operational costs depend on operating at scale. This paper presents an experimental study of the operational cost of a DAO-governed marketplace. Our evaluation decomposes the gas consumption of every blockchain operation throughout the contract lifecycle, performs ablation experiments to isolate the impact of on-chain coordination and IPFS storage on federated training, and derives an analytical model describing the amortization of deployment costs. Results show the lifecycle of a single training task consumes approximately 3.8 million gas units per hired trainer. The average cost per training round reaches its amortization knee - defined as twice the asymptotic recurring cost - after approximately 20 communication rounds. Moreover, integrating smart contracts and IPFS preserves model performance, achieving accuracy comparable to conventional FL deployments. These findings demonstrate that smart-contract-coordinated FL marketplaces exhibit an amortizing cost structure not because on-chain operations are inexpensive, but because recurring costs are one to two orders of magnitude smaller than fixed deployment costs, thereby diluting over the federation's lifetime.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于智能合约协调的联邦学习（FL）市场进行端到端的生命周期成本分析，提出并验证了解析摊销模型，揭示该类系统的运行成本呈摊销式结构——固定部署成本远高于每轮重复成本，因此随联邦运行轮次增加，每轮平均成本会快速逼近其重复操作渐近值。
AI.motivation: 现有区块链+联邦学习市场的工作大多只评估孤立的区块链交易成本（如单次合约调用的 gas），缺乏对完整市场生命周期经济性的刻画。这导致一个核心问题未被回答：运行成本究竟由一次性部署主导（可摊销）还是由每轮重复操作主导（线性增长），而这直接决定了该类平台是否随规模扩大而变得经济。
AI.method: 实现 DAO 治理的市场参考架构（Solidity 智能合约 + IPFS + Flower FL 框架），在本地 Hardhat EVM 上精确计量每个生命周期阶段（设置阶段 s19–s23、训练循环 s24–s31、结算阶段 s32–s33）的 gas 消耗；在 MNIST/MNISTNet 上以 FedAvg 进行三组对照消融（baseline / no-IPFS / full），分析 N∈{2,8,16,32} 的执行时间分解；推导出摊销解析模型 ḡ(R)=G_setup/R+G_round，并将其推广为关于受雇训练者数 N_t 的摊销拐点 R_be(N_t)。
AI.result: （1）消融：baseline/no-IPFS/full 三组最终精度统计上无差异（0.9882–0.9885），每轮时间差异落在实验噪声范围内，说明去中心化协调层对学习无负面影响；（2）生命周期 gas 分解：每名受雇训练者的一次性部署约 3.8M gas，其中 registerTrainer 与 AcceptOffer 占部署成本约 3/4；每轮重复成本约 0.5M gas（3 名训练者时 G_round(3)=496,400）；（3）摊销模型：摊销拐点 R_be≈20.37 轮（定义为平均成本=2×渐近重复成本），R=100 时平均成本仅比渐近值高 20%；（4）鲁棒性：R_be(N_t) 跨 N_t 两个数量级变化仅约 19%，极限收敛至约 22.11 轮，证明拐点位置由架构而非联邦规模决定。
AI.conclusion: 智能合约协调的 FL 市场具有摊销式成本结构——并非因为链上操作绝对廉价，而是因为每轮重复成本比固定部署成本低 1–2 个数量级，因此随联邦运行时间延长而被"稀释"。这一结论为评估去中心化协调架构提供了以生命周期摊销而非单笔交易成本为基础的新视角，论证了在持续运行的联邦下该类市场在经济上是可行的；同时作者也指出结论受限于单模型（MNISTNet/MNIST）、单一匹配制度（k̄=1）等有效性威胁。

title: Dynamic HBM Repartitioning for Multi-Turn MoE Serving
summary: Long-running multi-turn requests accumulate reusable key-value (KV) state. Once this state exceeds a fixed GPU KV-cache allocation, serving systems evict reusable prefixes, repeat prefill work, and may preempt requests. This pressure is particularly acute for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: their expert weights occupy most GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM), even though each token activates only a sparse subset of experts. A static boundary between weights and the KV cache prevents serving systems from using expert memory to preserve reusable state as conversations grow. We present VAMP, an MoE serving framework that changes this HBM boundary at runtime. When a KV allocation cannot be satisfied, VAMP compares the estimated future work of three alternatives: staging expert weights from host memory, evicting cached prefixes that may require re-prefill, or preempting and rescheduling requests. It then converts a bounded expert-weight region into KV-cache capacity when that action has the lowest estimated penalty. CUDA Virtual Memory Management page remapping performs this conversion without copying resident KV data. We implement VAMP in the vLLM serving engine and evaluate Qwen3-Next-80B on recorded and controlled multi-turn workloads. Across five replays of a recorded 2,103-turn SWE-bench agent workload, VAMP with a 15% maximum expert-offloading ratio reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) p90 from 26.1 s to 1.10 s (23.6 times) and increases request throughput by 20.7% relative to unmodified vLLM, while increasing time per output token (TPOT) by 31.1%.

AI.tldr: VAMP 是一个面向多轮 MoE 推理服务的框架，通过运行时动态重分配专家权重与 KV 缓存之间的 HBM 边界，利用三路代价模型在专家卸载、KV 驱逐和请求抢占之间选择最低代价方案，并借助 CUDA 虚拟内存管理（VMM）按页粒度重映射实现无数据拷贝的重分区。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型中专家权重占据绝大部分 HBM，而每 token 仅激活稀疏的专家子集；多轮 agentic 工作负载的可复用前缀 KV 缓存持续增长，导致固定 KV 缓存容量耗尽后引发"前缀缓存悬崖"——命中率骤降、TTFT 飙升。静态 HBM 分区无法将专家显存回收用于 KV 缓存。
AI.method: 1) 三路代价模型：估算专家卸载（重复传输开销）、KV 缓存驱逐（重预填充代价）和请求抢占（调度与重排队代价）的未来惩罚，选择最低代价动作。2) 动态 HBM 重分区：使用 CUDA VMM 按 expert group 页粒度重映射物理 HBM 页面，无需复制驻留数据。3) 批感知专家卸载：每层预取整个卸载区域，与前层计算通过双缓冲重叠传输。实现于 vLLM，约 7100 行代码。
AI.result: 在 2×H100 PCIe 上服务 Qwen3-Next-80B（80B 总参数，每 token 激活 3B），5 次重放 2,103 回合 SWE-agent 轨迹：VAMP-15 将 TTFT p90 从 26.1s 降至 1.10s（23.6×），请求吞吐量提升 20.7%，前缀缓存命中率从 0.19% 升至 89.8%，抢占率从 562.7/千回合降至 0.18；代价是 TPOT 增加 31.1%。在 4×H200 NVLink 上于 c=32 并发时，TTFT p99 降低 10.2×。不同卸载比例存在权衡：VAMP-15 在 TTFT 与 TPOT 间取得最佳平衡，VAMP-20 在低并发时因过卸载反而表现更差。
AI.conclusion: VAMP 通过动态 HBM 重分区成功推迟了多轮 MoE 服务中的"前缀缓存悬崖"，显著降低 TTFT 与抢占率。专家卸载比例应根据工作负载匹配而非最大化。局限性：当前控制器在内存压力缓解后不恢复专家驻留；未与 host 端 KV 缓存卸载结合。

title: PEAT: Pseudo-Error Assessment for GPU Kernel Validation in DNN Training
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely adopted in various fields, driving an emerging trend in developing software stacks associated with DNN training systems. For example, many codes have been ported across different frameworks or developed to leverage the computing power of GPUs or domain-specific accelerators. However, validating a kernel implementation in DNN training is time-consuming and generally requires massive storage. Specifically, this poses a fundamental question: how to characterize the behavior of a new implementation when it is integrated into a DNN training flow. Unfortunately, this problem is not well investigated in the literature, to the best of our knowledge. To address this shortcoming, we present PEAT - a lightweight inspection framework for \underline{P}seudo-\underline{E}rror \underline{A}ssessment associated with GPU kernel validation in DNN \underline{T}raining. Firstly, inspired by conventional fault injection (FI), PEAT's Profiler invokes an operation-wise kernel in a training flow to collect a DNN model's states (e.g., checkpoints and activations). More importantly, the Profiler introduces two simple yet effective techniques, playback FI and frequency-based runtime FI, leveraging persistent kernel calling during the training process. Secondly, PEAT's Analyzer characterizes profiled errors, revealing some signatures from the error distribution of a kernel compared to the golden one. Lastly, PEAT's Detector provides some guidelines as a sufficient condition, which enables associating several well-known error models with signature patterns. We demonstrate the applicability of our approach by presenting the results and analysis using GPUs from the two most popular vendors, NVIDIA V100 and AMD MI250, on various AI models, from vision tasks to language models, for both pretraining and finetuning scenarios.

AI.tldr: PEAT是一个轻量级GPU内核验证框架，针对DNN训练中的伪误差评估。它通过Playback FI和Frequency-based Runtime FI两种故障注入技术收集误差特征，并利用Analyzer和Detector对误差进行表征与分类。该框架在NVIDIA V100和AMD MI250上对多种CNN和Transformer模型（涵盖预训练和微调场景）进行了验证，揭示了收敛模式、重复块模式、前向/反向误差差异等规律。
AI.motivation: DNN训练系统快速发展，新内核开发与移植频繁。然而，内核验证面临巨大挑战：单元测试中微小误差（10⁻⁴~10⁻²量级）的阈值难以确定；现有故障注入方法成本极高（如FIdelity需>290万次实验、>49万节点小时）；GPU代码验证工具主要关注并发bug，无法揭示DNN训练中的静默误差；DNN对精度具有一定容忍度且各层误差范围差异大，单一阈值无法适用。核心问题：如何在DNN训练流中高效地表征新内核实现的正确性。
AI.method: PEAT框架包含三个核心组件：1) **Profiler**：包含两种FI方案——Playback FI（记录阶段采集权重/激活/梯度等训练上下文数据，回放阶段对预录数据注入故障并对比golden结果生成误差曲线）和Frequency-based Runtime FI（在训练过程中按频率持续注入故障以观察渐进式退化）；使用FP64/FP16/RV/RZ四种误差模型。2) **Analyzer**：通过(mean, std)对在三个层级（单操作、不同操作、重复块组）进行误差范围表征，并利用Spearman等级相关分析误差与权重/激活均值方差的关联。3) **Detector**：基于预定义阈值[xmin,xmax]和[rmin,rmax]以及Spearman分数，提供充分条件将误差模式与已知错误模型关联。关键概念包括Fault Injecting Point (FIP) 和 Fault Observing Point (FOP)。
AI.result: 在8个CNN模型（ResNet系列、MobileNet、EfficientNet-B0）和5个Transformer模型（T5-small/large/3B、Phi-1.5、Llama3.2-1B）上，针对预训练和微调场景在NVIDIA V100和AMD MI250两种GPU上验证。主要发现：1) **收敛模式**：FP16误差范围小且变化稳定，RV/RZ误差变化显著；2) **归一化后FP16误差比FP64大10³-10⁴倍；3) **规范化层敏感性**：BN/LN层对RZ误差最敏感；4) **重复块模式**：ResNet中相同输入输出形状的块呈现相似误差模式，T5编码器块每6层重复；5) **前向vs反向**：前向注入误差远大于反向注入（因梯度范围显著小于权重/激活）；6) **强相关性**：精度误差与权重/激活方差呈高Spearman相关（0.7-1.0）；7) **跨GPU一致性**：NVIDIA和AMD GPU上误差模式相似，证明方法无硬件依赖性；8) **阈值分类**：Conv/FC层FP16误差变化小而RV/RZ变化大；BN/LN层可设th1=1.0、th2=10.0区分RZ与RV/FP16误差；9) **实际影响**：10⁻³量级的微小误差即可导致训练精度明显下降。
AI.conclusion: PEAT是一种基于两种简洁有效的故障注入技术（Playback FI和Frequency-based Runtime FI）的内核表征框架，作为DNN框架开发过程中特征化与检测微小误差的低成本工具。PEAT为框架开发者提供有价值的洞察，通过识别特定DNN设备代码中潜在隐蔽误差的发生来简化设备代码验证。PEAT不依赖硬件或平台特定假设，能够在不同开发环境中表现良好，展现了广泛的适用性。

title: The Essence of Git: Concepts for P2P Replication
summary: Git is most commonly known as a decentralized version control system. Underneath the surface, the design of Git exhibits an elegant object model and incremental replication protocols that have been used to build a variety of applications that go much beyond version control. In this paper, we survey those applications and show how application concepts have been mapped to Git concepts to show the latter's generality. We also show the connection between the Git commit history and the theory of distributed algorithms and convergent replicated data structures, suggesting that it approaches their essence. We finally compare to current peer-to-peer frameworks to establish the level of abstraction of the Git object model and peek at its potential universality. Throughout, we frame our discussion using the \textit{conceptual design} approach proposed by Daniel Jackson.

AI.tldr: 本文以Daniel Jackson的"概念设计"方法为框架，重新审视Git的对象模型与复制协议，证明Git远不止是一个去中心化版本控制系统，而是逼近P2P复制本质的通用框架。作者综述了大量基于Git构建的应用（账本、日志、博弈、知识管理、文本编辑、审阅、访问控制、大数据集、安全等），揭示Git提交历史与分布式算法理论（CRDT、hash chain/blocklace、状态机复制）之间的深层联系，并与Secure-Scuttlebutt、Nostr、P2Panda、Willow等其他P2P模型对比，讨论Git模型是否趋近"通用"以及构建真正通用的P2P对象模型所需的最小扩展。
AI.motivation: Git虽以版本控制闻名，但其对象模型和增量复制协议已被广泛复用于远超源码管理的应用场景；同时，分布式系统理论中关于强最终一致性和拜占庭容错的抽象（hash chain、blocklace、hash chronicle等）本质上是对Git提交历史的抽象。作者希望从P2P应用开发者视角，借助Jackson的概念设计方法，给出Git核心概念的更一般化的定义、用途和操作原则，并探讨Git模型是否已逼近P2P复制的本质，为寻找通用P2P对象模型奠定基础。
AI.method: 采用Jackson的"概念设计"方法：(1) 对关键概念(path/tree/blob/commit/reference/repository等)给出抽象级定义；(2) 识别每个概念的用途；(3) 通过操作原则说明用户交互。论文分为：背景（第2节，原始Git对象模型）、综述（第3节，文献与开源项目中的应用）、理论联系（第4节，与CRDT、hash chain、blocklace等的关系）、重定义（第5节，对核心概念给出超越版本控制的一般化定义）、对比（第6节，与其他P2P模型比较）、结论与开放问题（第7节）。
AI.result: 1. 综述了十余类基于Git构建的应用，包括GOC-Ledger/DOLE v2（基于CRDT的账本）、2P-BFT-Log（BFT追加日志）、Gachix（Nix包缓存）、Catan/Monopoly博弈、Quit Store（RDF知识管理）、Pinnacle（协同文本编辑）、Git-reviewed（去中心化代码审阅）、Walser（基于信任图的访问控制）、XetHub（大数据集Merkle树）、Secure Git（加密Git）、Gitless/Jujutsu（替代前端）、Git notes/git-meta（元数据）、Radicle（P2P代码协作）、Git-annex（外部blob管理）等。2. 揭示Git不可变对象存储本质上是grow-only set CRDT，引用存储支持更复杂的合并；展示消息→commit、点对点交付→复制、happened-before→父子关系这一映射足以实现共识、复制寄存器、视图变更等所有现代分布式抽象。3. 提出Git核心概念的一般化定义，使其适用于任意分布式应用而非仅限于版本控制。4. 与SSB、Nostr、P2Panda（基于追加日志、无对象模型）和Willow（更接近Git的状态对象模型、基于时间戳的覆盖语义）对比，指出Git模型已较高层次但尚非完全通用，Willow的模型理论上可在Git上模拟。5. 提出开放问题：现有P2P项目在表达力与效率上是否等价于Git？是否存在类似ZF集合论的通用对象模型基础？构建BFT P2P应用所需的Git最小扩展是什么？
AI.conclusion: Git的对象模型与增量复制协议可被视为P2P复用的通用基础，已逼近分布式算法（共识、BFT日志）和收敛复制数据结构（CRDT）的本质。论文从P2P应用开发者视角给出了核心概念的一般化定义，并指出Git模型在表达能力上高于多数现有P2P框架但尚未完全通用（如Willow的时间戳覆盖语义需要扩展）。开放问题包括：是否存在等价或更优的通用对象模型、Git是否足以支撑BFT P2P应用、使其成为通用的最小扩展。强调"将同步对象与时机的选择权留给终端用户"的设计目标有助于构建更具韧性的计算基础设施，并在用户与平台/服务运营方利益之间取得更好平衡。

title: Object Model Analysis of a Supercomputer with Digital Twin
summary: Operators and developers need a mental model of both the structure and the live behavior of a large supercomputer, but its physical layout, logical organization, and streams of per-node telemetry are difficult to relate to one another, making it hard to trace a metric or event back to a specific hardware component. We present DAT, an interactive three-dimensional digital analytics twin of a compute cluster built in a real-time game engine, Unreal Engine. DAT expands a compact, parametric description of a supercomputer, a reusable Digital Twin Prototype (DTP), into a navigable Digital Twin Instance (DTI) that mirrors its physical containment hierarchy of racks, chassis, blades, and network links, encoding each node's role and health in its appearance, while a lightweight event-driven simulator animates job and hardware activity over a virtual clock. Our current implementation adds a two-path node-selection mechanism, unifying direct 3D pointing with command-shell queries, that opens an in-world visual-analytics panel beside any selected component showing summary statistics and live, time-varying metrics. We describe this architecture, report qualitative behavior from the working prototype, and outline the path toward driving the panels with recorded telemetry and in-situ anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DAT，一个基于 Unreal Engine 构建的交互式三维数字分析孪生，用于可视化超级计算机。它通过参数化描述自动生成可导航场景，统一了空间视图、逻辑角色和动态遥测三大视图，并新增了"点击选取"与"命令 shell"双路径选择机制以及一个面向相机的 in-world LCD 面板来实时展示节点指标。
AI.motivation: 超算运维人员和开发者需要将超级计算机的物理布局（机柜/刀片）、逻辑角色（计算/存储/网关等）以及实时遥测流三类信息整合理解，但传统仪表盘将动态视图与空间视图割裂，楼层图又缺乏动态性，导致难以将指标异常回溯到具体硬件组件及其邻居。游戏引擎具备实时渲染与空间导航能力，但其挑战在于如何在不淹没场景的前提下把密集的 per-node 信息在原位呈现。
AI.method:
方法核心是一个"数据—扩展—呈现"三层解耦的架构：
1) 元数据驱动的 Digital Twin Prototype (DTP)：用递归的 parent-id 表示 rack→chassis→blade→node 的物理包含层次，role 与 health 解耦正交编码，并附带设备能力摘要与类型化链路；
2) 通过 ClusterBuilder/SimDirector/LCD Panel/Network Visualizer 等 Actor 将 DTP 展开为 Digital Twin Instance (DTI)，按机柜行列布局渲染，节点颜色编码角色与健康状态；
3) 事件驱动 SimDirector 维护虚拟时钟与事件表，驱动 job 与硬件活动动画，节点在有 job 时"呼吸"并按 job 颜色发光；
4) 新增双路径选择机制：3D 屏幕中心射线点击（直接路径）与命令行 shell 的 select（符号路径），汇聚到同一个 selected-state；选择后弹出一个 billboard 朝向相机、可复用的 in-world LCD 面板（半透明 quad + 文本），按固定亚秒级节奏刷新；
5) 遥测层当前为合成占位（基于真实 job 负载叠加 per-node 相位振荡的温度/利用率），后续可替换为录制的真实遥测。
AI.result: 原型已在 Apple Silicon 笔记本上的 Unreal Engine 编辑器与 standalone 配置中构建并启动成功，可从规格文件加载场景、推进模拟、自动捕获帧；通过人工交互验证了双路径选择共用同一状态、面板始终随相机 billboard 且文本随虚拟时钟连续更新、利用率/温度随 job 启停升降、运行 job 计数与节点动画一致；性能开销低（每点击一次射线查询，面板为单个轻量 Actor，每秒数次字符串重建而非逐帧）。目前仍受限于单机评测、未连真实遥测、仅支持单选单面板、未可视化跨机柜网络拓扑、未做正式用户研究。
AI.conclusion: DAT 通过参数化数字孪生将超算的空间与动态视图桥接起来：用户可直接指向或命名任意节点并就地读取其状态。未来工作方向包括：可视化跨机柜网络拓扑、接入录制的真实时间戳遥测并由虚拟时钟驱动回放、按级别聚合 blades→chassis→racks 健康、多面板同显与 LOD、可扩展性与可用性研究；代码将在发表时开源。

title: BOOST: Concurrent Access to Host Memory and HBM to Accelerate LLM Inference
summary: GPU memory bandwidth and capacity limit throughput in large language model (LLM) inference. The GPU memory system consists of a primary tier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and a secondary tier of host memory connected via CPU-to-GPU interconnect. Current serving systems treat the tiers hierarchically: they serve exclusively from HBM when data fits, and otherwise prefetch data from host memory to HBM before use. In both cases, the host memory bandwidth is never well utilized. Prefetching expands capacity by utilizing host memory, but consumes HBM bandwidth for writes, reducing the bandwidth available for demand loads. We observe that fully utilizing both host and HBM bandwidth requires each wave of GPU threadblocks to access both tiers concurrently and in proportion to their bandwidth ratio. Existing bandwidth-proportional placement strategies fail to provide concurrency because they are not aware of GPU waves, and the large 2MB GPU page size. This paper presents BOOST, the first runtime system that provides concurrent and proportional access to both GPU memory tiers, extracting the combined bandwidth of host memory and HBM for LLM inference without kernel changes. The key insight in BOOST is to use kernel access patterns to make page allocation and runtime data management wave-aware. For static model weights, BOOST applies modulo-based page placement that eliminates access-ratio variance; for dynamically provisioned attention key-value (KV) pairs, it makes the free KV page pool wave-aware. We integrate BOOST into vLLM and evaluate on a Grace Hopper system. At iso-batch size, BOOST improves Time-per-Output-Token (TPOT) by 4.3% over HBM-only serving, whereas prefetching degrades TPOT by 6%. In high-throughput serving, BOOST improves throughput by 31% on average, outperforming prefetching by 15%.

AI.tldr: BOOST是首个在无需修改GPU内核的前提下，使LLM推理同时并发、按带宽比例访问HBM与主机内存的运行时系统。它通过基于模运算的页面放置（MPP）和感知wave的KV池管理（DSR），在每个GPU wave内实现并发且比例匹配的内存访问，从而同时获得两层的合并带宽和扩展容量。
AI.motivation: LLM推理的解码阶段受限于GPU内存带宽与容量。虽然现代GPU通过C2G互连拥有带宽约为HBM 10%的主机内存，但现有服务系统要么完全不使用主机内存，要么将其视为HBM的辅助层级，通过预取方式将数据迁移到HBM后再服务。这导致主机内存带宽被浪费，且预取消耗HBM写带宽，反而降低有效需求带宽。要充分利用两层级带宽，访问必须同时满足并发性（每个wave内同时访问两层）和比例性（按带宽比例分配访问）。现有的带宽比例页面放置策略（如BAPP-R）在4KB页时代可隐式实现并发，但现代GPU使用2MB大页，每个wave仅涉及数十个页面，随机放置在wave级别产生巨大比例方差，导致性能反而下降。
AI.method: BOOST由两个组件构成：(1) 页面分配管理器（PAM），对静态模型权重采用模运算页面放置（MPP），将连续K个superpage分配给HBM、第K+1个分配给主机层，确保每个wave内访问比例严格匹配带宽比；对CTA足迹与页边界不对齐的内核，使用superpage粒度（LCM of CTA footprint与页大小）确保每个CTA仅访问一个层级。(2) 数据形状重映射器（DSR），针对注意力内核中动态分配的KV缓存，将KV按head分块（KV head chunk）映射，并在运行时通过贪心策略维护single-head-host与all-local两类block的比例，使active KV head chunks中访问主机层的比例始终接近目标α。BOOST在vLLM中实现（约800行代码），仅修改权重加载器和KV池管理器，通过mmap/mbind分配页面，无需任何GPU端内核改动或运行时数据迁移。
AI.result: 在Grace Hopper系统上（α=10%），BOOST将TPOT在同batch大小下平均提升4.3%（而预取方案反而劣化6%）；在高吞吐服务中吞吐量平均提升31%（比预取高15%）。PAM单独贡献约23%加速，DSR再贡献额外约7%。在容量匹配对比中，4%的TPOT/吞吐增益纯粹来自并发访问，而非仅来自容量扩展。BAPP-R策略因wave级比例方差反而造成0.4%-2.7%的TPOT退化。在更高α（12%）的H100模拟平台上，BOOST达到9.6%的加速。在面向GB200的分析模型预测中，BOOST增益随α增大而提升，最高可超过预取60%。
AI.conclusion: BOOST证明了通过wave感知的页面放置和运行时数据管理，可以在不修改任何GPU内核的前提下实现并发且比例匹配的HBM+主机内存访问，从而同时提取两层级的合并带宽并扩展可用容量。这一方法在带宽受限的在线LLM解码场景中优于传统的预取式层级方案，且对未来具有更高α的近内存/分离内存系统（如Vera、NVLink-connected）同样适用，为充分释放异构GPU内存系统潜力提供了实用路径。

title: Real-World Deployment and Performance Characterisation of Fog-Based Deep Learning for Cold-Chain Temperature Prediction over LoRaWAN
summary: Fresh fruits and vegetables (FFVs) are highly perishable, and cold-chain breaks contribute significantly to global food waste. While Machine Learning (ML) can enable proactive intervention, cloud-based inference faces challenges such as latency and data loss. Fog computing addresses these issues but has been tested only in simulation for FFV cold-chain temperature prediction. To the best of the authors' knowledge, this paper presents its first real-world deployment. A fog-deployed LSTM-GRU model predicted cold-room temperature using LoRaWAN sensor data collected from a South African apple cold-storage facility with induced cold-chain breaks. Running entirely on a Raspberry Pi 4 with no cloud dependency, the system generated conditional SHAP explanations only when a break is predicted. The deployed system predicts cold-room temperature with an MAE of 0.2°C at roughly 0.2 kWh per day (0.7 Wh per prediction). Predictions were delivered in under one second (555 ms), dominated by network and messaging rather than computation, with conditional explanations adding modest cost. SHAP consumes 28% more CPU but is well within the hardware's capacity. The model attributes its predictions primarily to temperature, humidity, and their interaction. Critically, the deployment surfaced what simulation cannot: a sensor-triggered single point of failure, alongside genuine resilience, autonomous recovery from infrastructure faults and continued operation through internet loss. These are the first published deployment benchmarks for fog-based temperature prediction in FFV cold chains, establishing that explainable temperature forecasting is feasible on resource-constrained edge hardware. Future work includes asynchronous sensor fusion, commercial cold chain deployment, alternative model architectures, and causal analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在实际冷库环境中部署了基于雾计算的LSTM-GRU深度学习模型，通过LoRaWAN传感器数据预测苹果冷藏室温度，并在Raspberry Pi 4上实现了条件SHAP可解释性。系统以0.2°C的MAE、约0.7 Wh/次预测的能耗和555 ms的延迟运行，证明了在资源受限边缘硬件上进行可解释温度预测的可行性，同时揭示了传感器触发的单点故障等真实部署问题。
AI.motivation: 全球约三分之一的食物在供应链中被浪费，其中新鲜水果蔬菜（FFV）占近一半。冷链中断是主要原因之一。现有研究多采用云端机器学习推理，面临延迟高、数据丢失等问题，尤其是在低连接环境中。雾计算虽具优势，但在FFV冷链温度预测领域此前仅在仿真中验证，缺乏真实部署的性能基准数据。
AI.method: 采用堆叠式LSTM-GRU架构（LSTM(64)-Dropout-BatchNorm-GRU(50)-BatchNorm-Dense(1)），部署于Raspberry Pi 4雾节点。通过LoRaWAN（EU868）连接Kerlink网关和两个传感器（Synetica enLink ZonePlus环境传感器和Netvox R718E振动传感器）。事件驱动的传感器融合机制集成异步到达的传感器数据。使用SHAP GradientExplainer进行条件可解释性分析，仅在预测到温度中断时触发。模型离线训练后加载，在线推理。
AI.result: 温度预测精度：MAE = 0.1972°C（95% CI [0.1834, 0.2146]），MSE = 0.3826，R² = 0.7683；能耗约0.2 kWh/天（≈0.7 Wh/次预测），平均功耗8W；总延迟约555 ms（网络/消息占主导，推理约228 ms，SHAP额外约195 ms）；CPU平均1.95%（SHAP触发时升至2.42%，增加28%）；RAM约727 MiB（<20%）。24天运行中经历5次故障，系统可用性86.31%。SHAP分析显示温度、湿度及其交互作用是主要预测驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在资源受限的边缘硬件上进行可解释FFV冷链温度预测的可行性，单个雾节点可实现近实时、自主、低成本的预测。真实部署揭示了仿真无法发现的问题：基础设施故障后自主恢复、断网期间持续运行、以及由传感器触发设计导致的单点故障。系统存在轻微正偏差（0.13°C），偏向高估温度，属于安全方向的偏差。未来工作将重新设计推理触发机制以实现优雅降级，并扩展到商业冷链环境。

title: Reducing Cold-Start Latency in Serverless Applications via Dynamic Slicing
summary: We present PyXtrim, a system that reduces the cold-start latency of serverless applications through debloating. We focus on Python, a dominant language for serverless applications whose dynamic features and extensive use of native extensions make traditional static debloating particularly challenging. PyXtrim frames debloating as a dynamic slicing problem, using the application's externally visible behavior as the slicing criterion. Everything outside the resulting slice is removed, both from the application and its dependencies. Our key technical contribution is that the slice is computed by a cross-language dynamic dependence engine that tracks data and control dependences across Python and native code and identifies operations that interact with the operating system, which form the slicing criterion. As a result, PyXtrim can effectively handle real-world applications that rely on dynamic features such as reflection, interoperate with native code and interact with system resources. Across 31 applications on AWS Lambda, PyXtrim reduces cold-start latency by 21.7% and peak memory usage by 17.1% at the median. This is more than double the reduction achieved by the state of the art, while debloating each application in minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PyXtrim系统，将Python无服务器应用的冷启动去膨胀问题建模为动态切片问题，通过跨语言动态依赖引擎跟踪Python字节码和原生扩展间的数据/控制依赖，以应用的外部可见行为作为切片标准，在AWS Lambda上31个应用中实现冷启动延迟中位数降低21.7%、峰值内存降低17.1%，效果为现有最优工具λ-trim的两倍以上。
AI.motivation: 无服务器计算中冷启动延迟是关键挑战，其中初始化阶段（占计费时长53.8%）的大部分代码从未影响handler行为（30%-66%是冗余的）。现有方法如λ-trim（仅处理单模块）、FaaSLight（错误假设需要编译）、SlimStart（延迟副作用）均存在局限，Python的动态特性和原生扩展依赖使传统静态去膨胀方法难以处理。
AI.method: 将去膨胀建模为动态切片问题：(1)切片标准设为产生外部可见效果的操作（sinks），通过拦截libc调用识别；(2)构建动态依赖图（DDG），通过shadow interpreter（基于sys.monitoring）跟踪Python字节码的标签传播记录数据/控制依赖，仅IMPORT_NAME和MAKE_FUNCTION引入标签；(3)C-API拦截器通过GOT重写捕获原生扩展对Python对象的访问，并将其转化为依赖边；(4)trimmer离线计算fslice(S)\bslice(T)删除未影响sinks的import和函数定义语句，并实现import collapsing优化处理冗余导入链。
AI.result: 在AWS Lambda的31个真实应用上评估：PyXtrim成功处理全部31个应用（λ-trim 28个、FaaSLight 10个、SlimStart 7个）；冷启动延迟中位数降低21.7%（λ-trim仅8.5%），峰值内存降低17.1%（λ-trim仅5.4%）；去膨胀时间中位数5分钟（λ-trim为62分钟）；从未使任何应用变慢；消融实验证明sink detector使效果翻倍，C-API拦截器保证安全性（缺失时19/31应用失败）；在本地环境下复现了类似结果（中位数24.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 动态切片是优化无服务器程序的有效基础，PyXtrim通过跨Python和原生代码的依赖跟踪，能有效处理真实应用中反射、原生扩展和系统资源交互等复杂场景；该依赖分析方法不局限于去膨胀，还可用于源代码-汇点漏洞检测等其他用途。

title: DQN-Scheduler: A Multi-Objective Optimization Framework for Scheduling Microservices in Cloud Computing
summary: Cloud computing has emerged as an information technology solution, providing software and infrastructure solutions for companies and individuals. The pay-as-you-go approach has increased demands for the cloud. The massive range of resources, the variety of services, and flexible pricing grab attention. In addition, microservices have emerged as a new way of building software, with applications developed as loosely dependent tasks. Additionally, container technology has boosted the popularity of microservices by offering a platform for this type of architecture. Containers and microservices improve the flexibility and scalability of cloud applications. There are two primary types of microservices: batch and online services, with the majority of applications falling into the online service category. Scheduling microservices is challenging because it requires careful management of resource utilization, load balancing, network latency, reliability, and availability. In this study, we introduce the DQN-Scheduler, a novel reinforcement learning-based agent designed to optimize microservice scheduling in cloud environments.
